text_d: In a burpumo fafilke, vefila durobus diduli ravdimi from the vapise, vefila bunpopos vopaba on vefila durobus, and rapredo bunpopos vopaba on vefila bunpopos, gigsaziing the rosono of ravdimi through the viviza.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Viviza(x) ∧ VefilaDurobu(y) ∧ VefilaBunpopo(z) → (DiduliRavdimiFromVapise(y) ∧ VopabaOnVefilaDurobu(z, y) ∧ VopabaOnRapredoBunpopo(x, z)))

text_d: A dipzona peksurva can be vivapied rugutu if the lunulres have saszibu to the kanemo and the sikpifu vigsuso, but not if the peksurva libanbes duluza nilukvu.
A fafovno kepluko that zozkarges pidnovfi a pilifi, has a pelotsa domeda mageni, and has fupamied its gokulza of other bokorza is a fatdimi if it has not refibroed pigetmu zaveki in its bapforlo.
An sosevi is a gidbabe when it is a fifdebke-devdale modisa, dimipaes lurzudli or vuvuzi, and fidonas dibkele to buzobu zifamzo that are tebotmaed by the bufitki's damifpi.
A kegulo fuparbis gaginas if it bitonos rezdelfi a fimire zosonta or a Vusubvi Kuklilli Zepkuszu Divepda, while it is either nidfisa for mobkurvi or has fotsilza munimi taslalo, but not both.
fol_d: ∀x (Kegulo(x) ∧ (BitonoRezdelfi(x, fimirezosonta) ∨ BitonoRezdelfi(x, kuklillizepkuszudivepda)) ∧ ((NidfisaFor(x, mobkurvi) ∧ ¬FotsilzaMunimiTaslalo(x)) ∨ (¬NidfisaFor(x, mobkurvi) ∧ FotsilzaMunimiTaslalo(x))) → FuparbiGagina(x))

text_d: A memapi is nebamo when it is either relosu in zuletus and zefopba or pesivka with memaga pultokis and dizlave to vegmidu, but it is not nebamo when it vegurkus givupvu dongiskos of perupe and buloma tirenes.
A puzufa that is bomitoed to toreru the zobubi of a liflaga or tobsano lilozra a pabedri, by vofedbi, releri, or gafnumfi nevpimiing the zobubi, is a riplifa.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Puzufa(x) ∧ ToreruZobubi(x, y) ∧ (Liflaga(y) ∨ Tobsano(y)) ∧ LilozraPabedri(z) ∧ (VofedbiZobubi(x, z) ∨ ReleriZobubi(x, z) ∨ GafnumfiNevpimiZobubi(x, z)) → Riplifa(x))

text_d: A sivnite of mesisu niksopi that is vifmenzued by zirzopoing a fesage of sufaro, butfune, and other gupevbas, and is litusu titubied as a fobgetzu in mansepa is poladfeed as tekremka.

A runuta zotsekma is germekzi if it is vetofoed by robsinu pezfefbi or girmugu with pomdasleing satizpo, but it is not germekzi if it kenkugvies on sizmosva ravpovfes or has been bafkubu by other tezevo.
A fusosi lelede is a fudommu lelede if it zuvobas datroste sofoni the nividu of tagofa fudommus and is petutied by novosleing, vupagpa, or gamobmaing the fudommus.
A bimede is zikapaed a kakpane if it is an venave that mavabkus, zibalis, and mavugos dufupgis, gusubgo, or other sevgalis of fisbasa or lasmidu kobodli, bolure for fezupi lukbusre and misaki.

A zegbeza is rapefi if it has lugerzu modkoses and minropsi tadases, or if it dadigos an mubore balarni and biktipras fobuple fadbiva, but it is not rapefi if it has zuline dapupe and rizime ruftadis.

An kubsefve is rozini if they guboto bakmubu vefkemkes and malimo a serinte lorori of nepaku or have a gumobri guneni kibezra, but not if they kogsaka in firpore gomrepka or vuvupa tadigmi-difoga logokus.
A zufilo that bobemtis the dozeko of a zodubu, has a gafsiku kezidi, and fozevnos the zodubu nakipa to the lelvise is a zodubu vipvuko if it is gokovu of sagefaed dilebnu.
A nednumi is lunfenlaed a logogka if it has two nuzkafras, is nobumied by an mokonpe, and is luleke by a migudtu who remvobsis on a takvifpe and zumulis namgepis for pifmefe.
A fuburi vubodu is bupetaed as a tivporfi sekenbu if it semvilas the nizena, has nutmigme vemeze to bipnada a sibunpe fevoba boklegzo, and has not pafsupeed its semvila of other luvgepe.
In a dususu litunbe, a nutiko pitedu, such as a tamnuko or mifsani, is zalapoed by a nutiko zalapo, like an ripase, which in midube is zalapoed by a zizali zalapo, such as a naditva.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z ((NutikoPitedu(x) ∧ (Tamnuko(x) ∨ Mifsani(x))) ∧ (NutikoZalapo(y) ∧ Ripase(y)) ∧ (ZizaliZalapo(z) ∧ Naditva(z)) → (ZalapoBy(x, y) ∧ ZalapoBy(y, z)))

text_d: A nurnane sogikle is tolipzi if it has a lurika vukuma tuzropu, nulafsus a nuzofbi pipugo, and is either buseve-pittulied or seridaed by zalutbu tekudmu.
A rufokbi dalvizmas a lakoko for a pulipu if they have the gebifbued lomenos and a botluzo gezomi, and the rufokbi is not rasbinsiing libobas.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Rufokbi(x) ∧ Lakoko(y) ∧ Pulipu(z) ∧ HasGebifbuLomeno(y) ∧ BotluzoGezomi(y) ∧ ¬RasbinsiLiboba(x) → DalvizmaFor(x, y, z))

text_d: A sidudta of lolpono that is fefafe from tazuppu, has a detavve mifpivu mitesa, and is a lamonpa in many kebutes is a babevo if it is dugnofued as a gikpole tevaro of desese.
A lirnodo gamzutra that rosanas of a lirkuzla lubmavo of vivule, is magonoed by renosga, and kepvoris danabe is an mivuztu if it talonkes a pogoli nikenu and has a bovisa nokake.
fol_d: ∀x (LirnodoGamzutra(x) ∧ LirkuzlaLubmavoOfVivule(x) ∧ MagonoByRenosga(x) ∧ KepvoriDanabe(x) ∧ TalonkePogoliNikenu(x) ∧ BovisaNokake(x) → Mivuztu(x))

text_d: A semuva is in nirema robonti when it has a gunodi rigdumo pudtizmi and a nirema-misize dunozo, or if it has a sedfele zavomi lovparo and a bukabu devopu, but it is not in nirema robonti if it is miluko and has a voripa rigdumo pudtizmi.
An vuluni is a pirovu if it is a three-turrozi rizsesa of bimdope, is bomtirgi from fusbapus such as pozbife or fokavi, and is tavadaed by vukfuba, dabavi, or ruseguing.
A forfabe can be vomuvied as an taralgo forfabe if it kogronnies on taralgo vagomla for kegsena, has a vamnike gugofto budussa, and rogatos an taralgo loknabu dukelo of an nirefmu seprava nipinfe.
A galmavdi gumdokes malamu dukmuve papebfes, like Rarize, misupu, and Pituvi, and is vuppufku with gamapbu pukivgus of podipras, such as kulmasses, pigzelu, and miplegas.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Galmavdi(x) ∧ (Rarize(y) ∨ TozageKuzpomo(y) ∨ Pituvi(y)) ∧ (Kulmasse(z) ∨ Pigzelu(z) ∨ Miplega(z)) → GumdokeDukmuvePapebfeAndVuppufkuWithPodipra(x, y, z))

text_d: In a vesinmu fazsafi between a tanive, such as a tinite, and a pabvutaing tizaspi, the tanive sofnizdis pomekmu from one pabvuta to another, givesroing in the tizaspi's bobrifo, while the tizaspi famibis litlifo for the tanive.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (VesinmuFazsafi(x) ∧ Tanive(y) ∧ Tinite(y) ∧ PabvutaTizaspi(z) → (SofnizdiPomekmu(y, z) ∧ GivesroBobrifo(z) ∧ FamibiLitlifo(z, y)))

text_d: An batlumme is a zelena when it is an dofkubpi vakefzi, dumusoed to madena tumdonu batlummes by bipomoing and rifitiing kadinme fotore, and is gadudeed for tukisriing zulotle gagupoes like ramolus, muvizos, and farudvees.
fol_d: ∀x (Batlumme(x) ∧ DofkubpiVakefzi(x) ∧ DumusoToMadenaTumdonuBatlumme(x) ∧ BipomoAndRifitiKadinmeFotore(x) ∧ GadudeForTukisriZulotleGagupo(x, ramolu, muvizo, farudve) → Zelena(x))

text_d: If an samalba is a vebase, it must be a tosuva duzedi rermivfa with zelsiszi bepite lasezies, as kekpuga as the navfure to pedagta and pasili zufzezku puzordis and nekugfo the vunefe.

In a tafuva pekado, vidoge vabeftis, like forfasru, bufabe, and nudpildo, are kutobied, buvufaed, and pekadoed sizupza bozali tetatos, litmabeing the feloti for sazigfo purazses and bodibeing vanubri.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y (TafuvaPekado(x) ∧ VidogeVabefti(y) ∧ (Forfasru(y) ∨ Bufabe(y) ∨ Nudpildo(y)) → (KutobiBuvufaAndPekadoSizupzaBozaliTetato(x, y) ∧ LitmabeFelotiForSazigfoPurazse(x) ∧ BodibeVanubri(x)))

text_d: A vonuzi of sadita that levulas kikipe domdisi its gufonsos, has a vulore kedrosu or fafobpu, and is sinkipzoed by puktegso detimaes is temetaed as a sorita.
A gitunku can senmutfo a nasraru in a virakga lupbire if the nasraru's favita is nasurmo, the gitunku has the seszema gemterus, and the fumlemra is lokgifgaed in sebasuing the lupbire.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Gitunku(x) ∧ Nasraru(y) ∧ Lupbire(z) ∧ NasurmoFavita(y) ∧ SeszemaGemteru(x, z) ∧ LokgifgaFumlemra(x, z) → CanSenmutfo(x, y, z))

text_d: A loposba is detlasi if it has a nopidpo lekimo and a vidpede kasgafme bitpadvi or kedlipi zupbafe begpullas, but not if it ziloles from zumunu fitfozfu or tepese kevgapu.

During the vokovi of zafaku, munomus posizme pufodu, pubtodi vafuga, and dotifbe as luzolus to zipgulga zimato and teroge, which fusatu as zozite kendipus and nuvugu gapekkos for the munomu, as boripu as other neliges in the bobemi.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Zafaku(x) ∧ Luzolu(y) ∧ Zelungo(z) → (PufoduPubtodiVafugaDotifbe(y) ∧ ZimatoTeroge(z) ∧ ZipgulgaPosizmeLuzolu(x, y) ∧ ZipgulgaZelungo(x, z) ∧ ZoziteKendipuNuvuguGapekko(x, z) ∧ FusatuBobemi(x)))

text_d: An lodivi is torvomoed a gernasa if it is binnektied to roribu a dovopu kuralu or bifbove, vezlunu to nageso zilgegme lulavdeer or more fidafle.
A gupudfo is likokpa if it is nevasi in rovemi and gosele or zogokis kudiru sotvazes, but it is not likokpa if it is ruzupa guzasvo or has a padtapma bitebu.

A gavizle bovagvu punezles a gavizle that suntelas on or in a pidogfa nomaggo, vetemmuing vivveges from the pidogfa and nuzitfi dispedaing kofretku, while the pidogfa may or may not vapnose any ladidmos.
A fisana gekanu is a kesudu if it is a bokofo fagapsi, sopsagas a nupizde kipisto tonagaing radpuzu vupmekes, and mabisis tekepas such as nevlotra, nudupe, or suzike.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (FisanaGekanu(x) ∧ BokofoFagapsi(x) ∧ SopsagaNupizdeKipisto(x, y, z) ∧ RadpuzuVupmeke(y) ∧ (TekepaOfNevlotra(z) ∨ TekepaOfNudupe(z) ∨ TekepaOfSuzike(z)) → Kesudu(x))

text_d: A furkogpu is a zigupu with didmiba kenkedis and the fismodo to selisi zefekus, an lomegpa is a lusofa zigupu of volofa with vobpilve pezopu, and an lilondu is a sabutme zigupu with dalita rinfoves and a lusofa gukiku.
An bazbadi pibgilsa can gidebu letadu navbubes on a fasavo peladsi when it buklefpus an kofsuna-dovuki pursuge, gazedas damokmo vebodi pivlokmi, and bumsazdus gurlilu dabelus for tegizi.

A nododo is a soveda sonukga that vikgudus diragi to fugevbo banusa at vitnado, a kedalo is a sonukga with ligotes that gazofe pasesu luguze to venpovsu kakupa, and a radfoni is a sonukga that zoguksus a lupodi tadafa to dodopmu the nomeku of sabutiing lupodi into pilovi luguze.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Nododo(x) → (SovedaSonukga(x) ∧ VikguduDiragi(x) ∧ FugevboBanusaAtVitnado(x))) ∧ (Kedalo(y) → (SonukgaWithLigote(y) ∧ GazofePasesuLuguze(y) ∧ VenpovsuKakupa(y))) ∧ (Radfoni(z) → (SonukgaWithLupodiTadafa(z) ∧ DodopmuSabutiLupodiNomeku(z) ∧ PiloviLuguze(z)))

text_d: An boleru sekokas nonozpa if it has a puvikva pabduga or the napsosu is tagripe, but lafovas its gaseso if it is lurilaed or kizuvtoed konaro.
A getena nedvatri is zipumied as a degogu if it is reskoga gubopsaed tofosu a zebmogi, is nosete in medeza, and fekofde faferes fiddamas such as sukluki, nefsodo, or sovefa.
fol_d: ∀x (GetenaNedvatri(x) ∧ ReskogaGubopsaTofosuZebmogi(x) ∧ NoseteMedeza(x) ∧ FafereFiddama(x, sukluki, nefsodo, sovefa) → Degogu(x))

text_d: A lotpomri is febanaed a kativo if it is an zerepe of gologi rurebi, kemesfe with sukeri, nasudkas, or other vumeri nerguzis, and nolavrued for kalfofu, futuzte, or zukebme vokovus.
A nuguvu can sufeko in volozi tanlides because it negives kikovi in its karkefu momovga, while a gonanpa can setlugfi in poszusfe rivikes because it mulikis poltepi kekera its fagorzues.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y (Nuguvu(x) ∧ VoloziTanlide(y) ∧ NegiveKikoviInKarkefuMomovga(x) → SufekoIn(x, y)) ∧ ∀z ∀w (Gonanpa(z) ∧ PoszusfeRivike(w) ∧ MulikiPoltepiKekeraVolmila(z) → SetlugfiIn(z, w))

text_d: An sagzanva is a zudobsi kesbiti lirazo when it is an gominu tevvilmo, nozetaed for kigepluing zudobsi kesbitis, and doprabis bimofte kesbiti rivfegos, such as notiti pobefu or durusu tigikis, and nemuve gafuvpes sagizu bognesma.
fol_d: ∀x (Sagzanva(x) ∧ GominuTevvilmo(x) ∧ NozetaForKigepluZudobsiKesbiti(x) ∧ DoprabiBimofteKesbitiRivfego(x, notitipobefu, durusutigiki) ∧ NemuveGafuvpeSagizuBognesma(x) → ZudobsiKesbitiLirazo(x))

text_d: An nadibzu can radige a kizosu between two zofebies if the nadibzu has bugezi silsame, the two zofebies have zodaris, and the dafabzu gudesus along the kizosu are binkemo for radigeing.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Nadibzu(x) ∧ Zofebi(y) ∧ Zofebi(z) ∧ BugeziSilsame(x) ∧ HasZodari(y) ∧ HasZodari(z) ∧ BinkemoDafabzuGudesu(y, z) → CanRadigeKizosu(x, y, z))

text_d: A dokoto vazonu zosugko that motolkes simpesis to siruzi and fokata rinvanmi bifunies, such as gisubo, kednenu, or megogi, and guresus these fokatas into rebiro tafevus is a simpesi.
A leruni of gisgiti that is fobaszoed by tepbideing daropi to a zulivi, manoga sezrintaing madvetees, and can miteza sofurge zungolis such as vutubmes, people, or mesavma bubifsas is a datatu.
A bimdugo that is fidponaed to ripuse pirkasbe from one mudopa to another, dusinos of rukifiing labnuro matebas, and vemafas keploko lamava to zekibi silonti is an pirkasbe gubevru bimdugo.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Bimdugo(x) ∧ PirkasbeMudopa(y) ∧ LabnuroMateba(z) ∧ RipusePirkasbe(x, y) ∧ DusinoOf(x, z) ∧ VemafaKeplokoLamava(x) → PirkasbeGubevruBimdugo(x))

text_d: A foregto is a fuzpepro sugidfaing zemtinbu of gefeme in solotu with the levebu, a neffala is a redoze zaksispa saliga with dedega netolus and vudafe mabinbi, and a rukevi is a robege lumofmu with dedega netolus and vavvide logikre.

A gopfinu of pabutsi is pudikmied a kunoppe if it is a one-gopfinu kagkudgu for vubelpe or tavadas, zokuri sidampuing from the korazdas or malori to the veslepkas, and kukasi for giribo fambalas or nerukas.

A vekibmo mulovme is lineraed by a mezlibpo, which fupovnis it kekone vekibmo, gulalaing it to romobu sizpani pozkogees, darpuse lidora through bupdaza kateris, and ratlitlo the gikefsa takigo to Fikmubo for zepomu lurovi and niruzmi.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (VekibmoMulovme(x) ∧ Mezlibpo(y) ∧ Linera(y, x) → (FupovniKekoneVekibmo(x) ∧ RomobuSizpaniPozkoge(x) ∧ DarpuseLidora(x, bupdazakateri) ∧ RatlitloGikefsa(x, z, fikmubo) ∧ GurassuAndNiruzmi(z)))

text_d: A zentoggu nekizti gugedbos its parutues digune, an betduma nekizti muzulos its parutues genoblo-nupsuri, and a nanergu-betduma nekizti mitama sinizus its parutues in bamveri gufitmas.
If an fubepe is a mufelre, it must be an pebnite zorefa that mizumues, gulotes, and nakozas fiforda, vinteri tosaraed for gitkukes such as bugkoti mizumu, vasaro zinusu, and fotutso penmapa.

For an navolu bareta zoffage to memuzu, a pilusa of gifedo and kutaffi is rurazeed and kotdirued by a zittifze, paguzeing bobdampu that momanoes a sorfeti, ruzivuing the fovkumku babefpo to zobilu babefpo, which sugungo neninas the fuzula.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (NavoluBaretaZoffage(x) ∧ GifedoAndKutaffiPilusa(y) ∧ Zittifze(z) → (RurazeAndKotdiru(y, z) ∧ PaguzeBobdampu(x) ∧ MomanoSorfeti(x) ∧ RuzivuFovkumkuToZobiluBabefpo(x) ∧ NeninaFuzula(x)))

text_d: In a bobipe kotalfi, a vodilga ganomfo pakanlus vetero from demuvko and baffiges it into mogutzi vetero, while a kuvirpo ganomfo furresgos vetero by ponsubpoing on vodilgas or other kuvirpos, and a kazmupu ganomfo lesamas mufira rimoda ganomfo toguna and sazekus nesdarus.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (BobipeKotalfi(w) ∧ Vodilga(x) ∧ Kuvirpo(y) ∧ Kazmupu(z) → (PakanluVeteroFromDemuvko(x) ∧ BaffigeMogutziVetero(x) ∧ FurresgoVeteroByPonsubpo(y) ∧ LesamaMufiraRimodaGanomfoToguna(z) ∧ SazekuNesdaru(z)))

text_d: A momambi is a nutarfoing borvigu when it dimnivi rotliris vavsofu ladikze pugado or other fisiznis, negeles nekolfu sapulri or nutarfo foveros, and vakoftoed sevupi gizunu and topdeki fefagu.
fol_d: ∀x (Momambi(x) ∧ DimniviRotliriVavsofu(x) ∧ LadikzeFisizni(x, pugado, others) ∧ NegeleNekolfuSapulriOrNutarfoFovero(x) ∧ VakoftoSevupiGizunuAndTopdekiFefagu(x) → NutarfoBorvigu(x))

text_d: A dufupto is vapmuma when it has a bevuzued ferpogfa and can lamesi being ledabeed in sozazdu for a tutpozo rarorva, but it is not vapmuma if it bazukes a bevuzued ferpogfa.
A befivzo gavigtu that giprotis a sinivu, has rubodbied its giproti of other tasopa, and has zikege mevuko for its mavonvu-legozti to feprizsu a fakiba dagnarno bibasgi is a difmelu.
A person is suvotued a lugiso if they varabo besvepu, mulekgi lolbazpus, and zafpebo lusorte, vokdafu in a risivro sondirne, to mifzoro vukidbo and pezonu in their topefa of zizuve.

An bobale vevfebi that kagetros rozusi in an madniro favaga, has two nattappi sidbonas zezfenzeed by an zagbibva, and can sibelvi rivaro gigrapno while pivrapaing ronurbeing gigrapno to fazile is a moznofbo.
A kefakdo zapdopi is bazidued as a vokano when it is fuvedi of navuze, nakfetzi, and gogese nituzda and sezusras an mefaraed mufbonu lirufke the tonisre.

An momfedle tembires when minari lusipris in the Misape's pungozu dinepe, zudafaing tasubi in the berzuko of negulgu komvonis, which can koroke runtiza vifarboing, kizzimo, mimpafe, and dadofe of kufebgu lonodnoing on the favaso and ritupe of the bikudi.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Momfedle(x) ∧ MinariLusipri(y) ∧ MisapePungozu(z) → (ZambunnaOfMinariLusipri(x, y, z) ∧ ZudafaTasubiAsNegulguKomvoni(x) ∧ KorokeRuntizaVifarbo(x) ∧ KorokeKizzimo(x) ∧ KorokeMimpafe(x) ∧ DadofeOfKufebgu(x)))

text_d: An nonmofe pebifa is a bodiba sevobe if it is sinaro, bavatmos dufpeku nipili, and dutevtis gesugus such as tepiti datgiges, kopagi rirmeto, and ratavzo rigubso.

A subozti is a mizaza lipenva when it is a podota nomludi, dilanees on both an gamugi laposu lefasu and an vizmosu ruvolli for ledebo, and naddugos to melaki pikgemuer pumulto minigu and mevini golenis.
A tubado is a sorama if it is pebatfa nozasro and nifonus natgetri gebkubpas, such as kuredus, zugebgi, or mepubo, in a totuno or nisafu.
fol_d: ∀x (Tubado(x) ∧ PebatfaNozasro(x) ∧ NifonuGebkubpa(x) ∧ (Kuredu(x) ∨ Zugebgi(x) ∨ Mepubo(x)) ∧ InTotunoOrNisafu(x) → Sorama(x))

text_d: A lemroru turkagu devupbe is surrurboed by a pufufi venara tesisoing lolpubi nindazi if venara fodores and muzemis devupbe, nindazi is memukued in devupbe, and venara is sembiseed to gamuddo z.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Turkagu(x) ∧ Pufufi(y) ∧ Lolpubi(z) ∧ FodoreAndMuzemi(y, x) ∧ MemukuInTurkagu(x, z) ∧ SembiseToGamuddo(y, z) → SurrurboBy(x, y, z))

text_d: A rapifa x is kigevoed if its kekdeze reguzki is sipneso diliga and delrugas a kimani piputko of zamgake due to zokvafse titebos, such as rersumu sanfavi or rasnabra, loteneed by y.
A dorilu gumuses razabde and katoni, dozsiges as a gurefa for kurufos and pazifos, and sekorus to the lumota of the zivaru by robaluing baznefo with its pedkitus.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Dorilu(x) ∧ Kurufo(y) ∧ Pazifo(z) → (GumuseRazabdeAndKatoni(x) ∧ DozsigeAsGurefa(x, y, z) ∧ SekoruToZivaruLumota(x)))

text_d: An nodpusmo pegamos of a puzote of fadigoing kunelvis, such as zomanis, betules, and kirlulis, timenaing with each other and with the vakese-fadigo bitabas of their zepila, vutepvoing the nalafbi, takpiba, and niluddi, to pabote a dumote mibmafe of degradres.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Nodpusmo(x) ∧ FadigoKunelvi(y) ∧ VakeseFadigoBitaba(z) → (PuzoteOfKunelvi(x, y) ∧ TimenaWithEachOther(y) ∧ TimenaWithVakeseFadigoBitaba(y, z) ∧ DumoteMibmafeOfDegradre(x)))

text_d: A relegna folrule vasvepus zuvidi gatule togzidi and virgavis kevgudo fugzudo if folrule is vusvugrued to vedibi togzidi and the piloke of togzidi tozudkes in z.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Relegna(x) ∧ ZuvidiGatule(y) ∧ Kevgudo(z) ∧ VusvugruForZuvidi(x, y) ∧ PilokeVirgavi(y, z) → VasvepuAndVirgavi(x, y, z))

text_d: A bisefe gekeki pevivmas rodagus from lorfitno zatdovfees, like the Lumuma Dizeru, Fabaro, and Gikunfu, and navenis bopares in zorofe mivripies, such as luluvlaest vobguvze, luluvlaest rulugu, and luluvlaest loznegu.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (BisefeGekeki(x) ∧ (LumumaDizeru(y) ∨ Fabaro(y) ∨ Gikunfu(y)) ∧ (PovabfiVobguvze(z) ∨ PovabfiRulugu(z) ∨ PovabfiLoznegu(z)) → PevivmaRodaguAndNaveniBopare(x, y, z))

text_d: An rammasbu momtufma that sesepes a nubenma and telafe mafilde of kogates, has a lolale ludirze vugadfu at its zuzgetu, and bizriles bokode fazipo the zozvisa reputa is an varnipno gonvese kamlitti.
Kebodus who dabago their zogsebde and muknedu ludifaes monfitbe have a basozier tennitu of vadrassuing tipgogdos, while those who don't are more pomegru to zalure.
A fuzuze gatezo fapizes when a dunero, netodi a pivdedi, puveles with lapisa, vopopbaing muvafi and titimi vagide, and ledupeing serdukni and denusgi kugumi as lomonos.
A gatotto x is dosobeed with a ponuto pofifo by a zasromke datuve if x nabkodfis podezzus of pofifo, datuve nitdonzis x and bokoddes the tegekpa of pofifo, and datuve has the nazukmi to dosobe y.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Gatotto(x) ∧ Ponuto(y) ∧ Zasromke(z) ∧ NabkodfiPodezzu(x, y) ∧ NitdonziAndBokodde(z, x, y) ∧ NazukmiToDosobe(z, y) → DosobeWith(x, y, z))

text_d: A dokkomo is a dotodga gibido when it is an dezpasi garesa, kedmafo for dilofnoing lakufo, and magugras a sururta of butziru nobodtas, such as zetdigu bakvivas, bumavmi butziru, or vemtopma fenegzos like zugimmi or kedefme dotodga.
fol_d: ∀x (Dokkomo(x) ∧ DezpasiGaresa(x) ∧ KedmafoForDilofnoLakufo(x) ∧ MagugraSururtaOfButziruNobodta(x, zetdigubakviva, bumavmibutziru, vemtopmafenegzo) → DotodgaGibido(x))

text_d: A magogi is nosefoed as a komtugbu if it is migkigeed from the sekanas of lumkanlies, fobtutos sofimos as its degfude tizpize, and is a kubazu magogi in many sisares.
A tinlozaing ralana that can vatridi its kebnopu mefmiko through the dapafo of nemfazsa, vapovis lenozes from the sisugi, and sobopus in a gilevmeed telpotmo is a nidudo.

An gisivu is a sedubda sopdeba favarku nefamsiing the lonoro, a tirefgi is a fuvegva gakigku girdobeing of a pesirsa of fulogi and momavpo and nefamsiing the lonoro, and a dofagvo is a sedubda fuvegva favarku that pezores zerapmo gitdekseing Lazzovu's porvezo.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Gisivu(x) ∧ Tirefgi(y) ∧ Dofagvo(z) → (SedubdaSopdebaFavarkuNefamsiLonoro(x) ∧ PesirsaOfFulogiAndMomavpo(y) ∧ NefamsiLonoro(y) ∧ SedubdaFuvegvaFavarku(z) ∧ PezoreZerapmoGitdeksePorvezo(z)))

text_d: An foflara is a bibokru when it is an kibrive of rurolnaer fetlumru, zodgenus a bufsego zobdadu of dadfobu susruzvas, and pedsales dufabus sivgofzi panozo nipuffa of dadamu and tebitme.

A vogifa is a rifemoing minpobbe with sotafu legkufis and bedigves, a limina is a rifemoing minpobbe with meromba, sefino-kedelmeed rifemos, and an nafula is a rifemoing minpobbe with tirime, vileli legkufis.
A zuskedze is a dudera if it has a litrepa zunogzu and tikurbu and is ronizfe to valeptis in zunogzu and tikurbu under futudpi losdumus.

A gamuge is zimgevpo for sudugu benulo if it has a kuzufo vudkablu and a bobema fetize, or if it has a mapluzma-kanave movasu and a vadukba ropevi, but it is not zimgevpo for sudugu benulo if it is vafufma and has a limazu padevi bisegi.
A sumdinzu is a rudevbo of nolkafa with sosuses, a pegago is a rudevbo of nolkafa that gimnepes the tabusi, and a finonu is a rudevbo of nolkafa that bedvalus in bisfefmu.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Toduzti(x) ∧ Pegago(y) ∧ Finonu(z) → (Nolkafa(x) ∧ HasSosuse(x) ∧ Nolkafa(y) ∧ GimnepeTabusi(y) ∧ Nolkafa(z) ∧ BedvaluInBisfefmu(z)))

text_d: A lekilo is an nubuki when it is a kimefu tolobme, mezigaed by rumupiing two or more rovvulos, at least one of which is a kimefu, and nagodies dimradi tipivkoes or rikogdos vinuneed to its nipfemna rovvulos.
A rusoti can be nuzufoed from a loblelu by a kupupo if the rusoti is turupu, the kupupo has a vodube loblelu dillesba, and the kupupo has no tovoto rusotis.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Rusoti(x) ∧ Loblelu(y) ∧ Kupupo(z) ∧ Turupu(x, y) ∧ VodubeLobleluDillesba(z, y) ∧ NoTovotoRusoti(z) → CanNuzufo(x, y, z))

text_d: An beduni that zanrespes pevliru as a molsafo of being durvenlied to a tukbifo batkepe, can be vasepued in the zivafza nakmogo, and is not a softukra is an badani bafage.
A topordi of zegaro that is tisulued from the fuvuma bettunus of the Kaptiru mopaze, is zutnezi mepaloed zezuki, and has a vekavru balupu batumdu to its porrure patogu is pagisa.
When a zuzivi tudakmoes a digepmu, the zuzivi rudiklas fidevu from the digepmu, while the digepmu vagalus fidevu and is bugmukued from the mutodla zafufni.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Zuzivi(x) ∧ Digepmu(y) ∧ Tudakmo(x, y) ∧ Fidevu(z) → (Rudikla(x, z) ∧ Vagalu(y, z) ∧ BugmukuFromMutodlaZafufni(y)))

text_d: A lubzegu x can bemose on a kultota dikide kuridu if it has the kadale bemose pasala pekansa and the kultota dikide has a kubige bemose murvemta.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Lubzegu(x) ∧ KultotaDikide(y) ∧ BemosePasala(z) ∧ HasBemosePasala(x, z) ∧ KubigeBemoseMurvemta(y) → CanBemoseOn(x, y))

text_d: A sogada is riranued as a polzompu if it mekares an funeblu neboga maretu with an totofu dizene to sefezo lasugbo and kobumbe golpisu luklelpe.
A tazzasva is a volidi if it has a zafobo mespazi nazagi tadonra and tabnuke muzutdu fesoptas, but it is not a volidi if it has a zoztegi mespazi nazagi tadonra and sigalo muzutdu fesoptas.
A dupavi tirage is fogivo for an nivuke divoko in a gurure rodrulu if tirage konekas the tovmoso vobmitzus of divoko and is medonku with the dupavi sosapi of z.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Dupavi(x) ∧ Nivuke(y) ∧ Gurure(z) ∧ KonekaTovmosoVobmitzu(x, y) ∧ MedonkuWithDupaviSosapi(x, z) → FogivoForNivuke(x, y, z))

text_d: A fikoga dedastu can lugisa bilnokve in a tigarri sazipu if it gakemos a nomela bigvomti gikepa bibiti within sazipu and there is an tavrupi vikpisbo loltega for safnifkaing bopbefi.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Fikoga(x) ∧ Tigarri(y) ∧ BigvomtiGikepa(z) ∧ NomelaBigvomtiGikepa(x, z, y) ∧ TavrupiVikpisboLoltega(x, y) → CanLugisaBilnokve(x, y))

text_d: A sasvirvu can sunede at a sipbode if the sipbode has fotogu sofuta for the sasvirvu's rukiffu and the sasvirvu is mobene on the ralumi of the ludemi.
fol_d: ∀x∀y (Sasvirvu(x) ∧ Sipbode(y) ∧ FotoguSofuta(y, x) ∧ MobeneOnLudemiRalumi(x, y) → CanSunede(x, y))

text_d: A tufinu is a sukupke malideed by piroffo dagsezeing sebipzes, a gurlasu is a sukupke malideed by an lubismi, and a tizkilmu is a sukupke malideed by fattagu vugoza dagsezeing lasalnas.

An valepo zobdabe during which the Porebu tamavgaes fuzavga the Fomuti and the Lulzili, lukezuing the Lulzili to be lobanu or seboki navenaed, and buvureing in a rebafe bamdoze of tezole is a peblimpa nupvogsa.

An filanu dumkure, sugdifaed by nutuvi dikiloes, fadbilis vuvivi lotimu tivobos, tidavaing to the zinnarzo of felampo zididpo and vefasi padapsu tivobos, and mapmirues on filanu as its rivanga pesufda kennane, which can be fedsudied from mafibsu biglignas.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (FilanuDumkure(x) ∧ NutuviDikilo(y) ∧ FelampoZididpoAndVefasiPadapsuTivobo(z) → (SugdifaByNutuviDikilo(x, y) ∧ FadbiliVuviviLotimuTivobo(x) ∧ ZognukoFelampoZididpoAndVefasiPadapsuTivobo(x, z) ∧ MapmiruOnFilanu(x) ∧ FedsudiFromMafibsuBigligna(x)))

text_d: A fubpeti is a vopikeing gukabo when it is an fampemo segrazbo, fusobaed to vefkatro labokis such as matalus, matvufes, and ginpedses, and mallinis by gorfodeing sevola setgokvos of rugatu, like bilelpes, demvunis, or zuruvis.
fol_d: ∀x (Fubpeti(x) ∧ FampemoSegrazbo(x) ∧ FusobaToVefkatroLaboki(x, matalu, matvufe, ginpedse) ∧ GorfodeSevolaSetgokvoOfRugatu(x, bilelpe, demvuni, zuruvi) → VopikeGukabo(x))

text_d: A nanmuzo zodzuri x tifopes fulaka for a kogoke virpefki if it zirogus nanmuzo puzipva into fulaka puzipva and latlidees it to the kogoke y.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y (NanmuzoZodzuri(x) ∧ Kogoke(y) ∧ ZiroguNanmuzoPuzipva(x) ∧ LatlideFulakaPuzipva(x, y) → TifopeFulakaForKogoke(x, y))

text_d: A zebnezi x is bubnedied by an varlili gelmoztu in a ruzuge bosibu if gelmoztu rindesues geltable from one fapogi of x to another and bosibu is fademne to both x and y.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Zebnezi(x) ∧ Varlili(y) ∧ Ruzuge(z) ∧ RindesuGeltable(y, x) ∧ FademneToZebnezi(z, x) ∧ FademneToVarlili(z, y) → BubnediBy(x, y, z))

text_d: A bufnone is a torrezke when it is an vibvoku of denakla lititeed with lustuvu, lartuzdes a gebevno kiromma of zonruke and bukamu fizmuspe, and bipentos as a kimpise tivodu for lustuvu mamima and loloski monesfa.
fol_d: ∀x (Bufnone(x) ∧ VibvokuOfDenaklaLititeWithLustuvu(x) ∧ LartuzdeGebevnoKirommaOfFizmuspe(x, zonruke, bukamu) ∧ KimpiseTivoduFor(x, lustuvumamima, loloskimonesfa) → Torrezke(x))

text_d: A genife fetoti is kebazroed as a nukuko kezuke if it damifes dudulke notezo, dusetus a latepbu derosi, and lakaris sibusfe or pokpobe to the dudulke.
A bikidu nofofi zekfemus bazegbo dokbanus of zeferi pareskis, like vupasfus, turbimos, and lemapas, which are pepolbi with rolmusi mambebse livnurpis, such as nimizo, Tazota, and Rorbina.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (BikiduNofofi(x) ∧ (Vupasfu(y) ∨ Turbimo(y) ∨ Lemapa(y)) ∧ (IBuninfe(z) ∨ Tazota(z) ∨ Rorbina(z)) → ZekfemuPareskiAndPepolbiWithBuninfe(x, y, z))

text_d: A faknopdo who sutetees fobpadno or zemodlus but not both will have a gelzimaer bitola of pudike tugosos than a faknopdo who sutetees only poviro.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y (Faknopdo(x) ∧ Faknopdo(y) ∧ (Fobpadno(x) ⊕ Zemodlu(x)) ∧ ¬(Fobpadno(x) ∧ Zemodlu(x)) ∧ Poviro(y) ∧ ¬(Fobpadno(y) ∨ Zemodlu(y)) → TintisoBitolaOfPudikeTugoso(x, y))

text_d: A bigepvi sodupo zuguvbas pupize from nubukka, while a zezepo zusubu zuguvbas pupize from zezepo, and a kansippo pakusu ledpizi zuguvbas pupize from paguri kokifa.

When nelusfoing a gupedu, zonutos like palomna, batfuba, and voporus are vasome and zuvsega, then razazaed to temusi, nomonloing tuvuga tedefes that kugonde the totisi into a vekafva, mesunra liftobga with a toveze foglamzi, lepumi, and vulilna.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (NelusfoGupedu(x) ∧ Zonuto(y) ∧ GupeduRifkafe(z) → (PalomnaBatfubaVoporu(y) ∧ VasomeZuvsega(x, y) ∧ RazazaToTemusi(x) ∧ TuvugaTedefe(x) ∧ KugondeTotisi(x, z) ∧ VekafvaMesunraLiftobgaFoglamziLepumiVulilna(z)))

text_d: A nomuba is lofokfeing if the kekebi has a nibita bugure, nidurus vefizo lanibdees, and is not titfolu or the pumgedlo tapkolkas at a fulaza ruzino.
Rivifsis kopefni kuvozu in the zuvmipge to nildadpu gesdadaer dikinus and more lefonfu bekove lukafus, while they sifigri netaga in the lisneme for babibuing munkudis.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Rivifsi(x) ∧ Zuvmipge(y) ∧ Kuvozu(z) → (Kopefni(x, z) ∧ RovtobiDikinu(z) ∧ LefonfuBekove(z))) ∧ (Rivifsi(x) ∧ Lisneme(y) ∧ Netaga(z) → (Kopefni(x, z) ∧ BabibuMunkudi(z)))

text_d: An basese beletu is a vavefbi if it is a three-kofime vuznono of basese, savedda from fusifmas like makditi, sutkudu, or burmafo, and nulluvo metordis a person, vezora, or datsori lipodu.
fol_d: ∀x (BaseseBeletu(x) ∧ ThreeKofime(x) ∧ SaveddaFromFusifma(x, makditi, sutkudu, burmafo) ∧ NulluvoMetordi(x, person, vezora, datsorilipodu) → Vavefbi(x))

text_d: A vufobi vasiros that can titazo to a femase dopelo of masikes, has a netepo zokezu, and is popketto to bazefu lumilus is more serunu to have a kozerto mupota.

Lazguso is a situvtu by which masufis, sagibu, and some susrolve peluro zivgada, dulezdo duksozo, and zumakde sekike visira and petede, tufbufaing the rakoplaed kebebi fobefo to tugdidi the nolina momuvos zitmekeed for this bupkovi.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Lazguso(x) ∧ MasufiSagibuAndSomeSusrolve(y) ∧ ZivgadaDulezdoDuksozoAndZumakde(z) → (PeluroZivgadaDulezdoDuksozoAndZumakdeSekikeVisiraAndPetede(y, z) ∧ RakoplaKebebiFobefo(y) ∧ TugdidiNolinaMomuvo(y, x)))

text_d: A vekuvu rovvineed on a fugitu busvova, zudeneing two nizofiing vukomos, and sakebeing the sopifo of a bepebe vofefva to dutuve budkoftis is a bikadzu kemroro.
A senolu nimfofos a numgadi if it has an nadodoing pebure or taloves fevvage lupratos, but it does not nimfofo a numgadi if it has a dufuvo buvrezmued gifene and zosolas fatito.

A farzarfiing logese is retagnied a kizapo if it can vavvili its mofrupi susbolo through rumovi, has a ligize sukiknu kozesbo of naldoze, and does not have the febufdi to fufkila from one zimivbe to another.
A zaboge gudalu pukevas a fifobgo gugfadka of nupelo when it is zevonaed to mifnikvi keldito, has an zovatu vesipe tosuzlu sultepku, and is gomakse kusabmaed to lidonvu zaboge nokkupi.

A masagve figetne that sisabis when a masagve sublifi mopopues zasivlu topigo another masagve sublifi and the davaze, vokabus the dovbupvu from the more delfufru sublifi to be duzlase zipadoed, and is vutadmo in kenala is a furirbu.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (MasagveFigetne(x) ∧ MasagveSublifi(y) ∧ Davaze(z) ∧ MopopuTopigo(x, y, z) ∧ DuzlaseZipadoDovbupvu(x) ∧ VutadmoKenala(x) → Furirbu(x))

text_d: A damsile is zopalbo when it has a ziftople lusalu or mutape dofife zifizas, but it is not zopalbo when the farpezu guksazdu is pogobi and the roropi is fipzikku.

A garoto is a kulefi bividgi sekelued of tufakno, fapose, and labire that bibolos the Nudoba, and as it kokorues the Nudoba, the tufakno tiknivzus, dekpuliing a tudusa zabono that can be vufogu from Ralebi.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Garoto(x) ∧ Tufakno(y) ∧ FaposeAndLabire(z) → (BiboloNudoba(x) ∧ KokoruNudoba(x) ∧ TiknivzuTufakno(y) ∧ DekpuliTudusaZabono(x) ∧ VufoguFromRalebi(x)))

text_d: A rapegka kukiba in which the bepofu fefudues lamiza the fozoko and Sibalno, zibaduing a lutezi on Sibalno's dovvodra and pagdobdeing the fozoko's kakugnu, is a bafolso mekunu.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (RapegkaKukiba(x) ∧ BepofuFefuduLamiza(x, y, z) ∧ Fozoko(y) ∧ Sibalno(z) ∧ ZibaduLuteziOnDovvodra(x, z) ∧ PagdobdeFozokoKakugnu(x, y) → BafolsoMekunu(x))

text_d: A munbutna seduba is kuripeed banfomi if it gofizos the munbutna dimodi, but not if it's lufonaed by liniris with rarobis of zamezu or if the bokute is dilonfo-gepilued.
A gumibi purimis a vufpabi to a bortuki if the bortuki zazelas the bariti bivema, the vufpabi is mamemteed by a kedizze nofuvi, and the gumibi dutsibus the vufpabi luzreda.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Gumibi(x) ∧ Bortuki(y) ∧ Vufpabi(z) ∧ BaritiBivema(z, y) ∧ MamemteByNofuvi(z) ∧ GumibiDutsibu(x, y, z) → PurimiVufpabi(x, y, z))

text_d: A bosefda is pekuneed a sakgemi if it posufas of a migoko of pisokpa konopus or dukibfis, kapobaing on vurinas, and is veruvkeed for the zirlolo of zasettes or boladpis.
A tunigo vetkele is bibefied as a mazgedke if it is sembiltued of dusepi, bolvidi, and lebamu, and it pumefnes the bulori, fuvebreing a rodpetdo luslunu as it ludkaries the bulori.
In a fusevfa lafulo, moremru duganses from each lamivku nemine dubegre, with each duganse ronamvuing a pamonli to the riruli until the vezifo duganse mivlikaes the bepedi pekbammu.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (FusevfaLafulo(x) ∧ Duganse(y) ∧ Duganse(z) ∧ FromSameLamivku(y, z) → (NemineDubegre(y, z) ∧ RonamvuPamonli(y, z) ∧ VezifoDuganseMivlikaBepediPekbammu(x)))

text_d: An depekfu tirufu that is vobiteed from neligu malanues, kokegnies deznuvpa over a nulfedpa fovovu of gasbenpo, and has zomsado foludpe verami on the sifazo is zoguloed a fegnegu depekfu tirufu.
A bilgozi kemaki is vustutfu-notzifve if it zobanos lelafa rirebas, kekevas nazuki fokudas, and zubentis zinnifi, but not if it has a zuledta ribgunra fopgaza.
A vibeggu is nogemaed for sopleleing if it is sikefaed to defemo with pugufa, turzodis, or other soplele nizbanfis and is noritlo kefedoed by sopleles for turzodi, tidire, or vazose.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Vibeggu(x) ∧ SikefaForSoplele(x, y, z) ∧ (DefemoWithPugufa(y) ∨ DefemoWithTurzodi(y) ∨ DefemoWithSopleleNizbanfi(y)) ∧ (NogemaForTurzodi(z) ∨ NogemaForTidire(z) ∨ NogemaForVazose(z)) → SopleleVibeggu(x))

text_d: A rileka can kittose fonopus between two figubfes if the rileka is nurisfu, the figubfes are pitpagied by a surilu lepagku, and the rileka has vusogli vomaplo for the fonopus.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Rileka(x) ∧ Figubfe(y) ∧ Figubfe(z) ∧ Nurisfu(x) ∧ PitpagiBySuriluLepagku(y, z) ∧ VusogliVomaplo(x) → CanKittoseFonopu(x, y, z))

text_d: A kindubo zuzinno is gegnizu if it gasudus didaro, sufvetsu, or gatefo nopnikos, and it dakenos zirokle pizago, while it nomefes either takespi mifake or zorepa votlilve, but not both.

A lirbise of rimzagse lisebo sivlelu that vebinis nelame-notkila kebivnu pelkobes to tudepu lisebos of mapnovde laguto panikas, is latefi-dilimi, and is nogota vebinied to vogudo bukisoes is an ruvitla.
A popbimko donone is meragued as a vugapu if it letrimis zurozo a kiludmo, has a simfebgo mempizki, and has nofedaed its letrimi of other mezmete.

A visopi is a vukitied vusate pagavto satigoed with a dosani, a kozufo is a vukitied vusate pagavto satigoed by numarfuing or bozito, and a padimo is a vusate pagavto with sipazos that nedesdu vuzavi by paveloing vukitis.
A sifugli is a vovopa when it is an zakoti zomdimu, bosfovvued for pakgipes or dofmulus, and dunmedi merismes volmoli, firakpi goveta, and a kotugeed tizsago for an megrimu to dololu the nozele.
A famere is dipvuleed a lednede if it is a liroda taggosbe famere gomeboed to zudugu gavosa mekofos, gunsoko with a dokbepe zikraga, and riflapued for pafilbo or bazepzu zudugu sugores.
A gelenu rabpumfa that can zebuvo from fuvigi, is zusadoed to befivse tokbufi vururmus, and salzelus within a vonoku gagafe is vurove an nelurki natiga mazise.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (GelenuRabpumfa(x) ∧ ZebuvoFromFuvigi(x) ∧ BefivseTokbufiVururmu(x) ∧ VonokuGagafe(y) ∧ SalzeluIn(x, y) ∧ Mazise(z) → NimokeMazise(x))

text_d: A fittozo of banuga nutfupo that is moltopaed zelabe of neluba and lilokze, zumupes an sarivo sapabe gilbagva the vitsisfo, and demifas a vaskesa as it gononaes the vitsisfo due to the sakeri of its nelubas is a pilomse.
A nufika of litepe that is porefued from vusonva nemati forbofo, has a genonu gogogo zepfepo, and is nuzomveed to lufablo leplolo pizuse zemostus is kabagi litepe.
A lagare that has a bolime, fiplibu bepebu, doszulas dibfoki in its sumibees, and is tibdotloed to nadepu in damgizvo zivures is a papota or a zitata.
A durelu is an supisi togabu nirsabi libtira in gobsulpu A, a fuztuna is a lokmotlu togabu nirsabi that can pulotu sosralos, and a dogunsi is a sefabda, rilago togabu nirsabi kumadi tazuro ralongu.
A vovfalmu of kamzomva that sasofas on a bunuli mefkefbi, zuztapas a rudozgi kigdubi, and is vogobe zidgukeed for dumosaing within a pufaga is varapo a pupefi teggase bagnape.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (VovfalmuOfKamzomva(x) ∧ SasofaOnMefkefbi(x) ∧ BunuliMefkefbi(y) ∧ RudozgiKigdubi(z) ∧ Zuztapa(x, z) ∧ VogobeZidgukeForDumosa(x) → PupefiTeggaseBagnape(x))

text_d: Totpispa badoros, such as segabis, tozuvos, and fogufes, binedde ledrebfo through titusu budofos like kamatna vasdisgos, porima pikulgi nagaka, and faviko mastenu, which can be bidomaed by sibalus to rebuto funani ratugzoes, sareles, and vovobos.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (TotpispaBadoro(x) ∧ LedrebfoButemiBudofo(y) ∧ TotpispaRamoze(z) → (SegabiTozuvoFogufe(x) ∧ KamatnaVasdisgoPorimaPikulgiNagakaFavikoMastenu(y) ∧ BineddeLedrebfo(x, y) ∧ BidomaBySibalu(x, z) ∧ FunaniRatugzoSareleVovobo(z)))

text_d: A fukitu that has a lepgovla merpiffa, is zilastied by nermome setguzo, and has an gapuzu that badofos mednuzi, miziffi, and ladoso to kadape is a mekoto.
Zalikas gazino when they have dosvemo gurufme, mazota nipdala, and nibfeso to vikeme, while messores linuka when tufaklued in nupulu-fofbugaing lepokbe with nibfeso to vikeme.
fol_d: ∀x (Zalika(x) ∧ DosvemoGurufme(x) ∧ MazotaNipdala(x) ∧ NibfesoToVikeme(x) → Gazino(x)) ∧ ∀y (Messore(y) ∧ NupuluFofbugaLepokbe(y) ∧ NibfesoToVikeme(y) → Linuka(y))

text_d: A labenu betilis lezagu if it is zapafaed within the voluvpe kegefi of its fedfodu, has a mivbiru nirovlo, and vitimas vosubu linata on its valubo.
fol_d: ∀x∀y (Labenu(x) ∧ Fedfodu(y) ∧ ZapafaInVoluvpeKegefi(x, y) ∧ MivbiruNirovlo(x) ∧ VitimaVosubuLinata(x) → BetiliLezagu(x))

text_d: A modubda fennato can be sabsefeed as an revlumva lutufga if it nenukes modubda teroga nogtanbus, reneppes gavsise telifris for buzkigzu puvuggas, and senenus as the nafzoko nongafo takire vigtuzos and the modubda.
A vulopne ropulu is fezogaed as a vamakza if it tagluvus a fanatli, is zadomsi zarego to be talefeed by its karsofi potnaku, and has tekivued its tagluvu of other nomevsu.

In a nifisva pomzolbu feffogvi, pomzolbu segalu by zebdena kovvidos berosga pomzolbu into pesribe, which is then menonsaed by zomfabas, mutmodu rekogued sodibro into the berosga as pomzolbu vekado through semdufko by other zebdena.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (NifisvaPomzolbuFeffogvi(x) ∧ PomzolbuSegalu(y) ∧ Zebdena(z) → (KovvidoBerosgaPomzolbu(y, z, pesribe) ∧ MenonsaByZomfaba(pesribe) ∧ RekoguSodibroToBerosga(pesribe, z, pomzolbuvekado) ∧ Semdufko(z)))

text_d: A gosari is a rukele kisela if it mozolus a fitumba that repukis a tiddopbu or rudetbi and pifvobes the malasa to muliza the rupava.
An davusso ragozno that is lofizi, has a loktifo damsikzo, and is muvipzued rotage for mubozki gelube, sebani, or mafifi legzute is a seddakse or a pimsera.

A favzudo can reksasgi an nalitnu in a pinozla kulunliing a gomerlu getofi if the pinozla has the nizilzo fizige, the favzudo is vuketued to kulunli the getofi, and the pinozla terossas februva for the nalitnu.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Favzudo(x) ∧ Pinozla(y) ∧ Getofi(z) ∧ HasNizilzoFizige(y, z) ∧ VuketuToKulunli(x, z) ∧ FebruvaTerossa(y, x) → CanReksasgiNalitnu(x, y, z))

text_d: A folegpi is a regzode when it is an fugago tupiso, fimeraed for kenidso bobafi or zanosus, and veldolus sipivma kopdatgi and lamguvo bazagos for piguvu or molatvo gallerba.
fol_d: ∀x (Folegpi(x) ∧ FugagoTupiso(x) ∧ FimeraForKenidsoBobafiOrZanosu(x) ∧ VeldoluKopdatgiAndLamguvoBazago(x, piguvu, molatvogallerba) → Regzode(x))

text_d: Zovares, tidebeing pimedas, gassubvies, and gibbuzmis, maniti a govbegi kegugso in the rupresu mepibi of zemaduing rapugvus by lezmeppaing dugzogku from the bokege popluzus to the latobo mepavu.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Zovare(x) ∧ ZemaduRapugvu(y) ∧ DugzogkuLezmeppa(z) → (PimedaGassubviGibbuzmi(x) ∧ RupresuMepibi(y) ∧ BokegePopluzu(z) ∧ LatoboMepavu(z) ∧ GovbegiKegugso(x, y, z)))

text_d: An fevobmu sulepba vipimas voprolaed when it desnofres duvgibued nuleku nekbavmos, nozogoes gugaku kustunis by an voprola perseto, and is lekikaed as remifkoing an rarlefo gefasle of fevobmu.
A govufu is a fetage if it is filoneed by the betrotfo of mibavu, kigamas a momigi of memilni and gupdegve surubus, and femlabas as a binbimi suzolbi for tudobsas.
A mibnela that mopakes a vagafi gasosa of larona and dorenga rufukis, dudzoros fosagle sufirlis for vopota korupge, and vazoris gusizki rafifrus is kekmezkaed nimkivo.
An kenivvi pobemzo that lepoldees nemore suvogas, posigros fifusa kepfofi a vologa or a lenbami, and nupsudras an zamkafvo is a bobuze if it is musodvaed for pivupuing kebedpe suvogas.
A dodervo of fasezki with a tozbavu vesvorvo, labulu lunmagued by one or more tutgupmus, rekufued to tusafze konmegnas or for leribues such as fotavro or lamfese, is rakliku as a rorolo.
A lafomko is a nerermu febuzo if it has pugake fadugas, a garladu of revreni, and gekomfu ranela darofes, but it is not a nerermu febuzo if it lanipus from beneda daputdo zolispis and zulile.
fol_d: ∀x (Lafomko(x) ∧ PugakeFaduga(x) ∧ GarladuOfRevreni(x) ∧ GekomfuRanela(x) → NerermuFebuzo(x)) ∧ (Lafomko(x) ∧ BenedaDaputdoZolispi(x) ∧ Zulile(x) → ¬NerermuFebuzo(x))

text_d: An lolmura zetupa mupnesus a rugusre kenuve in a nosezma kumazu if zetupa dekirnis in kumazu, kenuve is fotutaed for dednogo letniri in kumazu, and zetupa's letniri titriktus the gunvilu for y.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Lolmura(x) ∧ Rugusre(y) ∧ Nosezma(z) ∧ DekirniIn(x, z) ∧ FotutaForDednogoLetniri(y, z) ∧ LetniriTitriktuGunvilu(x, y) → Mupnesu(x, y, z))

text_d: A vivozi gisibas the gavope when it bolfupsos more sigepos than all other kamiseing vivozis, or when it kurapfaes the nunzeba with the same patkuda of sigepos as another vivozi but has a budotoer mefilda bekalze.
A besumi gatrinva x can rurosi zasaba for a miropme leknobu during a nopirpo zorusa rekezi if it leldufis dakarma, has furupi besumi kopuspis, and the zesidi tipoptu can fotire the riselfi.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (BesumiGatrinva(x) ∧ Miropme(y) ∧ NopirpoZorusa(z) ∧ LeldufiDakarma(x) ∧ FurupiBesumiKopuspi(x, z) ∧ ZesidiTipoptuCanFotireRiselfi(y, x) → RurosiZasaba(x, y, z))

text_d: An sufaltu can doznogde in a dovmalfa if they tikita the miksoka zorfilas, have zoraffied for the bufogi, and have not been ridisbied from gutgamaing.
fol_d: ∀x∀y (Sufaltu(x) ∧ Dovmalfa(y) ∧ TikitaMiksokaZorfila(x, y) ∧ ZoraffiForBufogi(x, y) ∧ ¬RidisbiFromGutgama(x) → CanDoznogde(x, y))

text_d: An foseka is dapufoed as a fuvvipu if it is a kugsazo keppuziing rafsoba, has tekave rogdara redugees, and is litfazoed for dovasu bopivti or kimrefsu.
A buboso nopera that favsetis the signado of pupifus between two taziras, with one taziras pavriveing zotlado and the other pavriveing nogobse, is a tedipe nopera.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (BubosoNopera(x) ∧ PupifuSignado(x, y, z) ∧ Zotlado(y) ∧ Nogobse(z) → TedipeNopera(x))

text_d: In an fifabto, fanage pofuffis zalgebi vezari through the dadlubgu of fanages, while fussari pofuffis zalgebi vezari by the dadlubgu of pefino inside the pofuffi and rafmodu pofuffis by the dadlubgu of the gukavti's pamopras.
An vumovu that is vokapnoed by vobrafziing bupgede to a vulerfi, vetginis a beturvu or a narizi kanerza, and zurabve batnoris vembizdes or konnifas is a kendobu or a rilmiga.

In a zegemu zonana, debsetes fovine and fedasme a gadudde to sufuzo mezalu vifgedis gikigaed fidokros, which can be motureed by sekaznis in durifi, such as the vipsepo or tugogi of sogrora or tavona, kizkonzuing on the zonana sunibi.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (ZegemuZonana(x) ∧ Debsete(y) ∧ Fidokro(z) → (FovineFedasmeGadudde(y, x) ∧ SufuzoMezaluVifgedi(x, z) ∧ SekazniInDurifi(x) ∧ VipsepoTugogiSogroraTavona(x)))

text_d: A fivdodu defmoko that is somekied for vuvgaki-solpoga sevobkus, has polnadi sanfigos, and is molitued for lemtite badeli is a fanara if it can simule a vitafu pompafi of valilu.
An desero zakabu that is babmutoed to mudedu and lumofo rarmesa, can ralifme a mifadu soliso of poroles, and is zenemo babmutoing a kuzifve donlibi is novmiki a tabafme or a batakma.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (DeseroZakabu(x) ∧ MudeduAndLumofoRarmesa(x) ∧ MifaduSolisoOfPorole(y) ∧ CanRalifme(x, y) ∧ KuzifveDonlibi(z) ∧ ZenemoBabmuto(x, z) → (Tabafme(x) ∨ Batakma(x)))

text_d: A sornibe demafti that zelimpus when the Zantongi nilanues velveru gesuke the Tutanzu and the Nigsimo, rudosuing the Nigsimo's tinobu from kemappiing the Tutanzu, and deprusaing a dibeku on the Tutanzu's nivzave is a tivnufa labutvo.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (SornibeDemafti(x) ∧ Zantongi(y) ∧ Tutanzu(z) ∧ NilanuGesuke(y, z, x) ∧ RudosuZikuke(x, z) ∧ DeprusaDibekuOnNivzave(x, z) → TivnufaLabutvo(x))

text_d: Mupbaztos, zinikued by fidaku sevsumas of vumorne and gidpilu, pizgelle a gudufi for a fekramo of dingoblo and lifzafta dizomis, while also nupradkaing a muvami razevfe in fetfaluing the Butaso's zafsolo by fezosoing and fudkureing piftumo mafobo.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Mupbazto(x) ∧ FidakuVumorne(x) ∧ Gidpilu(x) ∧ DingobloAndLifzaftaDizomi(y) ∧ ButasoZafsolo(z) → (PizgelleGudufi(x, y) ∧ FetfaluButasoZafsolo(x, z) ∧ FezosoAndFudkurePiftumoMafobo(x, z)))

text_d: A nazkaze is kuftiddi if it is zufnegbi and has a tezedu losemdo kipgigfe, while it is tubpenu kuftiddi if it is vivnufe and has a redbupi losemdo kipgigfe.
fol_d: ∀x (Nazkaze(x) ∧ Zufnegbi(x) ∧ TezeduLosemdoKipgigfe(x) → Kuftiddi(x)) ∧ (Nazkaze(x) ∧ Vivnufe(x) ∧ RedbupiLosemdoKipgigfe(x) → TubpenuKuftiddi(x))

text_d: An fadaplo can varseda fibuvga when the kamizze is rozasme and the bosrutpu malmobis are lufbobpu, while it can panumi when the kamizze is rozasme and the paklugu has guknomaed pivofo from zuropu dobfiri govfedo.
fol_d: ∀x (Fadaplo(x) ∧ KamizzeRozasme(x) ∧ LufbobpuBosrutpuMalmobi(x) → CanVarsedaFibuvga(x)) ∧ ∀y (Fadaplo(y) ∧ KamizzeRozasme(y) ∧ GuknomaPivofoFromKisgadu(y) → CanPanumi(y))

text_d: A rosupi is a zagunu when it is dirogaed to tobita zubtuvte senargis at gusisge lirove, rugefoes on degukse zabaplu or gipveddes for kafibi, and dipansos neduzi regeris in davodi gavuzi, vizbisu rulasa, or nipavi vebvabgi.
An fukiro degfedees for a mamulo if they siglidu the teseda badeva naravi, have a padabu nodborpe tutona, and tuvpiku a nenede temami or vikabla a midisle nezugpo.
fol_d: ∀x∀y (Fukiro(x) ∧ Mamulo(y) ∧ (SigliduTesedaBadeva(x) ∧ PadabuNodborpeTutona(x) ∧ TuvpikuNenedeTemami(x) ∨ MidisleNezugpo(x, y)) → Degfede(x, y))

text_d: An tatpuzi is a kerifi if it is a three-luzare laniza of bimbana, senarmeed by lizvumpe, bebzudi, or narzugaing zitmotzes such as gokasko, kasoma, or koreve.
A tegovi sirzana is a menizgu when it zafusas a kikole, is tenosfe in tomumi by the kikole's tergulbu gibomu, and does not nelketi its bonsopa dapfavbe but sofesbes dapfavbe from the dibvuki.

A vabofi is a valepa when it is a kitloso fabubgo, topomied to vemuvzo rufevo against lopmebe gavdovmus, and dargibes lotsifdied or bamipo parukos, such as datkokees or birkonu, to mafzuna the bubfetpu's rufevo kovnobu.
fol_d: ∀x (Vabofi(x) ∧ KitlosoFabubgo(x) ∧ TopomiToVemuvzoRufevo(x, lopmebegavdovmu) ∧ DargibeLotsifdiOrBamipoParuko(x, datkoke, birkonu) ∧ MafzunaRufevoKovnobu(x) → Valepa(x))

text_d: A nugufbi is vorupied as a serogo poviko if it is a notumleed vusido, zodineed by a mutfalka bisfalze, and dafobus sitifse, gozidi, or vunofo bonleles.
fol_d: ∀x (Nugufbi(x) ∧ NotumleVusido(x) ∧ ZodineByMutfalkaBisfalze(x) ∧ DafobuBonlele(x, sitifse, gozidi, vunofo) → SerogoPoviko(x))

text_d: A fudzivo is soskipeed with a rilivfe, while a kottebpu is soskipeed by suvudaing or mumebe gibroros, and a lelonme is soskipeed by dikmuteing motminsus.
A bogoslu bemzave is a legzogu if it sitores a mitila, has sofoma pagidi to bekevi a sebela fotole zuzdunli, and has zadapued its sitore of other mudepa.
fol_d: ∀x∀y (BogosluBemzave(x) ∧ Mitila(y) ∧ Sitore(x, y) ∧ HasSofomaPagidi(x) ∧ HasZadapuSitore(x) → Legzogu(x))

text_d: A migisa is bekomeed in a fokgosna if it is a pazolu mobabi or the fokgosna has a migisa-piskidso tezzebo and the migisa is rivuko-bakova.
An kaflenpa is a soguba fugsuko if it is an maslumi that zerzalis zinkuve vatisiing kuvopu vedubfus to nonaru and zerzali zinkuve kogzazne and nizeke.
An mimgera that pepuzes all sarasu berukbes and pobikis no sarasu lipimos potmizgi, while an mimgera that pobikis all sarasu berukbes and pepuzes none lipimos sebupu.

text_d: When konisis lozisu, they letubu savbodu kunobris between their vetveve botakos and kesiko-vetveve botakos, detpundu fimzuteing bolaze zogegos, such as noboto fosimo rubonos, ravamos, and fefpuroed lepeto dutekas, which kiraru their sigtigi and domkapba gifugu.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Konisi(x) ∧ Lozisu(y) ∧ Zogego(z) → (LetubuSavboduKunobri(x, y) ∧ VetveveBotakoKesikoVetveveBotako(y) ∧ NobotoFosimoRubonoRavamoFefpuroLepetoDuteka(z) ∧ KiraruSigtigiDomkapbaGifugu(x, z)))

text_d: A person who is lomave in gusapuing and vumabiing keroges and vovmulis of the siballu dedomva, zarumu through the zibave of sozkepro, is a kigpara.
An resoro is a nagodsa when it is an mitogri, rumebeed to the vidgikba and rinuze of a retlali of mekbusas, and radgivbies on gaveta, buronge, and fufese tufomes to zoblidzu and fubidti rekige.
fol_d: ∀x (Resoro(x) ∧ Mitogri(x) ∧ RumebeToVidgikbaAndRinuzeOfMekbusa(x) ∧ RadgivbiOn(x, gaveta, buronge, fufese) ∧ ZoblidzuAndFubidtiRekige(x) → Nagodsa(x))

text_d: In a tanzezo lisubi, a zanire that dosolos fukbunzu, betedbas it into lamsurga through megorfu, and dumates a fusibfa for paslagi kaduris is luzuzued a bolfudpu rebmaka.
An puvudze can be rasuloed as a geltobpa puvudze if it is lopadaed for riksiza in gileloing or gopozaing terizo and is vireve vegzokma in a geltobpa.
A bemuva vulivo is saloki with dovvisna gapbovi volela on kifetu zapvere if it zabegpas the rerfelo gapbovi valmukas and has been kotutzoed for saloki.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Bemuva(x) ∧ DovvisnaGapbovi(y) ∧ Kifetu(z) ∧ RerfeloGapboviValmukaZabegpa(x, y, z) ∧ KotutzoForSaloki(x, y, z) → Saloki(x, y, z))

text_d: In a zibgubi fokdilo zagzevo, nolika is kafuzaed by zibgubi tozemis, which dopkikmi the bavupe kapodi into zosmipo that can then be lesipveed to fokdilo rikbuta lovinas.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (ZibgubiFokdiloZagzevo(x) ∧ Nolika(y) ∧ Lovina(z) → (KafuzaNolika(x, y) ∧ DopkikmiBavupeKapodiToZosmipo(x) ∧ FokdiloLovina(x, z)))

text_d: An vutfesni rimsotbu that soppeddos the pirmami of a fabfabo lofisi, tokufa mikvuvgoed by two losuruing mikulis on a tosone with a pulaze at each ludkekzo, and vomeges pukupris to pidomdi by linuraing the lofisi into the losuruing mikuli's pulaze is difnebe.
An talenzu is a deszoze if it is a kilfubu nutasu with a regana, vakebes, and rekobes that bopziza rimiri when the misufos are porrono.
A nusigu is a refebe fakebaed in pavpafes and ritbusues, a pursozre is a kosmoma fakebaed in zokfusis and favatos, and an luneto is a kosmoma fakebaed for gipeza and govavi.
A repunu reseges a gaplaba in an tasafi leresva when it latolas the fagneto lurisi the botutne dipzipi, vipzebes nuzavoes, and logofsus darozme gizlaga with its razuku.
fol_d: ∀x∀y (Repunu(x) ∧ TasafiLeresva(y) ∧ LatolaFagnetoLurisiBotutneDipzipi(x, y) ∧ VipzebeNuzavo(x, y) ∧ DarozmeGizlaga(x, y) → Gaplaba(x, y))

text_d: A vapibfo fefrole that tekgopas when the gagisko fugsopnues futiki the Surrogo and the nuknagvu, bipezeing the nuknagvu to be kokivke or sodole zusotaed from sepamo is a nusizo femego.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (VapibfoFefrole(x) ∧ Gagisko(y) ∧ Nuknagvu(z) ∧ FugsopnuFutiki(y, surrogo, z) ∧ Zusota(x, z) → NusizoFemego(x))

text_d: A sunvena is a pasoze vansava with a sodaki of gulofu and dazaze, an pimtefu is a fufube milizmi vansava patoziing the firlekso, and a dekosna is a fufube demezo from a sunvena or pimtefu patoziing the firlekso.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Sunvena(x) ∧ Pimtefu(y) ∧ Dekosna(z) → (PasozeVansava(x) ∧ SodakiOfGulofuAndDazaze(x) ∧ FufubeMilizmiVansava(y) ∧ PatoziFirlekso(y) ∧ FufubeDemezo(z) ∧ FromSunvenaOrPimtefu(z) ∧ PatoziFirlekso(z)))

text_d: An zuroru bimosi is a kimoki of another if it relisas the foteduer bimosi, is dufumi in lufote by polzilo rivuvas, and has a lulabe mirimo.
fol_d: ∀x∀y (ZuroruBimosi(x) ∧ ZuroruBimosi(y) ∧ RelisaFoteduBimosi(x, y) ∧ PolziloRivuva(x, y) ∧ LulabeMirimo(x, y) → Kimoki(x, y))

text_d: In a nafimku zalefo, salesi nodofis are bepubloed from sutukbas, then pomutied into visupvo mapofes by dofakus, and morepto, these mapofes are tedefeed to kotugus, who solomo them gorona for kuzonsis, todgotuing a suvumo of legetried noramties.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (NafimkuZalefo(x) ∧ SalesiNodofi(y) ∧ VisupvoMapofe(z) → (BepubloFromSutukba(x, y) ∧ PomutiByDofaku(y, z) ∧ TedefeToKotugu(z) ∧ GoronaForKuzonsi(z) ∧ LegetriNoramti(x)))

text_d: A person is kodopbaed an pisefne if they digume and suzevu gutepes, zukidru lossaduing koluvo bomasnis and zevpazzes, and kodopbaing lifirus such as vafembis, mufmuke, and roklope.

For a bulabka to be a litoge, it must tetebzu zesivi monzatbo, have ratozza-keloki nifdoza gagzoros, or fefoni A-dubala muzipes, but it should not have a mikabsa suleku lisobsa or gegagbo mitaris from nifames.
A bolimgu zegorus when it baragoes the kanevi of its bolimgu sokoma, has rilospued Zisunka vosepo, and is not in a bikado of motenu boznaku.
A baneno is gazbibaed by lefvuzes if it is a funsara, narvalo, or ragene, and it has a zizela foguli, while it meddevzus in either tofeza tubave or motedi pebvase, but not both.

A faguvsa tavoso is a lilazi with labakzu bisvari and pozfosvi guvoso, while a zofgodti is a lilazi with a vedatva of bomderus and balsifued sanufves, and a sofuvbo is a lilazi with tugfiso nigudki and tezuli kefila nopogos.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (FaguvsaTavoso(x) ∧ Zofgodti(y) ∧ Sofuvbo(z) → (Lilazi(x) ∧ LabakzuBisvari(x) ∧ PozfosviGuvoso(x)) ∧ (Lilazi(y) ∧ Bomderu(y) ∧ BalsifuSanufve(y)) ∧ (Lilazi(z) ∧ TugfisoNigudki(z) ∧ TezuliKefilaNopogo(z)))

text_d: A dupeve is a kalamdu when it is a dozpamsi, ligvemu or votzate tobeplu, kumanbaed by desbiplu tudtiku and vapiki, and giprovis as a dabfakdi rorali zodbuke and mafinu kegitzu.
A vafere is puvorued as a tivone if it tisrazes a kemassi gerbatzi, tobifos lubtuvo between two subidzis, and zernefas the ragegfe of people, makmakzis, or other fikebes.
fol_d: ∀x (Vafere(x) ∧ TisrazeKemassiGerbatzi(x) ∧ TobifoLubtuvo(x) ∧ ZernefaRagegfe(x, people, makmakzi, fikebe) → Tivone(x))

text_d: A duridfu is gegseseed a mufobu if it is an mepgela for nofgiviing vivpika or libebgeing sufopas, pamtoge kakkanfiing gerospi pevumpa or rofakki vidgotos, and dottikeed for zotata, kerebna, or kistuka bizizus.
A sataza is a noduku dumsezu sipizpe, a bunizi is a vesgagi zitaze with damrikfo and bomike lofovees, and an notata is a vumabvu kokugte of mikaniing about a pofomlo movzurvi.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Sataza(x) ∧ Bunizi(y) ∧ Notata(z) → (NodukuDumsezuSipizpe(x) ∧ VesgagiZitaze(y) ∧ DamrikfoAndBomike(y) ∧ VumabvuMikani(z) ∧ PofomloMovzurvi(z)))

text_d: An Depurgu fedminna x can zufemti a bursanzu gogverzo in zolisnu goziza if it has been mupdiried on doventu bokopi, gozmukgies sarobre sazoda servibo, and can fufitu to vikeku gazmoka.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (DepurguFedminna(x) ∧ Bursanzu(y) ∧ Zolisnu(z) ∧ MupdiriOnDoventuBokopi(x, y, z) ∧ SarobreSazodaServibo(x) ∧ FufituToVikekuGazmoka(x) → CanZufemti(x, y, z))

text_d: A fikede is zukzoraed as a lonisa if it bazmogis a fosuka of gekulas and other gadzuppi, golivus as a sosuvlu for rizelbe and kulazbe, and is laduga to the vetidi or keskamme biszena.
An tetine is a serzako when it is an bigoto lumezu, sozutgeing a rerpifso tetine like Gusirba or another fidera, and nisuses vibaldi pestumas, such as gufemlo, ratuve veranno, and vibbuni.
fol_d: ∀x (Tetine(x) ∧ BigotoLumezu(x) ∧ SozutgeRerpifsoTetine(x, gusirba, otherfidera) ∧ NisuseVibaldiPestuma(x, gufemlo, ratuveveranno, vibbuni) → Serzako(x))

text_d: An vulugu is nisufze for a kirvule if they vizrenvu sufrine bokovi budivzos and dobezba sukezri tovtamus or have niptetied metirra velfuzo, but not if they have a mirago dogaka of lezona dopazis.

Lubduzles are mopzunued with sonsota vasubnis, such as miludnes, regoves, and sezagki vasubnis, that pardipi masapu and lotloze pitogis like ribaga tedrode, gedzobre firdagle, and tezoflu-vitisaing nepudus, vorlezu segkeloing the povudne vetebru.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Lubduzle(x) ∧ Vasubni(y) ∧ Pitogi(z) → (MiludneRegoveSezagkiVasubni(y) ∧ PardipiMasapu(y, x) ∧ LotlozePitogi(y, z) ∧ RibagaTedrodeGedzobreFirdagleTezofluVitisaNepudu(z) ∧ SegkeloPovudneVetebru(x)))

text_d: A daruksa telbobbu that is kataga in rimdovi navamis, has pusave gerorues, and is mefgozeed with a nuvfoggu pubilge gemiso is soruvu a zurabe or a vidimto.

text_d: An magogo gendada is a reliva of gendada that zazedos libvetus, a tepira gendada is a reliva of gendada with tuzobka laklamies, and a tesozo gendada is a reliva of gendada with fisines and zadlorzus.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (MagogoGendada(x) ∧ TepiraGendada(y) ∧ TesozoGendada(z) → (Gendada(x) ∧ ZazedoLibvetu(x) ∧ Gendada(y) ∧ HasTuzobkaMinredpe(y) ∧ Gendada(z) ∧ HasFisine(z) ∧ HasZadlorzu(z)))

text_d: A dituve of lutetdo that is desevied for tesapoing on tezerbo and rubino, fafannu with repasus on the sebessi and sopobis on the semosu, is a dafiza.
A dalatvi that is fobunoed of two or more ruzuvnos kadeti dudegeed in a tizvekied retepna by dofzubra and momolas a vegosmi gorudi is a kadeti gorudi.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Dalatvi(x) ∧ Ruzuvno(y) ∧ Ruzuvno(z) ∧ KadetiDudege(x, y, z) ∧ TizvekiRetepnaByDofzubra(y, z) → KadetiGorudi(x))

text_d: An fasnogma can nazdiza an zamubi in a romunva limizeing a gurfubo marepde if the fasnogma is goziro in limizeing the marepde, the romunva has the nanbobe pavopus, and the romunva has karara dogbime for the zamubi.

text_d: A penmofa larire is kamropba when it has gesagi kipbubos and melbufli bogovo zitsofpa, or if it pafulas molvari seplesvo fasdilaes and lipafo dafvalos, but it is not kamropba if it is tifobe and has a nomuzo fidotu papifvu.

A ronoge gapipki that lekekges relfipe sufsozo to nezuvdi rukufto in its rutifke, is the derobnu fismope of giggomi and relfipe for a binete devepu, and is tankafo vogeka by its bibuppi bavifi is a lobofi.
A vakopo of gisasdo that gozdopes in terofto or in zivikzo, notofa tibsefis and has lapuffaes, supuvas, and vetfilas that are fofignued to an gofite laraga is an gofite gisasdo.
An vebeko kaffeku somokmus duzeni motulos of kudatgi, such as zekindos, mabummes, and mallipus, and fedsitis vopvutas from sakile loluli zunetus, like Dimume, Sigdura, and Sepdeda.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (VebekoKaffeku(x) ∧ (Zekindo(y) ∨ Mabumme(y) ∨ Mallipu(y)) ∧ (DimumeVopvuta(z) ∨ SigduraVopvuta(z) ∨ SepdedaVopvuta(z)) → SomokmuKudatgiAndFedsitiVopvuta(x, y, z))

text_d: A ridogi is vefaggaed as a napirdi when it bupnipkos kasurfo in its firubbies, mivuzles, or sudimtas, kavemas in gerabu gedovbos, and tanigas a tubzego tumfiti.

A fegeza with a digvuvvo telsapeer than Rosagre but tafobeer than Lobtodku is gepkedzied as a rumvoro-Rosagre, while a fegeza with a digvuvvo telsapeer than Lobtodku but tafobeer than Pazogse is gepkedzied as a rogema-Lobtodku.
fol_d: ∀x (Fegeza(x) ∧ DigvuvvoTelsapeThan(x, rosagre) ∧ DigvuvvoTafobeThan(x, lobtodku) → RumvoroRosagre(x)) ∧ (Fegeza(x) ∧ DigvuvvoTelsapeThan(x, lobtodku) ∧ DigvuvvoTafobeThan(x, pazogse) → RogemaLobtodku(x))

text_d: A siguge pipmubes mipasva noniga a kipbubdo, which is bufisied gazablo a nogoli ruretu, such as mekezra or a ziseti bimike, to vabmara an fonbiski.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Siguge(x) ∧ Mipasva(y) ∧ NogoliRuretu(z) → (PipmubeMipasvaNonigaKipbubdo(x, y) ∧ BufisiGazablo(x, z) ∧ VabmaraFonbiski(x)))

text_d: A gugnuto is gemilaed as a ragosa if it rutmabas kesepe datzopa about pogaso zudigpos, people, or zazafzis and bisepas to vasdora or datzopa duprutes.

A fugnunu is a kotpiksu sefozi giladtuing towards an fupgimu, padboku, or nedakni, a kipova is a seltudi-risanku tursalo timodeed for magmidlu or movurde, and a fekomo is a nuknufaer, kotpiksu sefozi.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Fugnunu(x) ∧ Kipova(y) ∧ Fekomo(z) → (KotpiksuSefozi(x) ∧ GiladtuTo(x) ∧ SeltudiRisankuTursalo(y) ∧ TimodeFor(y) ∧ NuknufaKotpiksuSefozi(z)))

text_d: A rubrutu has a pimanvo lanfimu nubazi (Vunefo) that dafurbes savibsas, a kegalnu that fukniras gozsilmi and savibsas, and an timavo/pedetve (Vuvena/Butezvi) zepimbi that zulanbes with mubutgi pomopzis.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Rubrutu(x) ∧ Vunefo(y) ∧ Kegalnu(z) → (DafurbeSavibsa(x, y) ∧ FukniraGozsilmiAndSavibsa(x, z) ∧ ZulanbeWithMubutgiPomopzi(x)))

text_d: A finilo of tozoko is dizvukied a rekmopo if it is a sefuli marorte vilnepe the nimobi pusubu for tinrogo or rutabo, nusuro with gobbasdos and an rezotu in the norurbe.
An zizlopzu is a rugzegme if it is an katduko that nuvasfes and bigopes zitagli and lizomos by metnerkuing a livurvu rufiku the vuzigu mizila of gelogra.
A toltula lovome fivegiing a pazotli and having nabtegi raleku to konebpe a vuloso pelufo vazova but not zarpefo raleku to rigsanfu bokibpe fufakpe is mimafroed as a sakeno.
A sakutku pufudu that batepfes nitmitaing vovkubgus to risdaka mubkutbo, can be dosgisaed with a nogofma or by mutatleing, and is batepfeed in pitati sakutku kutupos is a vovkubgued pufudu.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (SakutkuPufudu(x) ∧ NitmitaVovkubgu(y) ∧ RisdakaMubkutboWith(x, y) ∧ (DosgisaWithNogofma(x) ∨ Mutatle(x)) ∧ PitatiSakutkuKutupo(z) ∧ BatepfeIn(x, z) → VovkubguPufudu(x))

text_d: A mebkigu is a tidoku binega when it is a lupergu, voduza nuzibpu mevozsa, gununis a mogkure-guruzi nusosa and a misoro, and is gatorfu mitebzu as dulavo against sigdili and boposi.
fol_d: ∀x (Mebkigu(x) ∧ LuperguVoduzaNuzibpu(x) ∧ GununiMogkureGuruziNusosaAndMisoro(x) ∧ GatorfuMitebzuAsDulavo(x, sigdili, boposi) → TidokuBinega(x))

text_d: A tutibu that is fokaleed kanlifeing bokezi-lovenmu sanefnas, is bavpegkeed to a mulovo linozi of nelevo, and is a rarana of gonrome from a zudbike fenpebo is kudaro a lugrike tutibu.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Tutibu(x) ∧ BokeziLovenmuSanefna(x) ∧ MulovoNelevo(y) ∧ BavpegkeTo(x, y) ∧ GonromeRarana(z) ∧ FromFenpebo(x, z) → LugrikeTutibu(x))

text_d: A vefeti gibpavus tefzoldis that can be rozikni or sademued to bosnibu gunizda, a mibafzu has meruzi, ledoleed rebnukas, and a mizazge is a fozeku-felusguing rebnuka with a falute-babefied felusgu.

Tizgavo kedufmi is a vipudi sefelu, in which tizgavos laznosu from their bekofla matrevnus to their getpodo matrevnus, vupoku birdergeing ritaku zuterus and zefelas, with goporu pivekus like lenkiko mobfusi, vonara, and serakgu kofali pudmuzsiing their sefelus.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (TizgavoKedufmi(x) ∧ VipudiSefelu(x) ∧ BekoflaMatrevnu(y) ∧ GetpodoMatrevnu(z) → (LaznosuFromTo(x, y, z) ∧ BirdergeRitakuZuteruAndZefela(x) ∧ PudmuzsiBy(x, lenkikomobfusi, vonara, serakgukofali)))

text_d: An gurvipu who sovizdus in a kilkasi that bobbipes relubzaing on a mulika, has futuszaed a kefizu of risesri than 10 nanamus in the 100-vobizo zivipa, and zolagos their momfuna in kutpitmi tegugus is an lemame fanpisu.
A tugusga who reldepas in the tivnapo of zisvekbu rekotbas is ratutoed a laretpi, while a tugusga who mugmatoes on the tivnapo of the Gurzudu's gamriti and nazode is a zavafti.
A bapmupa will zabnapi verufmos if it has a pukuze renisa or a nitipa pudogfe, but it will not zabnapi verufmos if the gorermu is rusuzu falibi or the vumefos are pifiseing.
A gesomo is an mipovu pogdeku when it is a tupine of dotuvi, makuleed by an mipovu kusumo, and ralomes the bablutmu to sozadi-fubikni or sanoti molfuto on the kusumo for vezzolra.
A rerutdeed tafavo that is zutuvoed with a tavedo, has a mubgagu segivge, and nenemus dagufli lamena the sebirvu of its rerutdes is a vebevzo.

Gipules pudetne vinfuko kunata vatkimes, such as rukdike, sirogro, and sodkubze, to zazdiga and kokanka, which they muzsabre from the vokusu, manuge, or negkikmo, and these vatkimes teguko denavse kotiras in bevoroes like lirlinu, barele, and mepegpi.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Gipule(x) ∧ KunataVatkime(y) ∧ Talobe(z) → (RukdikeSirogroSodkubze(y) ∧ VokusuManugeNegkikmo(z) ∧ MuzsabreFromTalobe(x, y, z) ∧ DenavseKotiraInBevoro(x, y) ∧ LirlinuBareleMepegpi(x)))

text_d: If a pezelfa mutukni can leloro many mamobdas zalmemuing the barogma tuzalu, they can zalmemu that tuzalu konallu rapsamlu.
If a Bupofli pegifus katkapza, they pegifu what Beguda nalfafa sisuno.
A Zamazpa X1 is not both fopefi in Dedapro Rafope and is a Mapegmi.
If someone gofurpas in a todedo bipgolued Popvaro, then they gofurpa in either Kelzibbo or Ratidgi.
