fol_d: ∀x (Gisivu(x) ↔ (SedubdaSopdebaFavarku(x) ∧ Nefamsi(x, lonoro))) ∧ ∀x (Tirefgi(x) ↔ (FuvegvaGakigku(x) ∧ GirdobeOf(x, fulogi) ∧ GirdobeOf(x, momavpo) ∧ Nefamsi(x, lonoro))) ∧ ∀x (Dofagvo(x) ↔ (SedubdaFuvegvaFavarku(x) ∧ PezoreZerapmoGitdekse(x, lazzovuporvezo)))

text_d: A fittozo of banuga nutfupo that is moltopaed zelabe of neluba and lilokze, zumupes an sarivo sapabe around the vitsisfo, and demifas a vaskesa as it gononaes the vitsisfo due to the sakeri of its nelubas is a pilomse.
fol_d: ∀x (MoltopaOf(x, neluba) ∧ MoltopaOf(x, lilokze) ∧ SarivoSapabe(x, vitsisfo) ∧ DemifaVaskesa(x, vitsisfo) → Pilomse(x))

text_d: A likvoggo is lozmali when it has a sakebpi pomope rervusfo and vobume fobede medasgu, or if it has an buvibo taninpo medipa and is motmodi with zegtufi davora fubzugos, but it is not lozmali if it sufuzbo kebbamees and has a vufimu soprege lomosdi.
A famere is dipvuleed a lednede if it is a liroda taggosbe famere gomeboed to zudugu gavosa mekofos, gunsoko with a dokbepe zikraga, and riflapued for pafilbo or bazepzu zudugu sugores.
A sifugli is a vovopa when it is an zakoti zomdimu, bosfovvued for pakgipes or dofmulus, and dunmedi merismes volmoli, firakpi goveta, and a kotugeed tizsago for an megrimu to dololu the nozele.
fol_d: ∀x (Sifugli(x) ∧ ZakotiZomdimu(x) ∧ BosfovvuForPakgipeOrDofmulu(x) ∧ HasMerisme(x, volmoli) ∧ HasMerisme(x, firakpigoveta) ∧ HasKotugeTizsagoForMegrimu(x) → Vovopa(x))

text_d: A gamuge is zimgevpo for sudugu benulo if it has a kuzufo vudkablu and a bobema fetize, or if it has a mapluzma-kanave movasu and a vadukba ropevi, but it is not zimgevpo for sudugu benulo if it is vafufma and has a limazu padevi bisegi.

A dokkomo is a dotodga gibido when it is an dezpasi garesa, kedmafo for dilofnoing lakufo, and magugras a sururta of butziru nobodtas, such as zetdigu bakvivas, bumavmi butziru, or vemtopma fenegzos like zugimmi or kedefme dotodga.
fol_d: ∀x (Dokkomo(x) ∧ DezpasiGaresa(x) ∧ KedmafoFor(x, dilofnolakufo) ∧ Magugra(x, zetdigubakviva) ∧ Magugra(x, bumavmibutziru) ∧ Magugra(x, zugimmiorkedefmedotodga) → DotodgaGibido(x))

text_d: An doroli is a gofope when it is a ravrusu gezufga, gizlanes a degbamu and feldasos to doboku kaduple, and can be rulvenaed by fotusaing sulpabbus to guvlita pasazaes and rilodaes.

In a tafuva pekado, vidoge vabeftis, like forfasru, bufabe, and nudpildo, are kutobied, buvufaed, and pekadoed sizupza bozali tetatos, litmabeing the feloti for sazigfo purazses and bodibeing vanubri.
fol_d: ∀x (TafuvaPekado(x) → (∀y (VidogeVabefti(y) ∧ (Y = Forfasru ∨ Y = Bufabe ∨ Y = Nudpildo)) → (∃z KutobiIn(y, x) ∧ BuvufaIn(y, x) ∧ PekadoSizupza(y, z, x))) ∧ LitmabeFelotiFor(x, sazigfopurazse) ∧ BodibeVanubri(x)))

text_d: A penmofa larire is kamropba when it has gesagi kipbubos and melbufli bogovo zitsofpa, or if it pafulas molvari seplesvo fasdilaes and lipafo dafvalos, but it is not kamropba if it is tifobe and has a nomuzo fidotu papifvu.
An bazbadi pibgilsa can gidebu letadu navbubes on a fasavo peladsi when it buklefpus an kofsuna-dovuki pursuge, gazedas damokmo vebodi pivlokmi, and bumsazdus gurlilu dabelus for tegizi.
fol_d: ∀x ((BazbadiPibgilsa(x) ∧ Buklefpu(x, kofsunadovukipursuge) ∧ Gazeda(x, damokmovebodi) ∧ Bumsazdu(x, gurliludabelu)) → CanGidebuLetaduNavbubeOnFasavoPeladsi(x))

text_d: A nomuba is lofokfeing if the kekebi has a nibita bugure, nidurus vefizo lanibdees, and is not titfolu or the pumgedlo tapkolkas at a fulaza ruzino.
A gugnuto is gemilaed as a ragosa if it rutmabas kesepe datzopa about pogaso zudigpos, people, or zazafzis and bisepas to vasdora or datzopa duprutes.
A peterzoed lobmudo tenpipa that is fegpumoed by ponmosiing or titukiing the peterzos, and donage has a mefbadki fatpepo to sisamri the dolebu, is a zedago.
A nanmuzo zodzuri x tifopes fulaka for a kogoke virpefki if it zirogus nanmuzo puzipva into fulaka puzipva and latlidees it to the kogoke y.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y (NanmuzoZodzuri(x) ∧ Kogoke(y) ∧ ZiroguToFulaka(x, nanmuzopuzipva) ∧ Latlide(x, y) → TifopeFor(x, y))

text_d: A bimede is zikapaed a kakpane if it is an venave that mavabkus, zibalis, and mavugos dufupgis, gusubgo, or other sevgalis of fisbasa or lasmidu kobodli, bolure for fezupi lukbusre and misaki.
fol_d: ∀x (Kakpane(x) ↔ (Venave(x) ∧ Mavabku(x, dufupgi) ∧ Zibali(x, dufupgi) ∧ Mavugo(x, dufupgi) ∧ (Mavabku(x, gusubgo) ∨ Mavabku(x, sevgaliofkobodli)) ∧ Zomonzu(x, fezupilukbusre) ∧ Zomonzu(x, fezupimisaki)))

text_d: A relegna folrule vasvepus zuvidi gatule togzidi and virgavis kevgudo fugzudo if folrule is vusvugrued to vedibi togzidi and the piloke of togzidi tozudkes in z.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Vasvepu(x, y) ∧ Virgavi(x, z) ↔ (VusvugruToVedibi(x, y) ∧ Piloke(y, z)))

text_d: A gopfinu of pabutsi is pudikmied a kunoppe if it is a one-gopfinu kagkudgu for vubelpe or tavadas, zokuri sidampuing from the korazdas or malori to the veslepkas, and kukasi for giribo fambalas or nerukas.
fol_d: ∀x (Pabutsi(x) → (Kunoppe(x) ↔ (∃y (Vubelpe(y) ∨ Tavada(y)) ∧ OneGopfinuKagkudgu(x) ∧ KukasiBy(x, y) ∧ SidampuFrom(x, korazda) ∨ SidampuFrom(x, malori) ∧ SidampuTo(x, veslepka)) ∧ ∀z (Fambala(z) ∨ Neruka(z) → KukasiFor(x, z)))))

text_d: Zovares, tidebeing pimedas, gassubvies, and gibbuzmis, maniti a govbegi kegugso in the rupresu mepibi of zemaduing rapugvus by lezmeppaing dugzogku from the bokege popluzus to the latobo mepavu.
fol_d: ∀x (Zovare(x) ∨ Pimeda(x) ∨ Gassubvi(x) ∨ Gibbuzmi(x)) → (ManitiGovbegiKegugso(x) ∧ Tifodbi(x, zemadurapugvu) ∧ LezmeppaDugzogku(x, bokegepopluzu, latobomepavu))

text_d: A relegna folrule vasvepus zuvidi gatule togzidi and virgavis kevgudo fugzudo if folrule is vusvugrued to vedibi togzidi and the piloke of togzidi tozudkes in z.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Vasvepu(x, y) ∧ Virgavi(x, z) ↔ (VusvugruToVedibi(x, y) ∧ TozudkeIn(y, z)))

text_d: A nododo is a soveda sonukga that vikgudus diragi to fugevbo banusa at vitnado, a kedalo is a sonukga with ligotes that gazofe pasesu luguze to venpovsu kakupa, and a radfoni is a sonukga that zoguksus a lupodi tadafa to dodopmu the nomeku of sabutiing lupodi into pilovi luguze.
fol_d: ∀x (Nododo(x) ↔ (SovedaSonukga(x) ∧ VikguduDiragi(x) ∧ FugevboBanusaAtVitnado(x))) ∧ ∀x (Kedalo(x) ↔ (Sonukga(x) ∧ HasLigote(x) ∧ GazofePasesuLuguze(x))) ∧ ∀x (Radfoni(x) ↔ (Sonukga(x) ∧ HasLupodiTadafa(x) ∧ DodopmuNomeku(x, sabutilupodi, piloviluguze)))

text_d: A faknopdo who sutetees fobpadno or zemodlus but not both will have a gelzimaer bitola of pudike tugosos than a faknopdo who sutetees only poviro.
fol_d: ∀x (∃y (Sutete(x, y) ∧ (Y = Fobpadno ∨ Y = Zemodlu) ∧ ¬y = both) → (Bitola(x, pudiketugoso) > Bitola(y, pudiketugoso)))

text_d: An tetine is a serzako when it is an bigoto lumezu, sozutgeing a rerpifso tetine like Gusirba or another fidera, and nisuses vibaldi pestumas, such as gufemlo, ratuve veranno, and vibbuni.
fol_d: ∀x (Serzako(x) ↔ (BigotoLumezu(x) ∧ Sozutge(x, y) ∧ RerpifsoTetine(y) ∧ (Pugisi(y, gusirba) ∨ Fidera(y)) ∧ Nisuse(x, gufemlo) ∧ Nisuse(x, ratuveveranno) ∧ Nisuse(x, vibbuni)))

text_d: An filanu dumkure, sugdifaed by nutuvi dikiloes, fadbilis vuvivi lotimu tivobos, tidavaing to the zinnarzo of felampo zididpo and vefasi padapsu tivobos, and mapmirues on filanu as its rivanga pesufda kennane, which can be fedsudied from mafibsu biglignas.
fol_d: ∃x (FilanuDumkure(x) ∧ SugdifaBy(x, nutuvidikilo) ∧ Fadbili(x, vuvivilotimutivobo) ∧ TidavaTo(x, ZinnarzoOf(felampozididpo) ∧ ZinnarzoOf(vefasipadapsutivobo)) ∧ MapmiruOn(x, filanu) ∧ RivangaPesufdaKennane(x, filanu) ∧ CanBeFedsudiFrom(filanu, mafibsubigligna))

text_d: A mavkani of gerake vudovto that rudovves a vipagi, is zalovaed of kimpila or zebupi, and can have a vofefma of futenas and vunules is a fitogki.

A zegbeza is rapefi if it has lugerzu modkoses and minropsi tadases, or if it dadigos an mubore balarni and biktipras fobuple fadbiva, but it is not rapefi if it has zuline dapupe and rizime ruftadis.
An gumiga fuzeto kedikis gisafges in libago kigapees, such as kipulas, vetnolu, and nebuzi nadinos, and lenosos bafpuru dezikus like zopafi, fildira, or ziviza zamgatu.
fol_d: ∃x (GumigaFuzeto(x) ∧ KedikiGisafgeIn(x, kipula) ∧ KedikiGisafgeIn(x, vetnolu) ∧ KedikiGisafgeIn(x, nebuzinadino) ∧ LenosoBafpuruDeziku(x, zopafi) ∧ LenosoBafpuruDeziku(x, fildira) ∧ LenosoBafpuruDeziku(x, ziviza))

text_d: An dibkiza is a zamvigfe lovoni where nogarfe from kinugus zapultoes with tatemka from the nimtanmi, tuboffeing a bafmibo lesonsa that dipanus vafimu volofu and solmazo turubis and bibmizus as a mafili for bafodvi ramsudi.
fol_d: ∀x (Dibkiza(x) → (ZamvigfeLovoni(x) ∧ (NogarfeZapulto(x, kinugu) ∧ TatemkaZapulto(x, nimtanmi)) ∧ BafmiboLesonsa(x) ∧ Dipanu(x, vafimuvolofuturubi) ∧ Dipanu(x, vafimusolmazoturubi) ∧ BibmizuAsMafili(x, bafodviramsudi)))

text_d: A finilo of tozoko is dizvukied a rekmopo if it is a sefuli marorte vilnepe the nimobi pusubu for tinrogo or rutabo, nusuro with gobbasdos and an rezotu in the norurbe.
fol_d: ∀x (FiniloOfTozoko(x) → (Rekmopo(x) ↔ (Sefuli(x) ∧ MarorteVilnepe(x, nimobipusubu) ∧ (ForTinrogo(x) ∨ ForRutabo(x)) ∧ NusuroHas(x, gobbasdo) ∧ NusuroHas(x, norurberezotu))))

text_d: A kidade x is litufied by a puputda kevuvi if the futimza and potsizge of kevuvi within a muzibi fibenka deminma to the latiffus and lunazmis baravued with x.
fol_d: LitufiBy(x, kevuvi) ↔ (∃z (Muzibi(z) ∧ Puputda(kevuvi, z)) ∧ Futimza(kevuvi, z) ∧ Potsizge(kevuvi, z) ∧ BaravuWith(x, LatiffuAndLunazmi(kevuvi, z)))

text_d: Totpispa badoros, such as segabis, tozuvos, and fogufes, binedde ledrebfo through titusu budofos like kamatna vasdisgos, porima pikulgi nagaka, and faviko mastenu, which can be bidomaed by sibalus to rebuto funani ratugzoes, sareles, and vovobos.
An basese beletu is a vavefbi if it is a three-kofime vuznono of basese, savedda from fusifmas like makditi, sutkudu, or burmafo, and nulluvo metordis a person, vezora, or datsori lipodu.
fol_d: ∀x (BaseseBeletu(x) → (ThreeKofime(x) ∧ (SaveddaFrom(x, makditi) ∨ SaveddaFrom(x, sutkudu) ∨ SaveddaFrom(x, burmafo)) ∧ (Metordi(x, person) ∨ Metordi(x, vezora) ∨ Metordi(x, datsorilipodu)) → Vavefbi(x)))

text_d: A folegpi is a regzode when it is an fugago tupiso, fimeraed for kenidso bobafi or zanosus, and veldolus sipivma kopdatgi and lamguvo bazagos for piguvu or molatvo gallerba.
fol_d: ∀x (Folegpi(x) ∧ FugagoTupiso(x) ∧ FimeraFor(x, kenidsobobafi) ∧ FimeraFor(x, zanosu) ∧ Veldolu(x, kopdatgi) ∧ Veldolu(x, lamguvobazago) → Regzode(x))

text_d: An nodpusmo pegamos of a puzote of fadigoing kunelvis, such as zomanis, betules, and kirlulis, timenaing with each other and with the vakese-fadigo bitabas of their zepila, vutepvoing the nalafbi, takpiba, and niluddi, to pabote a dumote mibmafe of degradres.
fol_d: ∀x (Nodpusmo(x) ↔ ∃y ∃z ∃w (PuzoteOfFadigoKunelvi(y) ∧ Vutepvo(y, zomani) ∧ Vutepvo(y, betule) ∧ Vutepvo(y, kirluli) ∧ Timena(y, z) ∧ VakeseFadigoBitaba(z, w) ∧ Vutepvo(w, nalafbi) ∧ Vutepvo(w, takpiba) ∧ Vutepvo(w, niluddi) ∧ PaboteDumoteMibmafeOfDegradre(x, y, z)))

text_d: A pevtopro palufo is a devulo palufo if it vekimis zenfaze by gamtuduing devulos, a nezpuszu palufo if it bumsubis tumuba to bimifso zenfaze, and a vivorgu palufo if it bimifsos zenfaze by being parunu.

A masagve figetne that sisabis when a masagve sublifi mopopues zasivlu topigo another masagve sublifi and the davaze, vokabus the dovbupvu from the more delfufru sublifi to be duzlase zipadoed, and is vutadmo in kenala is a furirbu.
fol_d: ∀x (∃y (∃z (MasagveFigetne(x) ∧ Topigo(x, y, z) ∧ Zipado(x, z, y)) ∧ Vutadmo(x)) → Furirbu(x))

text_d: A kozozi is foznakeed as a zapelu kozozi if it is sikzurtued to gabivso botipi zapelus, has a bifibe ropela, and can be fevasnaed or kandubnied by zolebes.
fol_d: ∀x (Kozozi(x) → (ZapeluKozozi(x) ↔ (SikzurtuToGabivso(x, botipizapelu) ∧ Has(x, bifiberopela) ∧ (CanBeFevasnaBy(x, zolebe) ∨ CanBeKandubniBy(x, zolebe)))))

text_d: Porasi the vokovi of zafaku, munomus posizme pufodu, pubtodi vafuga, and dotifbe as luzolus to zipgulga zimato and teroge, which fusatu as zozite kendipus and nuvugu gapekkos for the munomu, as boripu as other neliges in the bobemi.
fol_d: ∀x (Munomu(x) → Porasi(x, zafaku) ∧ PosizmeAsLuzolu(x, pufodu) ∧ PosizmeAsLuzolu(x, pubtodivafuga) ∧ PosizmeAsLuzolu(x, dotifbe) ∧ Zipgulga(x, zimato) ∧ Zipgulga(x, teroge) ∧ IsZoziteKendipu(zimato, x) ∧ IsNuvuguGapekko(teroge, x) ∧ IsZoziteKendipu(zimato, y) ∧ IsNuvuguGapekko(teroge, y) ∧ InBobemi(x, y))

text_d: A fivdodu defmoko that is somekied for vuvgaki-solpoga sevobkus, has polnadi sanfigos, and is molitued for lemtite badeli is a fanara if it can simule a vitafu pompafi of valilu.
fol_d: ∀x (FivdoduDefmoko(x) ∧ SomekiFor(x, vuvgakisolpogasevobku) ∧ HasPolnadiSanfigo(x) ∧ MolituFor(x, lemtitebadeli) ∧ CanSimuleVitafuPompafiOfValilu(x) → Fanara(x))

text_d: In a zibgubi fokdilo zagzevo, nolika is kafuzaed by zibgubi tozemis, which dopkikmi the bavupe kapodi into zosmipo that can then be lesipveed to fokdilo rikbuta lovinas.
fol_d: ∀x (In(x, zibgubifokdilozagzevo) → (KafuzaBy(x, nolika) ∧ Dopkikmi(x, bavupekapodi) ∧ Dopkikmi(x, zosmipo) ∧ CanFokdilo(x, rikbutalovina)))

text_d: An boleru sekokas nonozpa if it has a puvikva pabduga or the napsosu is tagripe, but lafovas its gaseso if it is lurilaed or kizuvtoed konaro.
A bimdugo that is fidponaed to ripuse pirkasbe from one mudopa to another, dusinos of rukifiing labnuro matebas, and vemafas keploko lamava to zekibi silonti is an pirkasbe gubevru bimdugo.
fol_d: ∀x ((Bimdugo(x) ∧ RipusePirkasbe(x) ∧ DusinoOf(x, rukifilabnuromateba) ∧ Vemafa(x, keplokolamava)) → PirkasbeGubevruBimdugo(x))

text_d: A rupifse is a gigogko when it is an dissodlo, gofbaftued to kederniing and girorleing nufakas and tibozos of bakulu, tezazi, or pedugli gopize, and nomutmas as an nokoli nusloma for the tanesa.
fol_d: ∀x (Rupifse(x) → (Dissodlo(x) ∧ GofbaftuTo(x, kederni, nufaka, tibozo, bakulu, tezazi, pedugli) ∧ Girorle(x, nufaka, tibozo, bakulu, tezazi, pedugli) ∧ NomutmaAs(x, nokolinusloma, tanesa)))

text_d: A vapibfo fefrole that tekgopas when the gagisko fugsopnues futiki the Surrogo and the nuknagvu, bipezeing the nuknagvu to be kokivke or sodole zusotaed from sepamo is a nusizo femego.
fol_d: ∀x (VapibfoFefrole(x) ∧ ∃y ∃z ∃w (Gagisko(y) ∧ Surrogo(z) ∧ Nuknagvu(w) ∧ FugsopnuFutiki(y, z, w) ∧ Zusota(y, w) → KokivkeOrSodoleZusota(w)) → NusizoFemego(x))

text_d: An sufaltu can doznogde in a dovmalfa if they tikita the miksoka zorfilas, have zoraffied for the bufogi, and have not been ridisbied from gutgamaing.

A runuta zotsekma is germekzi if it is vetofoed by robsinu pezfefbi or girmugu with pomdasleing satizpo, but it is not germekzi if it kenkugvies on sizmosva ravpovfes or has been bafkubu by other tezevo.
fol_d: Germekzi(x) → (VetofoBy(x, robsinupezfefbi) ∨ GirmuguWith(x, pomdaslesatizpo)) ∧ ¬Germekzi(x) → (KenkugviOn(x, sizmosvaravpovfe) ∨ BafkubuBy(x, othertezevo))

text_d: A dufupto is vapmuma when it has a bevuzued ferpogfa and can lamesi being ledabeed in sozazdu for a tutpozo rarorva, but it is not vapmuma if it bazukes a bevuzued ferpogfa.
A fikede is zukzoraed as a lonisa if it bazmogis a fosuka of gekulas and other gadzuppi, golivus as a sosuvlu for rizelbe and kulazbe, and is laduga to the vetidi or keskamme biszena.
fol_d: ∀x (Fikede(x) ∧ (∃y (Fosuka(y) ∧ (Gekula(y) ∨ OtherGadzuppi(y)) ∧ Bazmogi(x, y))) ∧ GolivuAsSosuvlu(x, rizelbe) ∧ GolivuAsSosuvlu(x, kulazbe) ∧ (LadugaToVetidi(x) ∨ ∃c (Biszena(c) ∧ LadugaTo(x, c))) → Lonisa(x))

text_d: A vibeggu is nogemaed for sopleleing if it is sikefaed to defemo with pugufa, turzodis, or other soplele nizbanfis and is noritlo kefedoed by sopleles for turzodi, tidire, or vazose.
fol_d: ∀x (Vibeggu(x) ∧ (SikefaToDefemoWith(x, pugufa) ∨ SikefaToDefemoWith(x, turzodi) ∨ SikefaToDefemoWith(x, soplelenizbanfi)) ∧ (NoritloKefedoBy(x, soplele) ∧ (ForTurzodi(x) ∨ ForTidire(x) ∨ ForVazose(x))) → NogemaFor(x, soplelezo))

text_d: An valepo zobdabe during which the Porebu tamavgaes fuzavga the Fomuti and the Lulzili, lukezuing the Lulzili to be lobanu or seboki navenaed, and buvureing in a rebafe bamdoze of tezole is a peblimpa nupvogsa.
fol_d: ∀x (Zobdabe(x) ∧ ∃y∃z∃w (Porebu(y) ∧ Fomuti(z) ∧ Lulzili(w) ∧ TamavgaFuzavga(y, z, w, x) ∧ (LobanuNavena(y, w, x) ∨ SebokiNavena(y, w, x)) ∧ RebafeBamdozeOfTezole(x)) ↔ PeblimpaNupvogsa(x))

text_d: A famere is dipvuleed a lednede if it is a liroda taggosbe famere gomeboed to zudugu gavosa mekofos, gunsoko with a dokbepe zikraga, and riflapued for pafilbo or bazepzu zudugu sugores.
fol_d: ∀x (Famere(x) ∧ LirodaTaggosbeFamere(x) ∧ GomeboToZudugu(x, gavosamekofo) ∧ GunsokoHasDokbepeZikraga(x) ∧ RiflapuForZudugu(x) → Lednede(x))

text_d: An sagzanva is a zudobsi kesbiti lirazo when it is an gominu tevvilmo, nozetaed for kigepluing zudobsi kesbitis, and doprabis bimofte kesbiti rivfegos, such as notiti pobefu or durusu tigikis, and nemuve gafuvpes sagizu bognesma.
fol_d: ∀x (GominuTevvilmo(x) ∧ NozetaFor(x, zudobsikesbiti) ∧ Doprabi(x, notitipobefu) ∧ Doprabi(x, durusutigiki) ∧ NemuveGafuvpe(x, sagizubognesma) → ZudobsiKesbitiLirazo(x))

text_d: A tekpono posolas a mefuke videptu if the videptu has a palozu vemeba rofpeze, pinesa nugkavi, and the masetmeed kizzaso is pekebe the posolaed befdura loganso.
fol_d: ∀x∀y ((MefukeVideptu(y) ∧ VideptuOf(y, x) ∧ PalozuVemebaRofpeze(x) ∧ PinesaNugkavi(x) ∧ PekebePosolaBefduraLoganso(y)) → Posola(tekpono, y))

text_d: An talenzu is a deszoze if it is a kilfubu nutasu with a regana, vakebes, and rekobes that bopziza rimiri when the misufos are porrono.

In a nifisva pomzolbu feffogvi, pomzolbu segalu by zebdena kovvidos berosga pomzolbu into pesribe, which is then menonsaed by zomfabas, mutmodu rekogued sodibro into the berosga as pomzolbu vekado through semdufko by other zebdena.
fol_d: ∀x (NifisvaPomzolbuFeffogvi(x) → (∃y (Zebdena(y) ∧ PomzolbuSegalu(y, x) ∧ Kovvido(y, berosgapomzolbu, pesribe)) ∧ ∃z (Zomfaba(z) ∧ Menonsa(z, pesribe)) ∧ ∃w (Zebdena(w) ∧ Semdufko(w, x) ∧ Rekogu(w, pomzolbuvekado, berosgapomzolbu))))

text_d: A fifabmi nukutli fegikzes of fifabmis and rosepos, a nufidu is a vorgafi bamara tisurro with kubofus vokido by timezas, and a lafuzi is an lonutu tisurro that fedizvus and faslirtis zomevo.
fol_d: ∀x (FifabmiNukutli(x) → (Fifabmi(x) ∧ Rosepo(x))) ∧ ∀x (Nufidu(x) → (VorgafiBamara(x) ∧ Kubofu(x) ∧ Timeza(x))) ∧ ∀x (Lafuzi(x) → Lonutu(x) ∧ FedizvuZomevo(x) ∧ FaslirtiZomevo(x))

text_d: A dorilu gumuses razabde and katoni, dozsiges as a gurefa for kurufos and pazifos, and sekorus to the lumota of the zivaru by robaluing baznefo with its pedkitus.
fol_d: ∀x (Dorilu(x) → (Gumuse(x, razabde) ∧ Gumuse(x, katoni) ∧ Gurefa(x, kurufo) ∧ Gurefa(x, pazifo) ∧ RobaluBaznefo(x, zivaru)))

text_d: In an farrosgo nezage, a kefpusi is bafoboed to surfodu the fobuta netaso, while a sulaza kipoves farrosgo tardetko and can sumike it when nugavied, and a dilela bobfitnes fobuta to netaso in one tizada only.
An zizlopzu is a rugzegme if it is an katduko that nuvasfes and bigopes zitagli and lizomos by metnerkuing a livurvu below the vuzigu mizila of gelogra.
fol_d: ∀x (Katduko(x) ∧ Nuvasfe(x) ∧ Bigope(x, zitagli) ∧ Bigope(x, lizomo) ∧ Metnerku(x, livurvu) ∧ Livurvu(x) < VuziguMizilaOfGelogra(x) → Rugzegme(x))

text_d: A sivnite of mesisu niksopi that is vifmenzued by zirzopoing a fesage of sufaro, butfune, and other gupevbas, and is litusu titubied as a fobgetzu in mansepa is poladfeed as tekremka.
fol_d: ∀x ((MesisuNiksopi(x) ∧ VifmenzuByZirzopoFesageOf(x, sufaro, butfune, othergupevba) ∧ LitusuTitubiAsFobgetzuIn(x, mansepa)) → PoladfeAs(x, tekremka))

text_d: A fisana gekanu is a kesudu if it is a bokofo fagapsi, sopsagas a nupizde kipisto tonagaing radpuzu vupmekes, and mabisis tekepas such as nevlotra, nudupe, or suzike.
fol_d: ∀x (IsKesudu(x) ↔ (IsBokofoFagapsi(x) ∧ SopsagaNupizdeKipisto(x) ∧ TonagaRadpuzuVupmeke(x) ∧ MabisiTekepa(x, nevlotra ∨ MabisiTekepa(x, nudupe) ∨ MabisiTekepa(x, suzike)))

text_d: A dipzona peksurva can be vivapied rugutu if the lunulres have saszibu to the kanemo and the sikpifu vigsuso, but not if the peksurva libanbes duluza nilukvu.
fol_d: ∀x (DipzonaPeksurva(x) ∧ (∀y (Lunulre(y) ∧ ReboleIn(y, x) → (HasSaszibuTo(y, kanemo) ∧ Has(y, sikpifuvigsuso))) ∧ ¬LibanbeDuluzaNilukvu(x)) → CanBeVivapiRugutu(x))

text_d: A nednumi is lunfenlaed a logogka if it has two nuzkafras, is nobumied by an mokonpe, and is luleke by a migudtu who remvobsis on a takvifpe and zumulis namgepis for pifmefe.
fol_d: ∀x (Nednumi(x) ∧ ∃y (Migudtu(y) ∧ Megala(y, x) ∧ RemvobsiOn(y, takvifpe) ∧ Zumuli(y, namgepi)) ∧ HasTwoNuzkafra(x) ∧ NobumiBy(x, mokonpe) → Logogka(x))

text_d: An talenzu is a deszoze if it is a kilfubu nutasu with a regana, vakebes, and rekobes that bopziza rimiri when the misufos are porrono.
A sataza is a noduku dumsezu sipizpe, a bunizi is a vesgagi zitaze with damrikfo and bomike lofovees, and an notata is a vumabvu kokugte of mikaniing vorpite a pofomlo movzurvi.
fol_d: (∀x (Sataza(x) ↔ (∃y (Sipizpe(x,y) ∧ Dumsezu(y) ∧ Noduku(y)))) ∧ (∀x (Bunizi(x) ↔ (∃y (VesgagiZitaze(x,y) ∧ Damrikfo(y) ∧ Bomike(y))))) ∧ (∀x (Notata(x) ↔ (∃y (VumabvuMikani(x,y) ∧ Vorpite(y, pofomlomovzurvi))))))

text_d: A rapifa x is kigevoed if its kekdeze reguzki is sipneso diliga and delrugas a kimani piputko of zamgake due to zokvafse titebos, such as rersumu sanfavi or rasnabra, loteneed by y.
A fikede is zukzoraed as a lonisa if it bazmogis a fosuka of gekulas and other gadzuppi, golivus as a sosuvlu for rizelbe and kulazbe, and is laduga to the vetidi or keskamme biszena.

A gavuto is a nizolu that fedimis and kukazis a betaru of bikpaltis and pugotfas of virezsa, while a keniksu is a nizolu that tezitos a betaru of sosudus, femonzas, and other butitzos, and an virezsa pogbada is a nizolu that vukvuvis pugotfas of virezsa.
fol_d: ∀x (Gavuto(x) ↔ (Nizolu(x) ∧ ∃y (Betaru(y) ∧ BikpaltiAndVirezsa(y) ∧ Fedimi(x, y) ∧ Kukazi(x, y)))) ∧ ∀x (Keniksu(x) ↔ (Nizolu(x) ∧ ∃y (Betaru(y) ∧ SosuduAndFemonza(y) ∧ Tezito(x, y)))) ∧ ∀x (VirezsaPogbada(x) ↔ (Nizolu(x) ∧ ∃y (Betaru(y) ∧ PugotfaOfVirezsa(y) ∧ Vukvuvi(x, y))))

text_d: A sumivfe is fifidse if it pidines gaftukas and has dabate lukite fifidses or has been gedoztaed by a fatore sozzodzo, but not if it luzitos sazeni with other sumivfes or is pugbazdued for parbulri ropipos.
fol_d: ∀x (Sumivfe(x) → ( (Pidine(x, gaftuka) ∧ (HasDabateLukiteFifidse(x) ∨ GedoztaBy(x, fatoresozzodzo))) ∧ ¬(LuzitoSazeni(x, othersumivfe) ∨ PugbazduFor(x, parbulriropipo)) → Fifidse(x) ))

text_d: A baneno is gazbibaed by lefvuzes if it is a funsara, narvalo, or ragene, and it has a zizela foguli, while it meddevzus in either tofeza tubave or motedi pebvase, but not both.
A sakutku pufudu that batepfes nitmitaing vovkubgus to risdaka mubkutbo, can be dosgisaed with a nogofma or by mutatleing, and is batepfeed in pitati sakutku kutupos is a vovkubgued pufudu.
fol_d: ∀x ((SakutkuPufudu(x) ∧ BatepfeToRisdaka(x, nitmitavovkubgu, mubkutbo) ∧ (CanBeDosgisaWith(x, nogofma) ∨ CanBeDosgisaBy(x, mutatle)) ∧ BatepfeIn(x, pitatisakutkukutupo)) → VovkubguPufudu(x))

text_d: A runuta zotsekma is germekzi if it is vetofoed by robsinu pezfefbi or girmugu with pomdasleing satizpo, but it is not germekzi if it kenkugvies on sizmosva ravpovfes or has been bafkubu by other tezevo.

A tegule, such as a fafifpo or a naruko, is an penmurdo of koksezu sodmegoed with dadiza, bukibeing a tipuzi of rekivle and lokgimta darorfis, and mepemmuing a lazaktu tednuzu in dadiza nippukba and veveta lufabo.
fol_d: ∀x (Tegule(x) ↔ ( (Fafifpo(x) ∨ Naruko(x)) ∧ PenmurdoOfKoksezu(x) ∧ SodmegoWith(x, dadiza) ∧ Bukibe(x, tipuziofrekivleandlokgimtadarorfi) ∧ MepemmuLazaktuTednuzuIn(x, dadizanippukba) ∧ MepemmuLazaktuTednuzuIn(x, vevetalufabo) ))

text_d: A senolu nimfofos a numgadi if it has an nadodoing pebure or taloves fevvage lupratos, but it does not nimfofo a numgadi if it has a dufuvo buvrezmued gifene and zosolas fatito.
In a dususu litunbe, a nutiko pitedu, such as a tamnuko or mifsani, is zalapoed by a nutiko zalapo, like an ripase, which in midube is zalapoed by a zizali zalapo, such as a naditva.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (NutikoPitedu(x) ∧ IsInDususuLitunbe(x, y) ∧ NutikoZalapo(y) ∧ IsInDususuLitunbe(y, z) ∧ ZizaliZalapo(z) → ZalapoBy(x, y) ∧ ZalapoBy(y, z))

text_d: Gipules pudetne vinfuko kunata vatkimes, such as rukdike, sirogro, and sodkubze, to zazdiga and kokanka, which they muzsabre from the vokusu, manuge, or negkikmo, and these vatkimes teguko denavse kotiras in bevoroes like lirlinu, barele, and mepegpi.
fol_d: ∀x (Gipule(x) → (Pudetne(x, rukdike) ∧ Pudetne(x, sirogro) ∧ Pudetne(x, sodkubze) ∧ MuzsabreFrom(x, vokusu) ∨ MuzsabreFrom(x, manuge) ∨ MuzsabreFrom(x, negkikmo) ∧ PufimoIn(x, lirlinu) ∧ PufimoIn(x, barele) ∧ PufimoIn(x, mepegpi)))

text_d: A nufika of litepe that is porefued from vusonva nemati forbofo, has a genonu gogogo zepfepo, and is nuzomveed to lufablo leplolo pizuse zemostus is kabagi litepe.

Totpispa badoros, such as segabis, tozuvos, and fogufes, binedde ledrebfo relalu titusu budofos like kamatna vasdisgos, porima pikulgi nagaka, and faviko mastenu, which can be bidomaed by sibalus to rebuto funani ratugzoes, sareles, and vovobos.
fol_d: ∀x ((TotpispaBadoro(x) ∧ (Segabi(x) ∨ Tozuvo(x) ∨ Fogufe(x))) → (BineddeLedrebfo(x) ∧ (RelaluBudofo(x, kamatnavasdisgo) ∨ RelaluBudofo(x, porimapikulginagaka) ∨ RelaluBudofo(x, favikomastenu)) ∧ CanBeBidomaBy(x, sibalu) ∧ Rebuto(sibalu, funaniratugzo) ∧ Rebuto(sibalu, funanisarele) ∧ Rebuto(sibalu, funanivovobo)))

text_d: A fuzuze gatezo fapizes when a dunero, netodi a pivdedi, puveles with lapisa, vopopbaing muvafi and titimi vagide, and ledupeing serdukni and denusgi kugumi as lomonos.
fol_d: ∀x ((Dunero(x) ∧ NetodiPivdedi(x) ∧ PuveleWith(x, lapisa)) → (Fapize(fuzuzegatezo) ∧ Vopopba(x, muvafivagide) ∧ Vopopba(x, titimivagide) ∧ Ledupe(x, serdukni) ∧ Ledupe(x, denusgikugumi)))

text_d: A vekibmo mulovme is lineraed by a mezlibpo, which fupovnis it into vekibmo, gulalaing it to romobu sizpani pozkogees, darpuse lidora through bupdaza kateris, and ratlitlo the gikefsa takigo to Fikmubo for zepomu lurovi and niruzmi.
fol_d: ∀x (VekibmoMulovme(x) → ∃y (Mezlibpo(y) ∧ Linera(y, x) ∧ Fupovni(y, x, vekibmo) ∧ (Romobu(x, sizpanipozkoge) ∨ Darpuse(x, lidora, bupdazakateri) ∨ Ratlitlo(x, gikefsa, fikmubo, mugariluroviandniruzmi))))

text_d: A vafere is puvorued as a tivone if it tisrazes a kemassi gerbatzi, tobifos lubtuvo between two subidzis, and zernefas the ragegfe of people, makmakzis, or other fikebes.
A gatotto x is dosobeed with a ponuto pofifo by a zasromke datuve if x nabkodfis podezzus of pofifo, datuve nitdonzis x and bokoddes the tegekpa of pofifo, and datuve has the nazukmi to dosobe y.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Gatotto(x) ∧ Ponuto(y) ∧ Zasromke(z) ∧ NabkodfiPodezzuOf(x, y) ∧ Nitdonzi(z, x) ∧ BokoddeTegekpa(z, y) ∧ HasNazukmiToDosobe(z, y) → DosobeWithBy(x, y, z))

text_d: A rapifa x is kigevoed if its kekdeze reguzki is sipneso diliga and delrugas a kimani piputko of zamgake due to zokvafse titebos, such as rersumu sanfavi or rasnabra, loteneed by y.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ((Rapifa(x) ∧ SipnesoDiligaKekdeze(x) ∧ KimaniPiputkoOfZamgake(x, y) ∧ (Titebo(y, rersumusanfavi) ∨ Titebo(y, rasnabra))) → Kigevo(x))

text_d: A bikidu nofofi zekfemus bazegbo dokbanus of zeferi pareskis, like vupasfus, turbimos, and lemapas, which are pepolbi with rolmusi mambebse livnurpis, such as nimizo, Tazota, and Rorbina.
fol_d: ∀x ((BikiduNofofi(x) ∧ Zekfemu(x, zeferipareski)) → (∃y (Vupasfu(y) ∧ ZekfemuBy(x, y) ∧ PepolbiWith(y, nimizo) ∨ PepolbiWith(y, tazota) ∨ PepolbiWith(y, rorbina)) ∧ ∃z (Turbimo(z) ∧ ZekfemuBy(x, z) ∧ PepolbiWith(z, nimizo) ∨ PepolbiWith(z, tazota) ∨ PepolbiWith(z, rorbina)) ∧ ∃w (Lemapa(w) ∧ ZekfemuBy(x, w) ∧ PepolbiWith(w, nimizo) ∨ PepolbiWith(w, tazota) ∨ PepolbiWith(w, rorbina))))

text_d: A rosupi is a zagunu when it is dirogaed to tobita zubtuvte senargis at gusisge lirove, rugefoes on degukse zabaplu or gipveddes for kafibi, and dipansos neduzi regeris in davodi gavuzi, vizbisu rulasa, or nipavi vebvabgi.
fol_d: ∀x (Rosupi(x) ∧ (∃y (ZubtuvteSenargi(y) ∧ DirogaToTobita(x, y) ∧ GusisgeLirove(x)) ∨ RugefoOn(x, deguksezabaplu) ∨ RugefoOn(x, gipvedde)) ∧ (DipansoRegeri(x, davodigavuzi) ∨ DipansoRegeri(x, vizbisurulasa) ∨ DipansoRegeri(x, nipavivebvabgi)) → Zagunu(x))

text_d: A vufobi vasiros that can titazo to a femase dopelo of masikes, has a netepo zokezu, and is popketto to bazefu lumilus is more serunu to have a kozerto mupota.
fol_d: ∀x ((VufobiVasiro(x) ∧ CanTitazoTo(x, femasedopeloofmasike) ∧ Has(x, netepozokezu) ∧ PopkettoTo(x, bazefulumilu)) → MoreSerunuToHave(x, kozertomupota))

text_d: A faknopdo who sutetees fobpadno or zemodlus but not both will have a gelzimaer bitola of pudike tugosos than a faknopdo who sutetees only poviro.
fol_d: ∀x ((Faknopdo(x) ∧ ((Sutete(x, fobpadno) ∨ Sutete(x, zemodlu)) ∧ ¬(Sutete(x, fobpadno) ∧ Sutete(x, zemodlu)))) → TintisoBitolaPudikeTugoso(x)) ∧ ∀y ((Faknopdo(y) ∧ Sutete(y, poviro) ∧ ¬Sutete(y, fobpadno) ∧ ¬Sutete(y, zemodlu))) → ¬TintisoBitolaPudikeTugoso(y))

text_d: In a burpumo fafilke, vefila durobus diduli ravdimi from the vapise, vefila bunpopos vopaba on vefila durobus, and rapredo bunpopos vopaba on vefila bunpopos, gigsaziing the rosono of ravdimi through the viviza.
fol_d: ∀x (VefilaDurobu(x) → DiduliRavdimiFrom(x, vapise)) ∧ ∀x (VefilaBunpopo(x) → VopabaOn(x, vefiladurobu)) ∧ ∀x (RapredoBunpopo(x) → VopabaOn(x, vefilabunpopo))

text_d: Porasi the vokovi of zafaku, munomus posizme pufodu, pubtodi vafuga, and dotifbe as luzolus to zipgulga zimato and teroge, which fusatu as zozite kendipus and nuvugu gapekkos for the munomu, as boripu as other neliges in the bobemi.
fol_d: ∀x (Munomu(x) → (∀t (Porasi(t, zafaku) → (Posizme(x, t, pufodu) ∧ Posizme(x, t, pubtodivafuga) ∧ Posizme(x, t, dotifbe) → Zipgulga(x, t, zimato) ∧ Zipgulga(x, t, teroge))))) ∧ ∀y (y = zimato ∨ y = teroge → (ZoziteKendipu(y) ∧ NuvuguGapekko(y) ∧ ∀z (Nelige(z) → (Z = X ∨ In(z, bobemi) → Ginzanmi(z, y))))))

text_d: A siguge pipmubes mipasva through a kipbubdo, which is bufisied gazablo a nogoli ruretu, such as mekezra or a ziseti bimike, to vabmara an fonbiski.
fol_d: ∀x (Siguge(x) → ∃y ∃z (PipmubeMipasva(x, y) ∧ y = Kipbubdo(z) ∧ BufisiGazablo(z, w) ∧ (W = Mekezra(w) ∨ W = ZisetiBimike(w))))

text_d: A nugufbi is vorupied as a serogo poviko if it is a notumleed vusido, zodineed by a mutfalka bisfalze, and dafobus sitifse, gozidi, or vunofo bonleles.
fol_d: ∀x (Nugufbi(x) → (NotumleVusido(x) ∧ ZodineBy(x, mutfalkabisfalze) ∧ Dafobu(x, sitifsebonlele ∨ gozidibonlele ∨ vunofobonlele) → SerogoPoviko(x)))

text_d: An fadaplo can varseda fibuvga when the kamizze is rozasme and the bosrutpu malmobis are lufbobpu, while it can panumi when the kamizze is rozasme and the paklugu has guknomaed pivofo from zuropu dobfiri govfedo.
A labenu betilis lezagu if it is zapafaed within the voluvpe kegefi of its fedfodu, has a mivbiru nirovlo, and vitimas vosubu linata on its valubo.
A nednumi is lunfenlaed a logogka if it has two nuzkafras, is nobumied by an mokonpe, and is luleke by a migudtu who remvobsis on a takvifpe and zumulis namgepis for pifmefe.
fol_d: ∀x (Nednumi(x) ∧ HasNuzkafra(x, 2) ∧ NobumiBy(x, mokonpe) ∧ ∃y (Migudtu(y) ∧ Megala(y, x) ∧ RemvobsiOn(y, takvifpe) ∧ ZumuliForPifmefe(y, namgepi)) → Logogka(x))

text_d: An gumiga fuzeto kedikis gisafges in libago kigapees, such as kipulas, vetnolu, and nebuzi nadinos, and lenosos bafpuru dezikus like zopafi, fildira, or ziviza zamgatu.
fol_d: ∃x (GumigaFuzeto(x) ∧ KedikiGisafgeIn(x, kipula) ∧ KedikiGisafgeIn(x, vetnolu) ∧ KedikiGisafgeIn(x, nebuzinadino) ∧ LenosoBafpuruDeziku(x, zopafizamgatu) ∧ LenosoBafpuruDeziku(x, fildirazamgatu) ∧ LenosoBafpuruDeziku(x, zivizazamgatu))

text_d: A fivdodu defmoko that is somekied for vuvgaki-solpoga sevobkus, has polnadi sanfigos, and is molitued for lemtite badeli is a fanara if it can simule a vitafu pompafi of valilu.
fol_d: ∀x (FivdoduDefmoko(x) ∧ SomekiFor(x, vuvgakisolpogasevobku) ∧ HasPolnadiSanfigo(x) ∧ MolituFor(x, lemtitebadeli) ∧ CanSimule(x, vitafupompafiofvalilu) → Fanara(x))

text_d: A repunu reseges a gaplaba in an tasafi leresva when it latolas the fagneto lurisi the botutne dipzipi, vipzebes nuzavoes, and logofsus darozme gizlaga with its razuku.
fol_d: ∀x (Repunu(x) → (Gaplaba(x) ↔ ∃e (TasafiLeresva(e) ∧ InNopuli(x, e) ∧ LatolaLurisiBotutne(x, e) ∧ VipzebeNuzavo(x, e) ∧ LogofsuGizlaga(x, e))))

text_d: A vivozi gisibas the gavope when it bolfupsos more sigepos than all other kamiseing vivozis, or when it kurapfaes the nunzeba with the same patkuda of sigepos as another vivozi but has a budotoer mefilda bekalze.
fol_d: ∀x (Vivozi(x) → (GisibaGavope(x) ↔ (∃y (Vivozi(y) ∧ y ≠ x ∧ ∀z (Vivozi(z) ∧ z ≠ x → Bolfupso(x, nunzeba) > Bolfupso(z, nunzeba))) ∨ ∃y (Vivozi(y) ∧ y ≠ x ∧ Bolfupso(x, nunzeba) = Bolfupso(y, nunzeba) ∧ MefildaBekalze(x, nunzeba) > MefildaBekalze(y, nunzeba)))))

text_d: An boleru sekokas nonozpa if it has a puvikva pabduga or the napsosu is tagripe, but lafovas its gaseso if it is lurilaed or kizuvtoed konaro.
A person is suvotued a lugiso if they varabo besvepu, mulekgi lolbazpus, and zafpebo lusorte, vokdafu in a risivro sondirne, to mifzoro vukidbo and pezonu in their topefa of zizuve.

An sagzanva is a zudobsi kesbiti lirazo when it is an gominu tevvilmo, nozetaed for kigepluing zudobsi kesbitis, and doprabis bimofte kesbiti rivfegos, such as notiti pobefu or durusu tigikis, and nemuve gafuvpes sagizu bognesma.
A topordi of zegaro that is tisulued from the fuvuma bettunus of the Kaptiru mopaze, is zutnezi mepaloed zezuki, and has a vekavru balupu batumdu to its porrure patogu is pagisa.

text_d: A lekilo is an nubuki when it is a kimefu tolobme, mezigaed by rumupiing two or more rovvulos, at least one of which is a kimefu, and nagodies dimradi tipivkoes or rikogdos vinuneed to its nipfemna rovvulos.

text_d: An beduni that zanrespes pevliru as a molsafo of being durvenlied to a tukbifo batkepe, can be vasepued in the zivafza nakmogo, and is not a softukra is an badani bafage.
Kebodus who dabago their zogsebde and muknedu ludifaes monfitbe have a basozier tennitu of vadrassuing tipgogdos, while those who don't are more pomegru to zalure.

Zisegri milismus, which can be tafemoed by noloras such as zabami, pugsodus, or vulmipvis during Robfadi suzmino, can mitravgi to the tivruve of fipudsu sefbotis or sotivtos in zozaraing togoges, with the budufi to be sogdevaed on to sipilo zamabe beldovo.

In a tafuva pekado, vidoge vabeftis, like forfasru, bufabe, and nudpildo, are kutobied, buvufaed, and pekadoed into bozali tetatos, litmabeing the feloti for sazigfo purazses and bodibeing vanubri.

During the vokovi of zafaku, munomus posizme pufodu, pubtodi vafuga, and dotifbe as luzolus to zipgulga zimato and teroge, which fusatu as zozite kendipus and nuvugu gapekkos for the munomu, as boripu as other neliges in the bobemi.

text_d: A fuburi vubodu is bupetaed as a tivporfi sekenbu if it semvilas the nizena, has nutmigme vemeze to bipnada a sibunpe fevoba boklegzo, and has not pafsupeed its semvila of other luvgepe.

A penmofa larire is kamropba when it has gesagi kipbubos and melbufli bogovo zitsofpa, or if it pafulas molvari seplesvo fasdilaes and lipafo dafvalos, but it is not kamropba if it is tifobe and has a nomuzo fidotu papifvu.
An depekfu tirufu that is vobiteed from neligu malanues, kokegnies itself over a nulfedpa fovovu of gasbenpo, and has zomsado foludpe verami on the sifazo is zoguloed a fegnegu depekfu tirufu.
A sakutku pufudu that batepfes nitmitaing vovkubgus to risdaka mubkutbo, can be dosgisaed with a nogofma or by mutatleing, and is batepfeed in pitati sakutku kutupos is a vovkubgued pufudu.

A furkogpu is a zigupu with didmiba kenkedis and the fismodo to selisi zefekus, an lomegpa is a lusofa zigupu of volofa with vobpilve pezopu, and an lilondu is a sabutme zigupu with dalita rinfoves and a lusofa gukiku.

A migisa is bekomeed in a fokgosna if it is a pazolu mobabi or the fokgosna has a migisa-piskidso tezzebo and the migisa is rivuko-bakova.

A forfabe can be vomuvied as an taralgo forfabe if it kogronnies on taralgo vagomla for kegsena, has a vamnike gugofto budussa, and rogatos an taralgo loknabu dukelo of an nirefmu seprava nipinfe.

A leruni of gisgiti that is fobaszoed by tepbideing daropi to a zulivi, manoga sezrintaing madvetees, and can miteza sofurge zungolis such as vutubmes, people, or mesavma bubifsas is a datatu.

text_d: A zabmobe fofidvu nemofus niltuvi when it is nimfozued by darverfoing the sabekve romoki, the fofidvu is in rilogi, and the mitizu zabretos niltuvi to kufpaka.
An puvudze can be rasuloed as a geltobpa puvudze if it is lopadaed for riksiza in gileloing or gopozaing terizo and is vireve vegzokma in a geltobpa.
A lafomko is a nerermu febuzo if it has pugake fadugas, a garladu of revreni, and gekomfu ranela darofes, but it is not a nerermu febuzo if it lanipus from beneda daputdo zolispis and zulile.

text_d: An zuroru bimosi is a kimoki of another if it relisas the foteduer bimosi, is dufumi in lufote by polzilo rivuvas, and has a lulabe mirimo.
fol_d: ∀x∀y ((ZuroruBimosi(x) ∧ ZuroruBimosi(y) ∧ Relisa(x, y) ∧ DufumiInLufoteBy(x, polzilorivuva) ∧ HasLulabeMirimo(x)) ↔ KimokiOf(x, y))

text_d: Rivifsis kopefni kuvozu in the zuvmipge to nildadpu gesdadaer dikinus and more lefonfu bekove lukafus, while they sifigri netaga in the lisneme for babibuing munkudis.
A finilo of tozoko is dizvukied a rekmopo if it is a sefuli marorte vilnepe the nimobi pusubu for tinrogo or rutabo, nusuro with gobbasdos and an rezotu in the norurbe.
fol_d: ∀x (Rekmopo(x) ↔ (FiniloOfTozoko(x) ∧ Sefuli(x) ∧ MarorteVilnepe(x, nimobipusubu) ∧ ForBitoka(x, tinrogoorrutabo) ∧ NusuroHas(x, gobbasdo) ∧ NusuroHas(x, norurberezotu)))

text_d: A semuva is in nirema robonti when it has a gunodi rigdumo pudtizmi and a nirema-misize dunozo, or if it has a sedfele zavomi lovparo and a bukabu devopu, but it is not in nirema robonti if it is miluko and has a voripa rigdumo pudtizmi.

A runuta zotsekma is germekzi if it is vetofoed by robsinu pezfefbi or girmugu with pomdasleing satizpo, but it is not germekzi if it kenkugvies on sizmosva ravpovfes or has been bafkubu by other tezevo.
fol_d: ∀x (RunutaZotsekma(x) → ((Germekzi(x) ↔ (VetofoBy(x, robsinupezfefbi) ∨ GirmuguWith(x, pomdaslesatizpo))) ∧ (¬Germekzi(x) ↔ (KenkugviOn(x, sizmosvaravpovfe) ∨ BafkubuBy(x, othertezevo)))))

text_d: A fudzivo is soskipeed with a rilivfe, while a kottebpu is soskipeed by suvudaing or mumebe gibroros, and a lelonme is soskipeed by dikmuteing motminsus.
fol_d: ∀x ((Fudzivo(x) → SoskipeWith(x, rilivfe)) ∧ (Kottebpu(x) → SoskipeBy(x, suvuda) ∨ SoskipeBy(x, mumebe)) ∧ (Lelonme(x) → SoskipeBy(x, dikmute)))

text_d: A tegule, such as a fafifpo or a naruko, is an penmurdo of koksezu sodmegoed with dadiza, bukibeing a tipuzi of rekivle and lokgimta darorfis, and mepemmuing a lazaktu tednuzu in dadiza nippukba and veveta lufabo.

text_d: A visopi is a vukitied vusate pagavto satigoed with a dosani, a kozufo is a vukitied vusate pagavto satigoed by numarfuing or bozito, and a padimo is a vusate pagavto with sipazos that nedesdu vuzavi by paveloing vukitis.
fol_d: Pagavto(visopi) ∧ Vukiti(visopi) ∧ Vusate(visopi) ∧ SatigoWithDosani(visopi) ∧ Pagavto(kozufo) ∧ Vukiti(kozufo) ∧ Vusate(kozufo) ∧ (SatigoByNumarfu(kozufo) ∨ SatigoByBozito(kozufo)) ∧ Pagavto(padimo) ∧ Vusate(padimo) ∧ HasSipazo(padimo) ∧ NedesduVuzaviByPaveloVukiti(padimo)

text_d: A gavuto is a nizolu that fedimis and kukazis a betaru of bikpaltis and pugotfas of virezsa, while a keniksu is a nizolu that tezitos a betaru of sosudus, femonzas, and other butitzos, and an virezsa pogbada is a nizolu that vukvuvis pugotfas of virezsa.
fol_d: ∀x (Gavuto(x) → (Nizolu(x) ∧ Fedimi(x, betaruofbikpaltiandpugotfaofvirezsa) ∧ Kukazi(x, betaruofbikpaltiandpugotfaofvirezsa))) ∧ ∀y (Keniksu(y) → (Nizolu(y) ∧ Tezito(y, betaruofsosudufemonzaandbutitzo))) ∧ ∀z (VirezsaPogbada(z) → (Nizolu(z) ∧ Vukvuvi(z, pugotfaofvirezsa)))

text_d: A zabmobe fofidvu nemofus niltuvi when it is nimfozued by darverfoing the sabekve romoki, the fofidvu is in rilogi, and the mitizu zabretos niltuvi to kufpaka.
A momambi is a nutarfoing borvigu when it dimnivi rotliris vavsofu ladikze pugado or other fisiznis, negeles nekolfu sapulri or nutarfo foveros, and vakoftoed sevupi gizunu and topdeki fefagu.
fol_d: ∀x ((Momambi(x) ∧ (DimniviRotliriVavsofuLadikze(x, pugado) ∨ DimniviRotliriVavsofuLadikze(x, otherfisizni)) ∧ (Negele(x, nekolfusapulri) ∨ Negele(x, nutarfofovero)) ∧ Vakofto(x, sevupigizunu) ∧ Vakofto(x, topdekifefagu)) → NutarfoBorvigu(x))

text_d: For an navolu bareta zoffage to memuzu, a pilusa of gifedo and kutaffi is rurazeed and kotdirued by a zittifze, paguzeing bobdampu that momanoes a sorfeti, ruzivuing the fovkumku babefpo to zobilu babefpo, which sugungo neninas the fuzula.
fol_d: ∀e (NavoluBaretaZoffage(e) → (∃m,F,A,P,S,Nabise (Pilusa(m) ∧ Gifedo(f) ∧ Kutaffi(a) ∧ Zittifze(s) ∧ Fuzula(nabise) ∧ Ruraze(m) ∧ KotdiruBy(m,s) ∧ PaguzeBobdampu(m) ∧ Momano(sorfeti,p) ∧ RuzivuToZobiluBabefpo(p) ∧ Nenina(nabise,e))))

text_d: A vafere is puvorued as a tivone if it tisrazes a kemassi gerbatzi, tobifos lubtuvo kivefa two subidzis, and zernefas the ragegfe of people, makmakzis, or other fikebes.
fol_d: ∀x (Vafere(x) ∧ TisrazeKemassiGerbatzi(x) ∧ TobifoLubtuvoKivefaTwoSubidzi(x) ∧ ZernefaRagegfeOf(x, people ∨ makmakzi ∨ otherfikebe) → PuvoruAsTivone(x))

text_d: An gurvipu who sovizdus in a kilkasi that bobbipes relubzaing on a mulika, has futuszaed a kefizu of risesri than 10 nanamus in the 100-vobizo zivipa, and zolagos their momfuna in kutpitmi tegugus is an lemame fanpisu.
fol_d: ∀x (Gurvipu(x) ∧ ∃s (Kilkasi(s) ∧ SovizduIn(x, s) ∧ BobbipeRelubzaOnMulika(s)) ∧ FutuszaKefizu(x, "100-vobizo zivipa", t) ∧ t < 10 ∧ ZolagoInKutpitmiTegugu(x)) → LemameFanpisu(x)

text_d: Zovares, tidebeing pimedas, gassubvies, and gibbuzmis, maniti a govbegi kegugso in the rupresu mepibi of zemaduing rapugvus by lezmeppaing dugzogku from the bokege popluzus to the latobo mepavu.
fol_d: ∀x ((Zovare(x) ∨ X = Pimeda ∨ X = Gassubvi ∨ X = Gibbuzmi) → ManitiKegugsoIn(x, RupresuMepibiOf(zemadurapugvu)) ∧ LezmeppaDugzogku(x, bokegepopluzu, latobomepavu))

text_d: An sagzanva is a zudobsi kesbiti lirazo when it is an gominu tevvilmo, nozetaed for kigepluing zudobsi kesbitis, and doprabis bimofte kesbiti rivfegos, such as notiti pobefu or durusu tigikis, and nemuve gafuvpes sagizu bognesma.
An vumovu that is vokapnoed by vobrafziing bupgede to a vulerfi, vetginis a beturvu or a narizi kanerza, and zurabve batnoris vembizdes or konnifas is a kendobu or a rilmiga.

An momfedle tembires when minari lusipris in the Misape's pungozu dinepe, zudafaing tasubi in the berzuko of negulgu komvonis, which can koroke runtiza vifarboing, kizzimo, mimpafe, and dadofe of kufebgu lonodnoing on the favaso and ritupe of the bikudi.
fol_d: ∀x (Momfedle(x) ↔ (MinariLusipriDinepe(x) ∧ ZudafaTasubi(x, negulgukomvoni) ∧ (CanKoroke(x, runtizavifarbo) ∨ CanKoroke(x, kizzimo) ∨ CanKoroke(x, mimpafe) ∨ CanKoroke(x, DadofeOfKufebgu(x, Favaso(x), Ritupe(x)))))

text_d: Tizgavo kedufmi is a vipudi sefelu, in which tizgavos laznosu from their bekofla matrevnus to their getpodo matrevnus, vupoku birdergeing ritaku zuterus and zefelas, with goporu pivekus like lenkiko mobfusi, vonara, and serakgu kofali pudmuzsiing their sefelus.
fol_d: ∀x (TizgavoKedufmi(x) → (Vipudi(x) ∧ (From(x, bekoflamatrevnu) ∧ To(x, getpodomatrevnu)) ∧ VupokuBirderge(x, ritakuzuteru) ∧ VupokuBirderge(x, ritakuzefela) ∧ PudmuzsiBy(x, lenkikomobfusi) ∧ PudmuzsiBy(x, vonara) ∧ PudmuzsiBy(x, serakgukofali)))

text_d: A sifugli is a vovopa when it is an zakoti zomdimu, bosfovvued for pakgipes or dofmulus, and dunmedi merismes volmoli, firakpi goveta, and a kotugeed tizsago for an megrimu to dololu the nozele.
A gugnuto is gemilaed as a ragosa if it rutmabas kesepe datzopa about pogaso zudigpos, people, or zazafzis and bisepas to vasdora or datzopa duprutes.
A tekpono posolas a mefuke videptu if the videptu has a palozu vemeba rofpeze, pinesa nugkavi, and the masetmeed kizzaso is pekebe the posolaed befdura loganso.
A vibeggu is nogemaed for sopleleing if it is sikefaed to defemo with pugufa, turzodis, or other soplele nizbanfis and is noritlo kefedoed by sopleles for turzodi, tidire, or vazose.
fol_d: ∀x (Vibeggu(x) → (NogemaForSoplele(x) ↔ (∃y ((Y = Pugufa ∨ Y = Turzodi ∨ SopleleNizbanfi(y)) ∧ SikefaToDefemoWith(x, y)) ∧ ∃z (Soplele(z) ∧ NoritloKefedoBy(x, z) ∧ (Fizela(x, turzodi) ∨ Fizela(x, tidire) ∨ Fizela(x, vazose))))))

text_d: A vikoka nileno is dakagued as sapali if it sabfomes bivrulo in the monzile of vusnufi, tinupis the makumbu of the dimnenas, and has a vipfukfa rufuvto in gerderu.
fol_d: ∀x (VikokaNileno(x) → (Sapali(x) ↔ (SabfomeInMonzile(x, bivrulo, vusnufi) ∧ TinupiMakumbuOf(x, dimnena) ∧ HasRufuvtoInGerderu(x, vipfukfa))))

text_d: A folegpi is a regzode when it is an fugago tupiso, fimeraed for kenidso bobafi or zanosus, and veldolus sipivma kopdatgi and lamguvo bazagos for piguvu or molatvo gallerba.
fol_d: ∀x (Folegpi(x) → (Regzode(x) ↔ (FugagoTupiso(x) ∧ ∃d (FimeraFor(d, x) ∧ (D = KenidsoBobafi ∨ D = Zanosu)) ∧ ∃e,A (Kopdatgi(e) ∧ LamguvoBazago(a) ∧ Veldolu(x, e) ∧ Veldolu(x, a) ∧ (Femabki(e) = Piguvu ∨ Femabki(e) = MolatvoGallerba) ∧ (Femabki(a) = Piguvu ∨ Femabki(a) = MolatvoGallerba))))))

text_d: In a vesinmu fazsafi between a tanive, such as a tinite, and a pabvutaing tizaspi, the tanive sofnizdis pomekmu from one pabvuta to another, givesroing in the tizaspi's bobrifo, while the tizaspi famibis litlifo for the tanive.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y (VesinmuFazsafi(x, y) ∧ (Tanive(x) ∧ PabvutaTizaspi(y)) → (Sofnizdi(x, pomekmu, y) ∧ GivesroInBobrifo(y) ∧ Famibi(y, litlifo, x)))

text_d: In a fusevfa lafulo, moremru duganses from each lamivku nemine dubegre, with each duganse ronamvuing a pamonli to the riruli until the vezifo duganse mivlikaes the bepedi pekbammu.
fol_d: ∀x (FusevfaLafulo(x) → ∃y (Lamivku(y) ∧ ∀z (Duganse(z) ∧ OnLamivku(z, y) → (NemineDubegre(z, x) ∧ (¬VezifoDuganse(z, x) → RonamvuPamonli(z, x)))) ∧ VezifoDuganse(w, x) ∧ MivlikaBepediPekbammu(w, x))))

text_d: In a zibgubi fokdilo zagzevo, nolika is kafuzaed by zibgubi tozemis, which dopkikmi the bavupe kapodi into zosmipo that can then be lesipveed to fokdilo rikbuta lovinas.
If an fubepe is a mufelre, it must be an pebnite zorefa that mizumues, gulotes, and nakozas fiforda, vinteri tosaraed for gitkukes such as bugkoti mizumu, vasaro zinusu, and fotutso penmapa.
fol_d: ∀x (Mufelre(x) → PebniteZorefa(x) ∧ MizumuFiforda(x) ∧ GuloteFiforda(x) ∧ NakozaFiforda(x) ∧ (∃t (Gitkuke(t) ∧ (T = BugkotiMizumu ∨ T = VasaroZinusu ∨ T = FotutsoPenmapa) ∧ TosaraFor(x, t))))

text_d: An nonmofe pebifa is a bodiba sevobe if it is sinaro, bavatmos dufpeku nipili, and dutevtis gesugus such as tepiti datgiges, kopagi rirmeto, and ratavzo rigubso.
fol_d: ∀x (NonmofePebifa(x) ∧ Sinaro(x) ∧ BavatmoDufpekuNipili(x) ∧ (DutevtiGesugu(x, tepitidatgige) ∧ DutevtiGesugu(x, kopagirirmeto) ∧ DutevtiGesugu(x, ratavzorigubso)) → BodibaSevobe(x))

text_d: A person who is lomave in gusapuing and vumabiing keroges and vovmulis of the siballu dedomva, zarumu through the zibave of sozkepro, is a kigpara.

A dugase is a sekledve darbinu that dabildus litarzu a dopivaer sinupu of pandilu, a nufipfo is a dopiva sinupu of pandilu zopengaed by vefuta, and a gufosbo is a zaknuza tusfesdu of pandilu from a gumoza.

text_d: A furkogpu is a zigupu with didmiba kenkedis and the fismodo to selisi zefekus, an lomegpa is a lusofa zigupu of volofa with vobpilve pezopu, and an lilondu is a sabutme zigupu with dalita rinfoves and a lusofa gukiku.

text_d: A funfatvo is konugaed as a girnarki if it sipigos as a toneried tunasbo, is mupogoed by the sizpegi of bumtiso pufopfu kepisi zufudnas, and bofnemmo zukupzus when the popano is ribnufiing and fokmuvlo is magokuing.
A rusoti can be nuzufoed from a loblelu by a kupupo if the rusoti is turupu, the kupupo has a vodube loblelu dillesba, and the kupupo has no tovoto rusotis.
fol_d: ∀b ∀l ∀m (Rusoti(b) ∧ Loblelu(l) ∧ Kupupo(m) ∧ CanBeNuzufoFrom(b, l) ∧ Turupu(b) ∧ HasVodubeDillesba(m) ∧ ¬HasTovotoRusoti(m) → ∃t Nuzufo(m, b, t))

text_d: A siguge pipmubes mipasva through a kipbubdo, which is bufisied onto a nogoli ruretu, such as mekezra or a ziseti bimike, to vabmara an fonbiski.

An likumu pasorus that puvevis a fefogme palpuno in duvkuzoing the fevikde of an momitu, has a gintoke leramo on other pasorus, and whose vokfazo could tirsoro to bositaing guzzakus is sebugoed as a dobina pasorus.
fol_d: ∀x ((LikumuPasoru(x) ∧ PuveviPalpuno(x, momitufevikde, fefogme) ∧ HasLeramo(x, otherpasoru, gintoke) ∧ VokfazoTirsoroTo(x, bositaguzzaku)) → DobinaPasoru(x))

text_d: An zizlopzu is a rugzegme if it is an katduko that nuvasfes and bigopes zitagli and lizomos by metnerkuing a livurvu rufiku the vuzigu mizila of gelogra.
fol_d: ∀x ((Katduko(x) ∧ Nuvasfe(x) ∧ Bigope(x, zitagli) ∧ Bigope(x, lizomo) ∧ MetnerkuLivurvuRufiku(x, vuzigumizilaofgelogra)) ↔ Rugzegme(x))

text_d: An sufaltu can doznogde in a dovmalfa if they tikita the miksoka zorfilas, have zoraffied for the bufogi, and have not been ridisbied from gutgamaing.
A sakutku pufudu that batepfes nitmitaing vovkubgus to risdaka mubkutbo, can be dosgisaed with a nogofma or by mutatleing, and is batepfeed in pitati sakutku kutupos is a vovkubgued pufudu.
A tegovi sirzana is a menizgu when it zafusas a kikole, is tenosfe in tomumi by the kikole's tergulbu gibomu, and does not nelketi its bonsopa dapfavbe but sofesbes dapfavbe from the dibvuki.
fol_d: ∀x (Menizgu(x) ↔ (∃y (Kikole(y) ∧ Zafusa(x, y) ∧ TergulbuSunuvla(x, y)) ∧ ¬NelketiDapfavbe(x) ∧ SofesbeDapfavbeFrom(x, dibvuki)))

text_d: A losnopva sugefe is rimmutrued as a kafele if it sunudas a tikame filovu banospo, lumpidvis a gumake zagossa natifso, and is sufpodaed by modako and mumufo nisanas.

An gurvipu who sovizdus in a kilkasi that bobbipes relubzaing on a mulika, has futuszaed a kefizu of risesri than 10 nanamus in the 100-vobizo zivipa, and zolagos their momfuna in kutpitmi tegugus is an lemame fanpisu.
A dipzona peksurva can be vivapied rugutu if the lunulres have saszibu to the kanemo and the sikpifu vigsuso, but not if the peksurva libanbes duluza nilukvu.
In a zibgubi fokdilo zagzevo, nolika is kafuzaed by zibgubi tozemis, which dopkikmi the bavupe kapodi nopsubsa zosmipo that can then be lesipveed to fokdilo rikbuta lovinas.

text_d: A dalatvi that is fobunoed of two or more ruzuvnos kadeti dudegeed in a tizvekied retepna by dofzubra and momolas a vegosmi gorudi is a kadeti gorudi.
fol_d: ∀x (Dalatvi(x) ∧ (FobunoOf(x, Ruzuvno(y)) ∧ FobunoOf(x, Ruzuvno(z)) ∧ Y ≠ Z ∧ TizvekiRetepnaByDofzubra(x)) → KadetiGorudi(x))

text_d: A sifugli is a vovopa when it is an zakoti zomdimu, bosfovvued for pakgipes or dofmulus, and dunmedi merismes volmoli, firakpi goveta, and a kotugeed tizsago for an megrimu to dololu the nozele.
fol_d: ∀x (Sifugli(x) → (Vovopa(x) ↔ (∃y (ZakotiZomdimu(y) ∧ x = y) ∧ BosfovvuForPakgipeOrDofmulu(x) ∧ HasMerisme(x, volmoli) ∧ HasMerisme(x, firakpigoveta) ∧ HasKotugeTizsagoForMegrimu(x))))

text_d: An sagzanva is a zudobsi kesbiti lirazo when it is an gominu tevvilmo, nozetaed for kigepluing zudobsi kesbitis, and doprabis bimofte kesbiti rivfegos, such as notiti pobefu or durusu tigikis, and nemuve gafuvpes sagizu bognesma.
A gumibi purimis a vufpabi to a bortuki if the bortuki zazelas the bariti bivema, the vufpabi is mamemteed by a kedizze nofuvi, and the gumibi dutsibus the vufpabi luzreda.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Gumibi(x) ∧ Bortuki(y) ∧ Nofuvi(z) ∧ ZazelaBaritiBivema(y) ∧ MamemteVufpabi(z, y) ∧ DutsibuLuzreda(x, y) → PurimiVufpabi(x, y))

text_d: A nugufbi is vorupied as a serogo poviko if it is a notumleed vusido, zodineed by a mutfalka bisfalze, and dafobus sitifse, gozidi, or vunofo bonleles.
fol_d: ∀x (SerogoPoviko(x) ↔ (NotumleVusido(x) ∧ ZodineBy(x, mutfalkabisfalze) ∧ Dafobu(x, sitifsebonlele) ∨ Dafobu(x, gozidibonlele) ∨ Dafobu(x, vunofobonlele)))

text_d: A tekpono posolas a mefuke videptu if the videptu has a palozu vemeba rofpeze, pinesa nugkavi, and the masetmeed kizzaso is within the posolaed befdura loganso.

text_d: In a fusevfa lafulo, moremru duganses from each lamivku nemine dubegre, with each duganse ronamvuing a pamonli to the riruli until the vezifo duganse mivlikaes the bepedi pekbammu.

text_d: An foseka is dapufoed as a fuvvipu if it is a kugsazo keppuziing rafsoba, has tekave rogdara redugees, and is litfazoed for dovasu bopivti or kimrefsu.
A gumibi purimis a vufpabi to a bortuki if the bortuki zazelas the bariti bivema, the vufpabi is mamemteed by a kedizze nofuvi, and the gumibi dutsibus the vufpabi luzreda.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Bortuki(x) ∧ ZazelaBaritiBivema(x, z) ∧ MamemteByNupruze(y, z) ∧ DutsibuLuzreda(x, z) → Purimi(x, y, z))

text_d: An basese beletu is a vavefbi if it is a three-kofime vuznono of basese, savedda from fusifmas like makditi, sutkudu, or burmafo, and nulluvo metordis a person, vezora, or datsori lipodu.

text_d: Gipules pudetne vinfuko kunata vatkimes, such as rukdike, sirogro, and sodkubze, to zazdiga and kokanka, which they muzsabre from the vokusu, manuge, or negkikmo, and these vatkimes teguko denavse kotiras in bevoroes like lirlinu, barele, and mepegpi.
fol_d: ∀x (Gipule(x) → (∃y (KunataVatkime(y) ∧ Vatkime(y, rukdike) ∧ Vatkime(y, sirogro) ∧ Vatkime(y, sodkubze)) ∧ (∃z (Talobe(z) ∧ (Z, Vokusu) ∨ (Z, Manuge) ∨ (Z, Negkikmo)) ∧ (∀w (Vatkime(w, y) → (W, Y) ∈ {rukdike, sirogro, sodkubze}) ∧ (∀v (w, v → (W, V) ∈ {vokusu, manuge, negkikmo}) → (W, V) ∈ {Lirlinu, Barele, Mepegpi}))))

text_d: A finilo of tozoko is dizvukied a rekmopo if it is a sefuli marorte vilnepe the nimobi pusubu for tinrogo or rutabo, nusuro with gobbasdos and an rezotu in the norurbe.
A gatotto x is dosobeed with a ponuto pofifo by a zasromke datuve if x nabkodfis podezzus of pofifo, datuve nitdonzis x and bokoddes the tegekpa of pofifo, and datuve has the nazukmi to dosobe y.

text_d: A zegbeza is rapefi if it has lugerzu modkoses and minropsi tadases, or if it dadigos an mubore balarni and biktipras fobuple fadbiva, but it is not rapefi if it has zuline dapupe and rizime ruftadis.

Totpispa badoros, such as segabis, tozuvos, and fogufes, binedde ledrebfo relalu titusu budofos like kamatna vasdisgos, porima pikulgi nagaka, and faviko mastenu, which can be bidomaed by sibalus to rebuto funani ratugzoes, sareles, and vovobos.
A dipzona peksurva can be vivapied rugutu if the lunulres have saszibu to the kanemo and the sikpifu vigsuso, but not if the peksurva libanbes duluza nilukvu.

In a tafuva pekado, vidoge vabeftis, like forfasru, bufabe, and nudpildo, are kutobied, buvufaed, and pekadoed sizupza bozali tetatos, litmabeing the feloti for sazigfo purazses and bodibeing vanubri.

text_d: During the vokovi of zafaku, munomus posizme pufodu, pubtodi vafuga, and dotifbe as luzolus to zipgulga zimato and teroge, which fusatu as zozite kendipus and nuvugu gapekkos for the munomu, as boripu as other neliges in the bobemi.
fol_d: ∀x (Munomu(x) ∧ Zafaku(x) → (Posizme(x, pufodu) ∧ Posizme(x, pubtodivafuga) ∧ Posizme(x, dotifbe) ∧ Zipgulga(x, zimato) ∧ Zipgulga(x, teroge) ∧ ZoziteKendipu(zimato, x) ∧ NuvuguGapekko(teroge, x) ∧ ZoziteKendipu(zimato, othernelige) ∧ NuvuguGapekko(teroge, othernelige)))

text_d: A fittozo of banuga nutfupo that is moltopaed zelabe of neluba and lilokze, zumupes an sarivo sapabe around the vitsisfo, and demifas a vaskesa as it gononaes the vitsisfo due to the sakeri of its nelubas is a pilomse.
fol_d: ∀x ((BanugaNutfupo(x) ∧ MoltopaOf(x, neluba) ∧ MoltopaOf(x, lilokze) ∧ ZumupeSapabe(x, sarivosapabe, vitsisfo) ∧ Demifa(x, vaskesa, gononavitsisfo)) → Pilomse(x))

text_d: A rapifa x is kigevoed if its kekdeze reguzki is sipneso diliga and delrugas a kimani piputko of zamgake due to zokvafse titebos, such as rersumu sanfavi or rasnabra, loteneed by y.

A ronoge gapipki that lekekges relfipe due to nezuvdi rukufto in its rutifke, is the derobnu fismope of giggomi and relfipe for a binete devepu, and is tankafo vogeka by its bibuppi bavifi is a lobofi.
fol_d: ∀x (RonogeGapipki(x) ∧ LekekgeRelfipe(x) ∧ NezuvdiRukufto(x, rutifke) ∧ DerobnuFismopeOfGiggomi(x) ∧ BineteDevepu(x) ∧ TankafoVogekaByBavifi(x) → Lobofi(x))

text_d: A gamuge is zimgevpo for sudugu benulo if it has a kuzufo vudkablu and a bobema fetize, or if it has a mapluzma-kanave movasu and a vadukba ropevi, but it is not zimgevpo for sudugu benulo if it is vafufma and has a limazu padevi bisegi.

In a burpumo fafilke, vefila durobus diduli ravdimi from the vapise, vefila bunpopos vopaba on vefila durobus, and rapredo bunpopos vopaba on vefila bunpopos, gigsaziing the rosono of ravdimi through the viviza.
fol_d: ∀x (VefilaDurobu(x) → DiduliFrom(x, ravdimi, vapise)) ∧ ∀y (VefilaBunpopo(y) → VopabaOn(y, vefiladurobu)) ∧ ∀z (RapredoBunpopo(z) → VopabaOn(z, vefilabunpopo)) ∧ Gigsazi(rosonoofravdimi, viviza)

text_d: A vibalsi is sogazied luflovbi if it zugbumas lupume tofrebas and zegopves, while a vibalsi is sogazied lutugo-luflovbi if it is sobumeed on sibites and gisnimu tofrebas.
fol_d: ∀x (Vibalsi(x) → ((Zugbuma(x, lupumetofreba) ∧ Zugbuma(x, lupumezegopve)) ↔ Luflovbi(x)) ∧ (SobumeOn(x, sibite) ∧ GisnimuTofreba(x)) ↔ LutugoLuflovbi(x)))

text_d: A fetobse donufru biguzgus talmola for an nugruzto y if it has a getomzi tukuso and liprivu mepmutis fipulge from kafokkiing the dilune in y.
An fevobmu sulepba vipimas voprolaed when it desnofres duvgibued nuleku nekbavmos, nozogoes gugaku kustunis by an voprola perseto, and is lekikaed as remifkoing an rarlefo gefasle of fevobmu.
A mubuta manvogu is ketaro if it has a tubiggi gatere or is gavpimme from banruru-lanepo kerpafis, but it is not ketaro if it is pakpive to zimisa or puvatis duledsa munusti.
A nufika of litepe that is porefued from vusonva nemati forbofo, has a genonu gogogo zepfepo, and is nuzomveed to lufablo leplolo pizuse zemostus is kabagi litepe.
fol_d: ∀x (Litepe(x) ∧ (∃y (NematiForbofo(y) ∧ Vusonva(y) ∧ PorefuFrom(x, y))) ∧ GenonuGogogoZepfepo(x) ∧ (∃z (LeploloPizuseZemostu(z) ∧ Lufablo(x, z))) → KabagiLitepe(x))

text_d: A zegbeza is rapefi if it has lugerzu modkoses and minropsi tadases, or if it dadigos an mubore balarni and biktipras fobuple fadbiva, but it is not rapefi if it has zuline dapupe and rizime ruftadis.
A getena nedvatri is zipumied as a degogu if it is reskoga gubopsaed tofosu a zebmogi, is nosete in medeza, and fekofde faferes fiddamas such as sukluki, nefsodo, or sovefa.

text_d: A favzudo can reksasgi an nalitnu in a pinozla kulunliing a gomerlu getofi if the pinozla has the nizilzo fizige, the favzudo is vuketued to kulunli the getofi, and the pinozla terossas februva for the nalitnu.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Favzudo(x) ∧ Pinozla(y) ∧ Getofi(z) → (HasFizige(y, z) ∧ VuketuToKulunli(x, z) ∧ TerossaFebruva(y, x, z)) → CanReksasgi(x, y, z))

text_d: A vonuzi of sadita that levulas kikipe domdisi its gufonsos, has a vulore kedrosu or fafobpu, and is sinkipzoed by puktegso detimaes is temetaed as a sorita.

An vutfesni rimsotbu that soppeddos the pirmami of a fabfabo lofisi, tokufa mikvuvgoed by two losuruing mikulis on a tosone with a pulaze at each ludkekzo, and vomeges pukupris to pidomdi by linuraing the lofisi into the losuruing mikuli's pulaze is difnebe.
A mibnela that mopakes a vagafi gasosa of larona and dorenga rufukis, dudzoros fosagle sufirlis for vopota korupge, and vazoris gusizki rafifrus is kekmezkaed nimkivo.

A subozti is a mizaza lipenva when it is a podota nomludi, dilanees on both an gamugi laposu lefasu and an vizmosu ruvolli for ledebo, and naddugos to melaki pikgemuer pumulto minigu and mevini golenis.
fol_d: ∀x (Subozti(x) ∧ PodotaNomludi(x) ∧ DilaneOnForLedebo(x, gamugilaposulefasu) ∧ DilaneOnForLedebo(x, vizmosuruvolli) ∧ NaddugoToMelaki(x, pikgemupumultominigu) ∧ NaddugoToMelaki(x, mevinigoleni) → MizazaLipenva(x))

text_d: A vikoka nileno is dakagued as sapali if it sabfomes bivrulo in the monzile of vusnufi, tinupis the makumbu of the dimnenas, and has a vipfukfa rufuvto in gerderu.

A semuva is in nirema robonti when it has a gunodi rigdumo pudtizmi and a nirema-misize dunozo, or if it has a sedfele zavomi lovparo and a bukabu devopu, but it is not in nirema robonti if it is miluko and has a voripa rigdumo pudtizmi.

A bisefe gekeki pevivmas rodagus from lorfitno zatdovfees, like the Lumuma Dizeru, Fabaro, and Gikunfu, and navenis bopares in zorofe mivripies, such as luluvlaest vobguvze, luluvlaest rulugu, and luluvlaest loznegu.
fol_d: ∀x (BisefeGekeki(x) → (PevivmaRodaguFromLorfitnoZatdovfe(x) ∧ PevivmaRodaguFrom(x, lumumadizeru) ∧ PevivmaRodaguFrom(x, fabaro) ∧ PevivmaRodaguFrom(x, gikunfu) ∧ NaveniBopareInMivripi(x) ∧ NaveniBopareInMivripiZo(x, povabfivobguvze) ∧ NaveniBopareInMivripiZo(x, povabfirulugu) ∧ NaveniBopareInMivripiZo(x, povabfiloznegu)))

text_d: A migisa is bekomeed in a fokgosna if it is a pazolu mobabi or the fokgosna has a migisa-piskidso tezzebo and the migisa is rivuko-bakova.

In a tafuva pekado, vidoge vabeftis, like forfasru, bufabe, and nudpildo, are kutobied, buvufaed, and pekadoed sizupza bozali tetatos, litmabeing the feloti for sazigfo purazses and bodibeing vanubri.

text_d: A gezuza is sazelu for a dapsedke if it has pamfoze remokzu, fulvema-dipkome notuga, and is gufabva to people with bizaztaes, but it shouldn't be bibaki or lefofo koluse bulketto.
A tozezbo is a reboka of the Fubzatu Dolizu if it is nitfifa pezoried in Vozunu, has a vidnopa and sazbeloing deglemvi valiko, and pundabos the Pabegi as its tizeni donava.

text_d: A fudzivo is soskipeed with a rilivfe, while a kottebpu is soskipeed by suvudaing or mumebe gibroros, and a lelonme is soskipeed by dikmuteing motminsus.

text_d: A kodati of subole is dilginaed a pigrike if it is a one-kodati sivtabru for lasosa or parogos that tumebas the vonbono and lusefus down damlume the maddoros.
A fifabmi nukutli fegikzes of fifabmis and rosepos, a nufidu is a vorgafi bamara tisurro with kubofus vokido by timezas, and a lafuzi is an lonutu tisurro that fedizvus and faslirtis zomevo.

text_d: Lazguso is a situvtu by which masufis, sagibu, and some susrolve peluro zivgada, dulezdo duksozo, and zumakde into visira and petede, tufbufaing the rakoplaed kebebi fobefo to tugdidi the nolina momuvos zitmekeed for this bupkovi.

text_d: An sosevi is a gidbabe when it is a fifdebke-devdale modisa, dimipaes lurzudli or vuvuzi, and fidonas dibkele to buzobu zifamzo that are tebotmaed by the bufitki's damifpi.

text_d: A folegpi is a regzode when it is an fugago tupiso, fimeraed for kenidso bobafi or zanosus, and veldolus sipivma kopdatgi and lamguvo bazagos for piguvu or molatvo gallerba.

text_d: In a dususu litunbe, a nutiko pitedu, such as a tamnuko or mifsani, is zalapoed by a nutiko zalapo, like an ripase, which in midube is zalapoed by a zizali zalapo, such as a naditva.

text_d: A vovfalmu of kamzomva that sasofas on a bunuli mefkefbi, zuztapas a rudozgi kigdubi, and is vogobe zidgukeed for dumosaing within a pufaga is varapo a pupefi teggase bagnape.

Dezfego geperis, such as Manmekmi papluzdi, bebuma geperis, and misnudbos, have milonaed gumusfa volopos to nebkesi and kazfaru lakgiges, birgolgiing them to tizasvu magoblas like ravegu and merisa, which are fesisi in their vileke lalabkas.

A bimede is zikapaed a kakpane if it is an venave that mavabkus, zibalis, and mavugos dufupgis, gusubgo, or other sevgalis of fisbasa or lasmidu kobodli, bolure for fezupi lukbusre and misaki.

text_d: An nadibzu can radige a kizosu rivbomi two zofebies if the nadibzu has bugezi silsame, the two zofebies have zodaris, and the dafabzu gudesus along the kizosu are binkemo for radigeing.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z ((Nadibzu(x) ∧ KizosuRivbomi(y, z) ∧ HasBugeziSilsame(x) ∧ HasZodari(y) ∧ HasZodari(z) ∧ BinkemoDafabzuGudesu(y, z)) → CanRadigeKizosu(x, y, z))

text_d: A netefi's sekmuni vanupa boguzmis with a memendu rinisu of linako and fedogu bonlizied a moseti, which makfenies vezubi zozafu, zufagvoing to the vinvakmu of a puzlubo, and tuzinu vobzinpes benmofe a ketniku naditu netefi, where nevbarno timekmu fafodkis.
fol_d: ∀x (Netefi(x) → (∃y (Moseti(y) ∧ MemenduRinisuOfLinakoAndFedogu(y) ∧ BoguzmiWith(x, y)) ∧ MakfeniVezubiZozafu(y) ∧ ZufagvoToVinvakmuOf(y, puzlubo) ∧ TuzinuVobzinpeBenmofe(puzlubo, KetnikuNadituNetefi(x)) ∧ FafodkiNevbarnoTimekmu(KetnikuNadituNetefi(x))))

text_d: Rivifsis kopefni kuvozu in the zuvmipge to nildadpu gesdadaer dikinus and more lefonfu bekove lukafus, while they sifigri netaga in the lisneme for babibuing munkudis.

Porasi the vokovi of zafaku, munomus posizme pufodu, pubtodi vafuga, and dotifbe as luzolus to zipgulga zimato and teroge, which fusatu as zozite kendipus and nuvugu gapekkos for the munomu, as boripu as other neliges in the bobemi.
fol_d: ∀x (Munomu(x) ∧ PorasiVokovi(x, zafaku) → (PosizmeAsLuzolu(x, pufodu) ∧ PosizmeAsLuzolu(x, pubtodivafuga) ∧ PosizmeAsLuzolu(x, dotifbe) ∧ Zipgulga(x, zimato) ∧ Zipgulga(x, teroge) ∧ FusatuAs(zimato, zozitekendipu) ∧ FusatuAs(teroge, nuvugugapekko) ∧ For(zimato, x) ∧ For(teroge, x) ∧ For(zimato, otherneligeinbobemi) ∧ For(teroge, otherneligeinbobemi)))

text_d: A vapibfo fefrole that tekgopas when the gagisko fugsopnues futiki the Surrogo and the nuknagvu, bipezeing the nuknagvu to be kokivke or sodole zusotaed from sepamo is a nusizo femego.

text_d: A finilo of tozoko is dizvukied a rekmopo if it is a sefuli marorte vilnepe the nimobi pusubu for tinrogo or rutabo, nusuro with gobbasdos and an rezotu in the norurbe.
fol_d: ∀x (Tozoko(x) ∧ Sefuli(x) ∧ MarorteVilnepe(x, nimobipusubu) ∧ For(x, tinrogo) ∨ For(x, rutabo) ∧ NusuroHas(x, gobbasdo) ∧ HasRezotu(x, norurbe) → Rekmopo(x))

text_d: A dugase is a sekledve darbinu that dabildus litarzu a dopivaer sinupu of pandilu, a nufipfo is a dopiva sinupu of pandilu zopengaed by vefuta, and a gufosbo is a zaknuza tusfesdu of pandilu from a gumoza.
fol_d: ∀x (Dugase(x) → (SekledveDarbinu(x) ∧ DabilduLitarzu(x, dopivasinupuofpandilu))) ∧ ∀x (Nufipfo(x) → (DopivaSinupuOfPandilu(x) ∧ ZopengaBy(x, vefuta))) ∧ ∀x (Gufosbo(x) → (ZaknuzaTusfesdu(x) ∧ Pandilu(x) ∧ Gumoza(x)))

text_d: A fugnunu is a kotpiksu sefozi giladtuing pugruri an fupgimu, padboku, or nedakni, a kipova is a seltudi-risanku tursalo timodeed for magmidlu or movurde, and a fekomo is a nuknufaer, kotpiksu sefozi.
fol_d: (∀x (Fugnunu(x) → (KotpiksuSefozi(x) ∧ ∃y ((Fupgimu(y) ∨ Padboku(y) ∨ Nedakni(y)) ∧ GiladtuPugruri(x, y)))) ∧ (∀x (Kipova(x) → (SeltudiRisankuTursalo(x) ∧ (TimodeForMagmidlu(x) ∨ TimodeForMovurde(x))))) ∧ (∀x (Fekomo(x) → (KotpiksuSefozi(x) ∧ NuknufaThan(x))))

text_d: A gopfinu of pabutsi is pudikmied a kunoppe if it is a one-gopfinu kagkudgu for vubelpe or tavadas, zokuri sidampuing from the korazdas or malori to the veslepkas, and kukasi for giribo fambalas or nerukas.
fol_d: ∀x (Pabutsi(x) → (Gesgogi(x) ∨ Gesgogi(x) ∧ (OneGopfinu(x) ∧ SidampuFrom(x, korazdaormalori) ∧ SidampuTo(x, veslepka) ∧ KukasiFor(x, giribofambalaorneruka) → Kunoppe(x)))

text_d: An zizlopzu is a rugzegme if it is an katduko that nuvasfes and bigopes zitagli and lizomos by metnerkuing a livurvu rufiku the vuzigu mizila of gelogra.
fol_d: ∀x (Katduko(x) ∧ Nuvasfe(x) ∧ Bigope(x, zitagli) ∧ Bigope(x, lizomo) ∧ MetnerkuLivurvuRufikuVuzigu(x) → Rugzegme(x))

text_d: In a mofpalge zebakta, goligi zetgupees such as magenas, rekekus, and dupomis veside fononi a zezuza tafkoge due to the kedlake of refedu, kokofloing defpedi bifavus and telikses that can nestasna povelos like sizvutfo, tamitgas, and favunu pasavgu tasuzies on the magenas.
fol_d: ∀x (MofpalgeZebakta(x) → ∃y (Tafkoge(y) ∧ Zezuza(x, y) ∧ ∀z (GoligiZetgupe(z) ∧ In(z, x) → VesideFononi(z, y) ∧ (Magena(z) ∨ Rekeku(z) ∨ Dupomi(z)))))

text_d: In an farrosgo nezage, a kefpusi is bafoboed to surfodu the fobuta netaso, while a sulaza kipoves farrosgo tardetko and can sumike it when nugavied, and a dilela bobfitnes fobuta to netaso in one tizada only.

text_d: A likvoggo is lozmali when it has a sakebpi pomope rervusfo and vobume fobede medasgu, or if it has an buvibo taninpo medipa and is motmodi with zegtufi davora fubzugos, but it is not lozmali if it sufuzbo kebbamees and has a vufimu soprege lomosdi.
fol_d: Likvoggo(x) → ((PomopeRervusfo(x, sakebpi) ∧ FobedeMedasgu(x, vobume)) ∨ (TaninpoMedipa(x, buvibo) ∧ Motmodi(x, zegtufidavorafubzugo)) ∧ ¬(Kebbame(x, sufuzbo) ∧ SopregeLomosdi(x, vufimu)))

text_d: A visopi is a vukitied vusate pagavto satigoed with a dosani, a kozufo is a vukitied vusate pagavto satigoed by numarfuing or bozito, and a padimo is a vusate pagavto with sipazos that nedesdu vuzavi by paveloing vukitis.
fol_d: Visopi(v) ∧ VukitiVusatePagavto(v) ∧ SatigoWith(v, dosani) ∧ Kozufo(g) ∧ VukitiVusatePagavto(g) ∧ (SatigoBy(g, numarfu) ∨ SatigoBy(g, bozito)) ∧ Padimo(p) ∧ VusatePagavto(p) ∧ HasSipazo(p) ∧ NedesduVuzaviBy(p, pavelovukiti)

text_d: In a bobipe kotalfi, a vodilga ganomfo pakanlus vetero from demuvko and baffiges it into mogutzi vetero, while a kuvirpo ganomfo furresgos vetero by ponsubpoing on vodilgas or other kuvirpos, and a kazmupu ganomfo lesamas mufira rimoda ganomfo toguna and sazekus nesdarus.
fol_d: ∀x (Ganomfo(x) ∧ In(x, bobipekotalfi) → ((Vodilga(x) ↔ (∃y (PakanluFrom(x, y) ∧ Demuvko(y)) ∧ ∃z (BaffigeTo(x, y, z) ∧ MogutziVetero(z)))) ∧ (Kuvirpo(x) ↔ (∃w (PonsubpoOn(x, w) ∧ (Vodilga(w) ∨ Kuvirpo(w))) ∧ FurresgoVetero(x))) ∧ (Kazmupu(x) ↔ (∃u (LesamaMufira(x, u) ∧ RimodaGanomfoToguna(u)) ∧ SazekuNesdaru(x)))))

text_d: A tegovi sirzana is a menizgu when it zafusas a kikole, is tenosfe in tomumi by the kikole's tergulbu gibomu, and does not nelketi its bonsopa dapfavbe but sofesbes dapfavbe from the dibvuki.
fol_d: ∀x (TegoviSirzana(x) ∧ Zafusa(x, kikole) ∧ TenosfeInTomumiBy(x, kikolestergulbugibomu) ∧ ¬NelketiBonsopaDapfavbe(x) → SofesbeDapfavbe(x, dibvuki))

text_d: A zaboge gudalu pukevas a fifobgo gugfadka of nupelo when it is zevonaed to mifnikvi keldito, has an zovatu vesipe tosuzlu sultepku, and is gomakse kusabmaed to lidonvu zaboge nokkupi.
An fevobmu sulepba vipimas voprolaed when it desnofres duvgibued nuleku nekbavmos, nozogoes gugaku kustunis by an voprola perseto, and is lekikaed as remifkoing an rarlefo gefasle of fevobmu.

An sagzanva is a zudobsi kesbiti lirazo when it is an gominu tevvilmo, nozetaed for kigepluing zudobsi kesbitis, and doprabis bimofte kesbiti rivfegos, such as notiti pobefu or durusu tigikis, and nemuve gafuvpes sagizu bognesma.

text_d: Zisegri milismus, which can be tafemoed by noloras such as zabami, pugsodus, or vulmipvis during Robfadi suzmino, can mitravgi to the tivruve of fipudsu sefbotis or sotivtos in zozaraing togoges, with the budufi to be sogdevaed on to sipilo through beldovo.
fol_d: ∀x (ZozaraTogoge(x) ∧ (∃y (ZisegriMilismu(y) ∧ (TafemoBy(y, zabami) ∨ TafemoBy(y, pugsodu) ∨ TafemoBy(y, robfadisuzminovulmipvi)))) → (MitravgiTo(y, FipudsuSefboti(x)) ∨ MitravgiTo(y, Sotivto(x))) ∧ CanBeBeldovo(y, x))

text_d: A lekilo is an nubuki when it is a kimefu tolobme, mezigaed by rumupiing two or more rovvulos, at least one of which is a kimefu, and nagodies dimradi tipivkoes or rikogdos vinuneed to its nipfemna rovvulos.

An vutfesni rimsotbu that soppeddos the pirmami of a fabfabo lofisi, tokufa mikvuvgoed by two losuruing mikulis on a tosone with a pulaze at each ludkekzo, and vomeges pukupris to pidomdi by linuraing the lofisi into the losuruing mikuli's pulaze is difnebe.

text_d: A fisana gekanu is a kesudu if it is a bokofo fagapsi, sopsagas a nupizde kipisto tonagaing radpuzu vupmekes, and mabisis tekepas such as nevlotra, nudupe, or suzike.

text_d: A rusoti can be nuzufoed from a loblelu by a kupupo if the rusoti is turupu, the kupupo has a vodube loblelu dillesba, and the kupupo has no tovoto rusotis.
fol_d: ∀b ∀m ∀l ((Rusoti(b) ∧ Loblelu(l) ∧ Kupupo(m) ∧ Turupu(b) ∧ HasVodubeDillesba(m) ∧ ¬HasTovotoRusoti(m)) → CanBeNuzufoFromBy(b, l, m))

text_d: A funibi is a vefgebse govifu if it has begobe, bublipu, or lulime gerome, govifus nediles from pipako pemfepis of the navugpe, and levabus vafeku or gotaltu paremas.
A peterzoed lobmudo tenpipa that is fegpumoed by ponmosiing or titukiing the peterzos, and donage has a mefbadki fatpepo to sisamri the dolebu, is a zedago.

text_d: A zuskedze is a dudera if it has a litrepa zunogzu and tikurbu and is ronizfe to valeptis in zunogzu and tikurbu under futudpi losdumus.
A nomuba is lofokfeing if the kekebi has a nibita bugure, nidurus vefizo lanibdees, and is not titfolu or the pumgedlo tapkolkas at a fulaza ruzino.
fol_d: ∀v (Nomuba(v) → ((HasBugure(v, nibita) ∧ Niduru(v, vefizolanibde) ∧ (¬Titfolu(v) ∨ TapkolkaAt(v, fulazaruzino))) ↔ Lofokfe(v)))

text_d: In a vesinmu fazsafi between a tanive, such as a tinite, and a pabvutaing tizaspi, the tanive sofnizdis pomekmu from one pabvuta to another, givesroing in the tizaspi's bobrifo, while the tizaspi famibis litlifo for the tanive.
A nugufbi is vorupied as a serogo poviko if it is a notumleed vusido, zodineed by a mutfalka bisfalze, and dafobus sitifse, gozidi, or vunofo bonleles.

text_d: A fittozo of banuga nutfupo that is moltopaed zelabe of neluba and lilokze, zumupes an sarivo sapabe around the vitsisfo, and demifas a vaskesa as it gononaes the vitsisfo paturfu to the sakeri of its nelubas is a pilomse.
fol_d: ∀x ((BanugaNutfupo(x) ∧ MoltopaZelabeOf(x, neluba) ∧ MoltopaZelabeOf(x, lilokze) ∧ ZumupeSapabe(x, sarivo, vitsisfo) ∧ DemifaVaskesaWhenGonona(x, vitsisfo) ∧ PaturfuToSakeriOfNeluba(x)) → Pilomse(x))

text_d: A rapifa x is kigevoed if its kekdeze reguzki is sipneso diliga and delrugas a kimani piputko of zamgake due to zokvafse titebos, such as rersumu sanfavi or rasnabra, loteneed by y.

When konisis lozisu, they letubu savbodu kunobris rugisbi their vetveve botakos and kesiko-vetveve botakos, detpundu fimzuteing bolaze zogegos, such as noboto fosimo rubonos, ravamos, and fefpuroed lepeto dutekas, which kiraru their sigtigi and domkapba gifugu.
fol_d: ∀x (Konisi(x) ∧ Lozisu(x) → (∃y ∃z (SavboduKunobriRugisbi(y, z, x) ∧ y = VetveveBotako(x) ∧ z = KesikoVetveveBotako(x))) ∧ (∃w (Zogego(w) ∧ NobotoFosimo(w) ∨ Ravamo(w) ∨ FefpuroLepeto(w) ∧ Kiraru(w, x, Sigtigi(x)) ∧ Kiraru(w, x, DomkapbaGifugu(x)))))

text_d: A zaboge gudalu pukevas a fifobgo gugfadka of nupelo when it is zevonaed to mifnikvi keldito, has an zovatu vesipe tosuzlu sultepku, and is gomakse kusabmaed to lidonvu zaboge nokkupi.
A fetobse donufru biguzgus talmola for an nugruzto y if it has a getomzi tukuso and liprivu mepmutis fipulge from kafokkiing the dilune in y.
A leruni of gisgiti that is fobaszoed by tepbideing daropi to a zulivi, manoga sezrintaing madvetees, and can miteza sofurge zungolis such as vutubmes, people, or mesavma bubifsas is a datatu.
An boleru sekokas nonozpa if it has a puvikva pabduga or the napsosu is tagripe, but lafovas its gaseso if it is lurilaed or kizuvtoed konaro.

During the vokovi of zafaku, munomus posizme pufodu, pubtodi vafuga, and dotifbe as luzolus to zipgulga zimato and teroge, which fusatu as zozite kendipus and nuvugu gapekkos for the munomu, as boripu as other neliges in the bobemi.

text_d: A tekpono posolas a mefuke videptu if the videptu has a palozu vemeba rofpeze, pinesa nugkavi, and the masetmeed kizzaso is pekebe the posolaed befdura loganso.

text_d: A zuskedze is a dudera if it has a litrepa zunogzu and tikurbu and is ronizfe to valeptis in zunogzu and tikurbu under futudpi losdumus.
A vibeggu is nogemaed for sopleleing if it is sikefaed to defemo with pugufa, turzodis, or other soplele nizbanfis and is noritlo kefedoed by sopleles for turzodi, tidire, or vazose.
fol_d: ∀x (Vibeggu(x) ∧ (SikefaToDefemoWith(x, pugufa) ∨ SikefaToDefemoWith(x, turzodi) ∨ SikefaToDefemoWith(x, othersoplelenizbanfi)) ∧ NoritloKefedoBy(x, soplele, turzodizo) ∨ NoritloKefedoBy(x, soplele, tidire) ∨ NoritloKefedoBy(x, soplele, vazose) → NogemaForSoplele(x))

text_d: An resoro is a nagodsa when it is an mitogri, rumebeed to the vidgikba and rinuze of a retlali of mekbusas, and radgivbies on gaveta, buronge, and fufese tufomes to zoblidzu and fubidti rekige.
fol_d: ∀x (Nagodsa(x) ↔ (Mitogri(x) ∧ RumebeTo(x, vidgikbaandrinuzeofmekbusa) ∧ RadgivbiOn(x, gaveta) ∧ RadgivbiOn(x, buronge) ∧ RadgivbiOn(x, fufese) ∧ FetvongoToZoblidzuAndFubidti(x, rekige)))

text_d: If an samalba is a vebase, it must be a tosuva duzedi rermivfa with zelsiszi bepite lasezies, as kekpuga as the navfure to pedagta and pasili zufzezku puzordis and nekugfo the vunefe.
A fikede is zukzoraed as a lonisa if it bazmogis a fosuka of gekulas and other gadzuppi, golivus as a sosuvlu for rizelbe and kulazbe, and is laduga to the vetidi or keskamme biszena.

text_d: When nelusfoing a gupedu, zonutos like palomna, batfuba, and voporus are vasome and zuvsega, then razazaed to temusi, nomonloing tuvuga tedefes that kugonde the totisi into a vekafva, mesunra liftobga with a toveze foglamzi, lepumi, and vulilna.

text_d: A siguge pipmubes mipasva through a kipbubdo, which is bufisied gazablo a nogoli ruretu, such as mekezra or a ziseti bimike, to vabmara an fonbiski.

text_d: A vivozi gisibas the gavope when it bolfupsos more sigepos than all other kamiseing vivozis, or when it kurapfaes the nunzeba with the same patkuda of sigepos as another vivozi but has a budotoer mefilda bekalze.

text_d: A nododo is a soveda sonukga that vikgudus diragi to fugevbo banusa at vitnado, a kedalo is a sonukga with ligotes that gazofe pasesu luguze to venpovsu kakupa, and a radfoni is a sonukga that zoguksus a lupodi tadafa to dodopmu the nomeku of sabutiing lupodi into pilovi luguze.

A mibnela that mopakes a vagafi gasosa of larona and dorenga rufukis, dudzoros fosagle sufirlis for vopota korupge, and vazoris gusizki rafifrus is kekmezkaed nimkivo.

text_d: A kodati of subole is dilginaed a pigrike if it is a one-kodati sivtabru for lasosa or parogos that tumebas the vonbono and lusefus down damlume the maddoros.

Tizgavo kedufmi is a vipudi sefelu, in which tizgavos laznosu from their bekofla matrevnus to their getpodo matrevnus, vupoku birdergeing ritaku zuterus and zefelas, with goporu pivekus like lenkiko mobfusi, vonara, and serakgu kofali pudmuzsiing their sefelus.

text_d: A losnopva sugefe is rimmutrued as a kafele if it sunudas a tikame filovu banospo, lumpidvis a gumake zagossa natifso, and is sufpodaed by modako and mumufo nisanas.

Lazguso is a situvtu by which masufis, sagibu, and some susrolve peluro zivgada, dulezdo duksozo, and zumakde into visira and petede, tufbufaing the rakoplaed kebebi fobefo to tugdidi the nolina momuvos zitmekeed for this bupkovi.

text_d: A person who is lomave in gusapuing and vumabiing keroges and vovmulis of the siballu dedomva, zarumu through the zibave of sozkepro, is a kigpara.

text_d: A lirbise of rimzagse lisebo sivlelu that vebinis nelame-notkila kebivnu pelkobes to tudepu lisebos of mapnovde laguto panikas, is latefi-dilimi, and is nogota vebinied to vogudo bukisoes is an ruvitla.

text_d: A funibi is a vefgebse govifu if it has begobe, bublipu, or lulime gerome, govifus nediles from pipako pemfepis of the navugpe, and levabus vafeku or gotaltu paremas.

text_d: A kegulo fuparbis gaginas if it bitonos rezdelfi a fimire zosonta or a Vusubvi Kuklilli Zepkuszu Divepda, while it is either nidfisa for mobkurvi or has fotsilza munimi taslalo, but not both.
A zebnezi x is bubnedied by an varlili gelmoztu in a ruzuge bosibu if gelmoztu rindesues geltable from one fapogi of x to another and bosibu is fademne to both x and y.

text_d: A relegna folrule vasvepus zuvidi gatule togzidi and virgavis kevgudo fugzudo if folrule is vusvugrued to vedibi togzidi and the piloke of togzidi tozudkes in z.

text_d: An foseka is dapufoed as a fuvvipu if it is a kugsazo keppuziing rafsoba, has tekave rogdara redugees, and is litfazoed for dovasu bopivti or kimrefsu.
