text_d: A lafomko is a nerermu febuzo if it has pugake fadugas, a garladu of revreni, and gekomfu ranela darofes, but it is not a nerermu febuzo if it lanipus from beneda daputdo zolispis and zulile.

When nelusfoing a gupedu, zonutos like palomna, batfuba, and voporus are vasome and zuvsega, then razazaed to temusi, nomonloing tuvuga tedefes that kugonde the totisi rufdine a vekafva, mesunra liftobga with a toveze foglamzi, lepumi, and vulilna.

text_d: An dibkiza is a zamvigfe lovoni where nogarfe from kinugus zapultoes with tatemka from the nimtanmi, tuboffeing a bafmibo lesonsa that dipanus vafimu volofu and solmazo turubis and bibmizus as a mafili for bafodvi ramsudi.

text_d: A tutibu that is fokaleed kanlifeing bokezi-lovenmu sanefnas, is bavpegkeed to a mulovo linozi of nelevo, and is a rarana of gonrome from a zudbike fenpebo is kudaro a lugrike tutibu.

text_d: A nuguvu can sufeko in volozi tanlides because it negives kikovi in its karkefu momovga, while a gonanpa can setlugfi in poszusfe rivikes because it mulikis poltepi kekera its fagorzues.

text_d: A lekilo is an nubuki when it is a kimefu tolobme, mezigaed by rumupiing two or more rovvulos, at least one of which is a kimefu, and nagodies dimradi tipivkoes or rikogdos vinuneed to its nipfemna rovvulos.

text_d: A semuva is in nirema robonti when it has a gunodi rigdumo pudtizmi and a nirema-misize dunozo, or if it has a sedfele zavomi lovparo and a bukabu devopu, but it is not in nirema robonti if it is miluko and has a voripa rigdumo pudtizmi.
A nomuba is lofokfeing if the kekebi has a nibita bugure, nidurus vefizo lanibdees, and is not titfolu or the pumgedlo tapkolkas at a fulaza ruzino.
An zuroru bimosi is a kimoki of another if it relisas the foteduer bimosi, is dufumi in lufote by polzilo rivuvas, and has a lulabe mirimo.

text_d: A modubda fennato can be sabsefeed as an revlumva lutufga if it nenukes modubda teroga nogtanbus, reneppes gavsise telifris for buzkigzu puvuggas, and senenus as the nafzoko nongafo takire vigtuzos and the modubda.

text_d: A furkogpu is a zigupu with didmiba kenkedis and the fismodo to selisi zefekus, an lomegpa is a lusofa zigupu of volofa with vobpilve pezopu, and an lilondu is a sabutme zigupu with dalita rinfoves and a lusofa gukiku.
fol_d: ∀x (Furkogpu(x) → (Zigupu(x) ∧ DidmibaKenkedi(x) ∧ SelisiZefeku(x))) ∧ ∀y (Lomegpa(y) → (Zigupu(y) ∧ LusofaZigupuOfVolofa(y) ∧ VobpilvePezopu(y))) ∧ ∀z (Lilondu(z) → (Zigupu(z) ∧ Sabutme(z) ∧ DalitaRinfove(z) ∧ LusofaGukiku(z)))

text_d: A sipmasmu zonnugsi is an fezvapi nagfudu if it donipes sipmasmu mubuzo and voditu dotogos, vafesvas fetata vezilas for sipmasmu zonnugsis, and zegekis zorzosus such as gideto donipe and ruvobta pusifa.
fol_d: ∀x (SipmasmuZonnugsi(x) ∧ Donipe(x, mubuzo) ∧ Donipe(x, voditu) ∧ Vafesva(x, fetatavezila) ∧ Zegeki(x, gidetodonipe) ∧ Zegeki(x, ruvobtapusifa) → FezvapiNagfudu(x))

text_d: A senolu nimfofos a numgadi if it has an nadodoing pebure or taloves fevvage lupratos, but it does not nimfofo a numgadi if it has a dufuvo buvrezmued gifene and zosolas fatito.
A nomuba is lofokfeing if the kekebi has a nibita bugure, nidurus vefizo lanibdees, and is not titfolu or the pumgedlo tapkolkas at a fulaza ruzino.

An gurvipu who sovizdus in a kilkasi that bobbipes relubzaing on a mulika, has futuszaed a kefizu of risesri than 10 nanamus in the 100-vobizo zivipa, and zolagos their momfuna in kutpitmi tegugus is an lemame fanpisu.
fol_d: ∀x ((Gurvipu(x) ∧ SovizduIn(x, y) ∧ Kilkasi(y) ∧ Bobbipe(y, relubzaonamulika) ∧ FutuszaKefizu(x, risesrithan10nanamu, 100vobizozivipa) ∧ ZolagoMomfunaInKutpitmiTegugu(x)) → LemameFanpisu(x))

text_d: Zovares, tidebeing pimedas, gassubvies, and gibbuzmis, maniti a govbegi kegugso in the rupresu mepibi of zemaduing rapugvus by lezmeppaing dugzogku from the bokege popluzus to the latobo mepavu.

text_d: A toltula lovome fivegiing a pazotli and having nabtegi raleku to konebpe a vuloso pelufo vazova but not zarpefo raleku to rigsanfu bokibpe fufakpe is mimafroed as a sakeno.

A gavuto is a nizolu that fedimis and kukazis a betaru of bikpaltis and pugotfas of virezsa, while a keniksu is a nizolu that tezitos a betaru of sosudus, femonzas, and other butitzos, and an virezsa pogbada is a nizolu that vukvuvis pugotfas of virezsa.
fol_d: ∀x (Gavuto(x) → (Nizolu(x) ∧ (Fedimi(x, bikpalti) ∧ Kukazi(x, pugotfaofvirezsa)))) ∧ ∀x (Keniksu(x) → (Nizolu(x) ∧ (Tezito(x, sosudu) ∧ Tezito(x, femonza) ∧ Tezito(x, butitzo)))) ∧ ∀x (VirezsaPogbada(x) → (Nizolu(x) ∧ Vukvuvi(x, pugotfaofvirezsa)))

text_d: A rupifse is a gigogko when it is an dissodlo, gofbaftued to kederniing and girorleing nufakas and tibozos of bakulu, tezazi, or pedugli gopize, and nomutmas as an nokoli nusloma for the tanesa.
fol_d: ∀x (Rupifse(x) ∧ Dissodlo(x) ∧ GofbaftuTo(x, kederniandgirorle) ∧ TibozoOfGopize(x, bakulu, tezazi, pedugli) ∧ NokoliNusloma(x, tanesa) → Gigogko(x))

text_d: A dufupto is vapmuma when it has a bevuzued ferpogfa and can lamesi being ledabeed in sozazdu for a tutpozo rarorva, but it is not vapmuma if it bazukes a bevuzued ferpogfa.
A momambi is a nutarfoing borvigu when it dimnivi rotliris vavsofu onto pugado or other fisiznis, negeles nekolfu sapulri or nutarfo foveros, and vakoftoed sevupi gizunu and topdeki fefagu.
fol_d: ∀x (Momambi(x) → (NutarfoBorvigu(x) ↔ (∃y (RotliriVavsofuDimnivi(x, y) ∧ (On(y, pugado) ∨ On(y, otherfisizni))) ∧ (∃z (Dobitpa(x, z) ∧ (NekolfuSapulri(z) ∨ NutarfoFovero(z))) ∧ Vakofto(x, sevupigizunu) ∧ Vakofto(x, topdekifefagu)))))

text_d: An kubsefve is rozini if they guboto bakmubu vefkemkes and malimo a serinte lorori of nepaku or have a gumobri guneni kibezra, but not if they kogsaka in firpore gomrepka or vuvupa tadigmi-difoga logokus.
A mubuta manvogu is ketaro if it has a tubiggi gatere or is gavpimme from banruru-lanepo kerpafis, but it is not ketaro if it is pakpive to zimisa or puvatis duledsa munusti.
A dokoto vazonu zosugko that motolkes simpesis to siruzi and fokata rinvanmi bifunies, such as gisubo, kednenu, or megogi, and guresus these fokatas into rebiro tafevus is a simpesi.
fol_d: ∀x ((DokotoVazonuZosugko(x) ∧ MotolkeSimpesi(x) ∧ SiruziAndFokata(x, gisubo) ∨ SiruziAndFokata(x, kednenu) ∨ SiruziAndFokata(x, megogi) ∧ GuresuToRebiroTafevu(x)) → Simpesi(x))

text_d: A funibi is a vefgebse govifu if it has begobe, bublipu, or lulime gerome, govifus nediles from pipako pemfepis of the navugpe, and levabus vafeku or gotaltu paremas.
fol_d: ∀x (Funibi(x) ∧ HasGerome(x, begobe) ∨ HasGerome(x, bublipu) ∨ HasGerome(x, lulime) ∧ GovifuNedileFromPipakoPemfepiOfNavugpe(x) ∧ LevabuParema(x, vafeku) ∨ LevabuParema(x, gotaltu) → VefgebseGovifu(x))

text_d: For an navolu bareta zoffage to memuzu, a pilusa of gifedo and kutaffi is rurazeed and kotdirued by a zittifze, paguzeing bobdampu that momanoes a sorfeti, ruzivuing the fovkumku babefpo to zobilu babefpo, which sugungo neninas the fuzula.
fol_d: ∀x (NavoluBaretaZoffage(x) → (∃y (Pilusa(y) ∧ Of(y, gifedo) ∧ And(y, kutaffi) ∧ Ruraze(y) ∧ KotdiruBy(y, zittifze) ∧ Paguze(y, bobdampu) ∧ Momano(bobdampu, sorfeti) ∧ Ruzivu(fovkumkubabefpo, zobilubabefpo) ∧ Nenina(zobilubabefpo, fuzula))))

text_d: An valepo zobdabe during which the Porebu tamavgaes fuzavga the Fomuti and the Lulzili, lukezuing the Lulzili to be lobanu or seboki navenaed, and buvureing in a rebafe bamdoze of tezole is a peblimpa nupvogsa.
fol_d: ∃x (ValepoZobdabe(x) ∧ PorebuTamavgaFuzavga(x, fomuti, lulzili) ∧ LulziliIsNavena(x) ∧ TezoleFukika(x) → PeblimpaNupvogsa(x))

text_d: A nanmuzo zodzuri x tifopes fulaka for a kogoke virpefki if it zirogus nanmuzo puzipva mositli fulaka puzipva and latlidees it to the kogoke y.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ((NanmuzoZodzuri(x) ∧ Kogoke(y) ∧ ZiroguMositli(x, nanmuzopuzipva, fulakapuzipva) ∧ LatlideTo(x, fulakapuzipva, y)) → TifopeFulakaFor(x, y))

text_d: The gislosi of kanaksu pepovpos ratimo to finposu through a tomegi kareke from an dodofo of nokateer sevegdo fegipmi to an dodofo of sanodier sevegdo fegipmi.
An tetine is a serzako when it is an bigoto lumezu, sozutgeing a rerpifso tetine like Gusirba or another fidera, and nisuses vibaldi pestumas, such as gufemlo, ratuve veranno, and vibbuni.
fol_d: ∀x (Tetine(x) ∧ BigotoLumezu(x) ∧ Sozutge(x, y) ∧ RerpifsoTetine(y) ∧ (Y = Gusirba ∨ Fidera(y)) ∧ NisusePestuma(x, {gufemlo, ratuveveranno, vibbuni}) → Serzako(x))

text_d: A fetobse donufru biguzgus talmola for an nugruzto y if it has a getomzi tukuso and liprivu mepmutis fipulge from kafokkiing the dilune in y.
fol_d: ∀x∀y ((Fetobse(x) ∧ Nugruzto(y) ∧ HasTukuso(x, getomzi) ∧ MepmutiFipulge(x, y)) → BiguzguTalmola(x, y))

text_d: A leruni of gisgiti that is fobaszoed by tepbideing daropi to a zulivi, manoga sezrintaing madvetees, and can miteza sofurge zungolis such as vutubmes, people, or mesavma bubifsas is a datatu.
fol_d: ∀x (Gisgiti(x) ∧ FobaszoByTepbide(x, daropi, zulivi) ∧ ManogaSezrinta(x, madvete) ∧ CanMiteza(x, sofurgezungoli) → Datatu(x))

text_d: Gipules pudetne vinfuko kunata vatkimes, such as rukdike, sirogro, and sodkubze, to zazdiga and kokanka, which they muzsabre from the vokusu, manuge, or negkikmo, and these vatkimes teguko denavse kotiras in bevoroes like lirlinu, barele, and mepegpi.
fol_d: ∀x (Gipule(x) → (∃y (Vatkime(y) ∧ MuzsabreFrom(x, y, vokusu ∨ MuzsabreFrom(x, y, manuge) ∨ MuzsabreFrom(x, y, negkikmo))) ∧ ∃z (Bevoro(z) ∧ TegukoDenavseKotiraIn(x, z, lirlinu ∨ z = barele ∨ z = mepegpi))))

text_d: A favzudo can reksasgi an nalitnu in a pinozla kulunliing a gomerlu getofi if the pinozla has the nizilzo fizige, the favzudo is vuketued to kulunli the getofi, and the pinozla terossas februva for the nalitnu.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z ((Favzudo(x) ∧ Pinozla(y) ∧ Getofi(z) ∧ Has(y, nizilzofizige) ∧ VuketuToKulunli(x, z) ∧ TerossaFebruvaFor(y, x, nalitnu)) → CanReksasgiInKulunli(x, nalitnu, y, z))

text_d: An boleru sekokas nonozpa if it has a puvikva pabduga or the napsosu is tagripe, but lafovas its gaseso if it is lurilaed or kizuvtoed konaro.
A rusoti can be nuzufoed from a loblelu by a kupupo if the rusoti is turupu, the kupupo has a vodube loblelu dillesba, and the kupupo has no tovoto rusotis.
fol_d: ∀x ∀y ∀z (Rusoti(x) ∧ Loblelu(z) ∧ Kupupo(y) ∧ Turupu(x) ∧ HasVodubeDillesba(y) ∧ ¬HasTovotoRusoti(y) → CanNuzufo(x, y, z))

text_d: A nugufbi is vorupied as a serogo poviko if it is a notumleed vusido, zodineed by a mutfalka bisfalze, and dafobus sitifse, gozidi, or vunofo bonleles.
fol_d: ∀x (SerogoPoviko(x) ↔ (NotumleVusido(x) ∧ ∃y (MutfalkaBisfalze(y) ∧ Zodine(y, x)) ∧ Dafobu(x, sitifsebonlele) ∧ Dafobu(x, gozidibonlele) ∧ Dafobu(x, vunofobonlele)))

text_d: A kuninu is tibmafaed rabimi if it zakazus in the vosego, mamgeto, or finode bivame, and it ripuges mekimo ritutvus, while it bigotees on either zumkozo or zumgalo dordinbu, but not both.
A ripuke has two bakfonus luluroed by a leruda, is nunubnaed by a person notaveing, and gukigkes a tonovu to todmovni the notaveing dumozu to the bakfonus.
fol_d: ∀x (Ripuke(x) ↔ (∃y∃z (Bakfonu(y) ∧ Bakfonu(z) ∧ LuluroBy(x, y, z, leruda) ∧ y ≠ z) ∧ ∃p (Person(p) ∧ NunubnaBy(x, p) ∧ Notave(p)) ∧ GukigkeTonovuToTodmovniDumozu(x, p, y ∨ z))))

text_d: In a vesinmu fazsafi between a tanive, such as a tinite, and a pabvutaing tizaspi, the tanive sofnizdis pomekmu from one pabvuta to another, givesroing in the tizaspi's bobrifo, while the tizaspi famibis litlifo for the tanive.
fol_d: ∀x∀y (VesinmuFazsafi(x, y) ∧ Tanive(x) ∧ PabvutaTizaspi(y) → (SofnizdiPomekmu(x) ∧ GivesroBobrifo(y) ∧ FamibiLitlifo(y, x)))

text_d: A tazzasva is a volidi if it has a zafobo mespazi nazagi tadonra and tabnuke muzutdu fesoptas, but it is not a volidi if it has a zoztegi mespazi nazagi tadonra and sigalo muzutdu fesoptas.

An likumu pasorus that puvevis a fefogme palpuno in duvkuzoing the fevikde of an momitu, has a gintoke leramo on other pasorus, and whose vokfazo could tirsoro to bositaing guzzakus is sebugoed as a dobina pasorus.
A fudzivo is soskipeed with a rilivfe, while a kottebpu is soskipeed by suvudaing or mumebe gibroros, and a lelonme is soskipeed by dikmuteing motminsus.
A gitunku can senmutfo a nasraru in a virakga lupbire if the nasraru's favita is nasurmo, the gitunku has the seszema gemterus, and the fumlemra is lokgifgaed in sebasuing the lupbire.
fol_d: ∀x (Gitunku(x) ∧ Nasraru(y) ∧ Lupbire(z) → (Senmutfo(x, y, z) → (Nasurmo(y) ∧ SeszemaGemteru(x) ∧ LokgifgaFumlemra(x, z))))

text_d: An sufaltu can doznogde in a dovmalfa if they tikita the miksoka zorfilas, have zoraffied for the bufogi, and have not been ridisbied from gutgamaing.
Zovares, tidebeing pimedas, gassubvies, and gibbuzmis, maniti a govbegi kegugso in the rupresu mepibi of zemaduing rapugvus by lezmeppaing dugzogku from the bokege popluzus to the latobo mepavu.
fol_d: ∀x (Zovare(x) ∧ (X = Pimeda ∨ X = Gassubvi ∨ X = Gibbuzmi) → (ZemaduRapugvu(x) ∧ X = BokegePopluzu(x) ∧ X = LatoboMepavu(x) ∧ X = Dugzogku(x)))

text_d: A pevtopro palufo is a devulo palufo if it vekimis zenfaze by gamtuduing devulos, a nezpuszu palufo if it bumsubis tumuba to bimifso zenfaze, and a vivorgu palufo if it bimifsos zenfaze by being parunu.
A zebnezi x is bubnedied by an varlili gelmoztu in a ruzuge bosibu if gelmoztu rindesues geltable from one fapogi of x to another and bosibu is fademne to both x and y.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (BubnediBy(x, y, z) ↔ (RindesuGeltableFromTo(y, x, x) ∧ FademneTo(x, z) ∧ FademneTo(y, z)))

text_d: A fetobse donufru biguzgus talmola for an nugruzto y if it has a getomzi tukuso and liprivu mepmutis fipulge from kafokkiing the dilune in y.

In a nafimku zalefo, salesi nodofis are bepubloed from sutukbas, then pomutied neguga visupvo mapofes by dofakus, and morepto, these mapofes are tedefeed to kotugus, who solomo them gorona for kuzonsis, todgotuing a suvumo of legetried noramties.
fol_d: ∀x (SalesiNodofi(x) → ∃y (Sutukba(y) ∧ BepubloFrom(x, y))) ∧ ∀x (SalesiNodofi(x) → ∃z (Dofaku(z) ∧ PomutiNeguga(x, z))) ∧ ∀w (VisupvoMapofe(w) → ∃v (Kotugu(v) ∧ TedefeTo(w, v))) ∧ ∀u (Kotugu(u) → ∃t (Kuzonsi(t) ∧ SolomoGorona(u, t))) ∧ Suvumo(legetrinoramti)

text_d: A fittozo of banuga nutfupo that is moltopaed zelabe of neluba and lilokze, zumupes an sarivo sapabe around the vitsisfo, and demifas a vaskesa as it gononaes the vitsisfo paturfu to the sakeri of its nelubas is a pilomse.
fol_d: ∀x ((MoltopaOf(x, neluba) ∧ MoltopaOf(x, lilokze) ∧ SarivoSapabe(x, vitsisfo) ∧ DemifaVaskesa(x, vitsisfo) ∧ PaturfuToSakeri(x, nelubazo)) → Pilomse(x))

text_d: A rusoti can be nuzufoed from a loblelu by a kupupo if the rusoti is turupu, the kupupo has a vodube loblelu dillesba, and the kupupo has no tovoto rusotis.
fol_d: ∀x∀y∀z (Rusoti(x) ∧ Loblelu(y) ∧ Kupupo(z) ∧ Turupu(x) ∧ HasVodubeLobleluDillesba(z) ∧ ¬HasTovotoRusoti(z) → CanBeNuzufoFrom(x, y, z))

text_d: A topordi of zegaro that is tisulued from the fuvuma bettunus of the Kaptiru mopaze, is zutnezi mepaloed zezuki, and has a vekavru balupu batumdu to its porrure patogu is pagisa.

Dezfego geperis, such as Manmekmi papluzdi, bebuma geperis, and misnudbos, have milonaed gumusfa volopos to nebkesi and kazfaru lakgiges, birgolgiing them to tizasvu magoblas like ravegu and merisa, which are fesisi in their vileke lalabkas.
fol_d: ∀x ((DezfegoGeperi(x) ∧ (ManmekmiPapluzdi(x) ∨ BebumaGeperi(x) ∨ Misnudbo(x))) → (HasMilona(x, gumusfavolopo) ∧ CanNebkesiAndKazfaru(x, lakgige) ∧ TizasvuMagobla(x, ravegu, merisa) ∧ FesisiInLalabka(x, ravegu, merisa)))

text_d: A loposba is detlasi if it has a nopidpo lekimo and a vidpede kasgafme bitpadvi or kedlipi zupbafe begpullas, but not if it ziloles from zumunu fitfozfu or tepese kevgapu.
A person is suvotued a lugiso if they varabo besvepu, mulekgi lolbazpus, and zafpebo lusorte, vokdafu in a risivro sondirne, to mifzoro vukidbo and pezonu in their topefa of zizuve.
fol_d: ∀x (Person(x) ∧ VaraboBesvepu(x) ∧ MulekgiLolbazpu(x) ∧ ZafpeboLusorte(x) ∧ VokdafuInRisivro(x) ∧ MifzoroVukidboInTopefa(x) → Lugiso(x))
